source_zh: 力量（STR）:表示角色力量的大小以及肉体上的强壮度，影响生命值（HP）、Protection（防御率）、伤害值（Damage）。此能力对于使用剑（Sword）和刀（Blade）的近战型角色来说是至关重要的能力。
translation: Strength (STR): Indicates the character's strength and physical strength, affecting health (HP), Protection (defense rate), and damage (Damage). This ability is crucial for melee characters who use swords and blades.

source_zh: 敏捷（DEX）:表示角色的灵活性、瞬间爆发等能力值，影响到命中率（To Hit）、回避率（Defence）。此能力对于使用枪（Gun）的远程型角色来说是至关重要的能力。
translation: Agility (DEX): Indicates the character's flexibility, instant burst and other ability values, which affects the hit rate (To Hit) and avoidance rate (Defence). This ability is crucial for long-range characters who use guns.

source_zh: 智力（INT）：表示角色的智力、集中力等精神上的能力值，影响到魔法力（MP）和魔法成功率。对于使用治疗（Heal）以及祝福（Enchant）的魔法圣职者角色来说是至关重要的能力。
translation: Intelligence (INT): Indicates the character's intelligence, concentration and other mental ability values, which affects magic power (MP) and magic success rate. A vital ability for magic priest characters who use Heal and Enchant.

source_zh: 生命值（HP）:表示角色的生命力，当HP变为0时角色将变为不可战斗状态。
translation: Health value (HP): Indicates the character's vitality. When the HP becomes 0, the character will become unable to fight.

source_zh: 魔法力（MP）/灵力（EP）：表示角色的精神力、魔法能力。当MP/EP变为0时不能使用任何魔法。
translation: Magic power (MP)/spiritual power (EP): Indicates the character's mental power and magic ability. No magic can be used when MP/EP reaches 0.

source_zh: 回避率（DeFence）：表示对敌人攻击的闪避能力，此项数值增高将提升回避对方攻击的几率。
translation: Avoidance rate (DeFence): Indicates the ability to dodge enemy attacks. An increase in this value will increase the chance of evading the opponent's attack.

source_zh: 防御率（Protection）：表示对敌人攻击的防护能力，此项数值增高将减少因对方的攻击而导致的伤害。
translation: Defense rate (Protection): Indicates the ability to protect against enemy attacks. An increase in this value will reduce the damage caused by the opponent's attacks.

source_zh: 命中率（Tohit）：表示角色攻击成功率的能力，此项数值增高将提高命中对手的几率。
translation: Tohit: The ability that indicates the success rate of a character's attack. An increase in this value will increase the chance of hitting the opponent.

source_zh: 伤害值/杀伤力（Damage）：表示给敌人造成伤害的程度。此项数值增大可以使攻击对对方Hp值减少的值更多。
translation: Damage value/lethality (Damage): Indicates the degree of damage caused to the enemy. Increasing this value can cause attacks to reduce the opponent's HP value by more.

source_zh:
欢迎加入EVE小队。
现在的形势非常紧急，所以不得不在没有受到训练的情况下把新兵投入战场中。
不过新兵也可以在野战司令部教官那里得到充分的训练，所以不必太担心。
首先你要凭补充命令书去找情报战略负责官员塔娜。先警告一下，擅自行动是禁止的。如果你擅自走出安全地带，刹那间会变成吸血鬼的食物。
新兵通过塔娜的模拟训练系统，可以培养出对抗吸血鬼的基本能力。一定要记住教官的说明。关于当前的战时情况的详细的内容，可以通过卡尔教官那里获取。请记住，新兵也算是EVE的正式军人，所以一定要遵守纪律并按照命令行动。
translation:
Welcome to join the EVE team.
The current situation is very urgent, so new soldiers have to be thrown into the battlefield without training.
However, new recruits can also receive sufficient training from the field command instructors, so there is no need to worry too much.
First, you must go to Tana, the officer in charge of intelligence strategy, with the supplementary order letter. First, a warning, unauthorized action is prohibited. If you step out of the safe zone without authorization, you will become vampire food in an instant.
Through Tana's simulation training system, new recruits can develop basic abilities to fight against vampires. Be sure to remember the instructor's instructions. Detailed information about the current wartime situation can be obtained from Instructor Carl. Please remember that recruits are also considered as official soldiers of EVE, so they must abide by discipline and act according to orders.

source_zh:
亲爱的兄弟姐妹们，能听到我的声音吗。我为你们增加的的力量和美丽的肉身你们能感觉到吗?
我是这个林宝城的主人巴托里。
你们现在的力量虽然比人类要强，不过在令人厌恶的人类面前还是很微小的。我希望你们在我的保护下吸收血液中的魔力，进而变得更强。仔细观察城里，你们将会发现通向地下的通道连接巴托里地牢地下1层，我用自己的力量来抵抗人类的侵入，你们就在这里安心地练习吧。
吸血只有在对方的生命力低于三分之一的时候才可以使用。吸血可以让你得到更强韧的能量，同时也可以补充你的生命力。
等级达到可以修炼魔法的时候，你可以去找林宝城的佛利可乐加斯，他会给你新的力量。
希望你能向我展示你的忠诚。
translation:
Dear brothers and sisters, can you hear my voice? Can you feel the strength and beautiful body I have added to you?
I am Bathory, the master of Linbao City.
Although your power is stronger than that of humans now, it is still very small in front of disgusting humans. I hope you will absorb the magic in your blood under my protection and become stronger. If you observe the city carefully, you will find that the underground passage leads to the first underground floor of Bathory Dungeon. I use my own power to resist human invasion. You can practice here with peace of mind.
Blood-stealing can only be used when the opponent's health is less than one-third. Vampire can give you stronger energy and replenish your vitality.
When you reach the level where you can practice magic, you can go to Foli Colagas in Linbao City and he will give you new power.
I hope you can show me your loyalty.

source_zh:
你一定要铭记生命和自然的正灵给你们降临的祝福，并把你们带到了这个地方的事实。
现在我们的圣地正在被吸血鬼和人类的欲望玷污。守护圣地的我们从长达500年的睡眠中睁开了双眼。随着我们需要带着我们的使命，为了守护圣地，现在需要你的力量。不用担心，因为我们身边的巨大的自然的灵一直陪伴着我们。
在魔灵村庄内有通向地下洞穴的通道，那里可以防御外族的侵入，所以请大家安心前往。
灵魂吸收是利用尸体给自己恢复EP，并制造HP恢复道具的重要的腐法之一。要借用正灵的力量就会需要EP，请记住这一点。
理解之后希望你加入我们，并加强我们的势力。
translation:
You must bear in mind the fact that the righteous spirit of life and nature has given you blessings and brought you to this place.
Now our holy places are being defiled by vampires and human desires. We who protect the Holy Land have opened our eyes from a 500-year sleep. As we carry out our mission to protect the Holy Land, your strength is now needed. Don't worry, because the huge natural spirit around us is always with us.
There is a passage leading to an underground cave in the Ousters Village, which is protected from foreign invasion, so please feel free to go there.
Soul absorption is one of the important corruption methods that uses corpses to restore EP to oneself and create HP restoration items. To borrow the power of the Righteous Spirit, you will need EP, please remember this.
After understanding, I hope you will join us and strengthen our power.

source_zh:
部分弹出的窗口可以按通过长按边框进行拖动来改变位置。
不可拖动的窗口通常可以通过点击窗口外的区域快速关闭该窗口
translation:
Some of the pop-up windows can be changed by dragging them by long pressing the border.
Non-dragable windows can usually be quickly closed by clicking outside the window.

source_zh:
[b][生命值栏][/b]
左侧显示生命值和法力值的状态
右侧显示当前最高的领域等级，以及该领域经验值距离升级的比例。

[b][小地图栏][/b]
右上角的小地图可以查看到你当前所在地区的地理信息，点击可以打开大地图看到更详细的信息，并且可以通过点击地图或者右侧的导航自动前往目标地点
tips: 该界面可以通过系统设置切换半透明显示。

[b][当前目标][/b]
当你选中任何玩家或怪物时，界面顶部会显示该目标的信息，包括目标的名称、血量、阶级图标以及增益信息。

[b][综合信息栏][/b]
[任务栏]
任务栏分页显示你当前的任务信息
tips: 如果距离任务地点过远，可以点击任务条目快速跳转到任务目的地。

[组队栏]
组队栏分页显示你当前队伍成员信息
tips: 在该栏内你可以快捷创建队伍或者快捷申请其他队伍。

[目标栏]
目标栏分页会显示你周围的队友信息以及敌人信息。

[b][快捷道具栏][/b]
当你装备了腰带（人族）时会获得快捷道具栏，你可以在背包界面点击想要放入的物品选择放入腰带，在快捷道具栏中选择放入的位置，点击即可及时便捷的使用。

[b][简略聊天栏][/b]
显示你所选择的聊天频道内的实时信息，点击该聊天栏可以展开聊天窗口
tips: 该界面可以通过系统设置切换半透明显示。

[b][系统菜单栏][/b]
包含技能编辑窗口、日期、时间以及主要功能入口。

[技能编辑]
点击“技能”按钮，可以进入技能编辑界面，在该界面内预览已学习的所有技能，并将其装备在技能轮盘中。

[布局编辑]
技能编辑界面内存在布局编辑分页，在此界面下可以新增或删除技能按钮，并且调整按钮的位置以及尺寸。

[时间/日期]
显示当前游戏时间（游戏时间并非现实时间）
tips：人族在游戏时间中的夜晚时行动受限，会难以看清周围的环境，需格外小心！

[功能菜单]
功能菜单下有四个分页，分别为“菜单”、“经验值”、“功能”、“系统”
每个分页下有主要的界面入口，比如背包界面、装备界面、组队界面、公会界面、系统设置界面等
translation:
[b][Health column][/b]
The left side shows the status of health and mana.
displays the current highest field level and the proportion of experience points in that field to upgrade.

[b][Mini map bar][/b]
The small map in the upper right corner can view the geographical information of your current area. Click to open the large map to see more detailed information, and you can automatically go to the target location by clicking on the map or the navigation on the right.
tips: This interface can switch translucent display through system settings.

[b][current target][/b]
When you select any player or monster, the target's information will be displayed at the top of the interface, including the target's name, blood volume, class icon and gain information.

[b][Comprehensive information column][/b]
[Taskbar]
The taskbar displays your current task information in paging
tips: If you are too far away from the mission location, you can click on the mission entry to quickly jump to the mission destination.

[Team Column]
The team column displays your current team member information in pages.
tips: In this column you can quickly create a team or quickly apply for other teams.

[target column]
The target bar tab will display information about teammates and enemies around you.

[b][Quick tool bar][/b]
When you are equipped with a belt (human race), you will get a shortcut tool bar. You can click on the item you want to put in the backpack interface and select it to put into the belt. Select the location in the shortcut tool bar and click to use it promptly and conveniently.

[b][Simple chat bar][/b]
displays real-time information in the chat channel you selected. Click the chat bar to expand the chat window.
tips: This interface can switch translucent display through system settings.

[b][System menu bar][/b]
includes skill editing window, date, time and main function entrance.

[Skill Edit]
Click the "Skills" button to enter the skill editing interface, where you can preview all the skills you have learned and equip them in the skill wheel.

[Layout Edit]
There is a layout editing page in the skill editing interface. In this interface, you can add or delete skill buttons, and adjust the position and size of the buttons.

[time/date]
Displays the current game time (game time is not real time)
tips: Humans have limited movement at night during game time, and it will be difficult to see the surrounding environment clearly, so be extra careful!

[Function menu]
There are four pages under the function menu, namely "Menu", "Experience Value", "Function" and "System"
There are main interface entrances under each page, such as backpack interface, equipment interface, team interface, guild interface, system settings interface, etc.

Click the "Skills" button to enter the skill editing interface, where you can preview all the skills you have learned and equip them in the skill wheel.

[Layout Edit]
There is a layout editing page in the skill editing interface. In this interface, you can add or delete skill buttons, and adjust the position and size of the buttons.

[time/date]
Displays the current game time (game time is not real time)

[Function menu]
There are four pages under the function menu, namely "Menu", "Experience Value", "Function" and "System"
There are main interface entrances under each page, such as backpack interface, equipment interface, team interface, guild interface, system settings interface, etc.

source_zh:
可以通过点击魔物或者使用魔物选择按钮选中魔物

力量（STR）影响到杀伤力和生命值。 

敏捷性（DEX）影响到命中率和防御力。

知识（INT）可影响MP,SP以及圣职者和魔灵族的特定魔法强度。

所有装备都会有角色能力值或等级的制约。

击败怪物可以搜刮战利品，再次搜刮可以获得怪物灵石。

获得的怪物灵石可以贩卖给NPC以换取金钱。

小地图中用绿色范围的地方是安全区。

在安全区不能使用技能。

要进行交易时在安全区点击交易对象选择交易后等待答复即可。

全体攻击模式下可以攻击同族玩家，但是会降低倾向值。

若在聊天窗口中多次连续发送消息，会导致暂时无法使用聊天窗。

想要与人组队可以通过组队界面找到合适的队伍发送申请然后等待答复即可。

要说悄悄话，可以在聊天窗口点击对方名字选择私聊

点击右上角小地图可以打开大地图。

倾向值过低时死亡将会随机丢失自己所拥有的道具。

在相同的种族之间，攻击比自己倾向值良好的人会使自己的倾向值变的更坏。

如有疑问事宜请致信我们的客服信箱，或者拨打我们的客服电话。

如有bug,请联系GM或者致信我们的客服信箱。

关于各种活动的疑问事项请致信我们的客服信箱或者登陆我们的官方网站查询。

玩家帐号资料请妥善保管，以防止被黑客盗取或被骗而导致玩家帐号物品丢失。

请大家避免不礼貌的言行（辱骂，刷屏）。

请务必不要的向别人透露密码或身份证号码

吸血鬼和怪物们在夜间攻击力会增强。

生命力(HP) :显示角色生命力的值，当HP为0时角色会死亡。

命中率(TOHIT) :显示攻击的准确性，隶属于敏捷(DEX)和技能以及总技能等级。

伤害值(DAMAGE) :显示可以给予对方伤害的程度，隶属于力量(STR)和技能等级。

回避率(DEFENSE) :显示防御能力，隶属于敏捷(DEX)。

防御率(PROTECTION) :显示角色能承受攻击的能力，隶属于力量(STR)。

声望值(FAME) :随着杀灭怪兽的数量的增加而上升。

屏幕的左上方出现人物装备简率图时要对图上被黄色或红色标记的装备进行修复。

每个装备都标有装备这个装备所需的能力值。

使用道具时，红色标记的道具不能被使用。

先受到攻击时将启动正当防卫系统。

正当防卫启动时，在一定的时间间隔内可不受倾向值的影响而实施反击。

对话框和地图具有半透明显示功能，可以在设置-画面中开启或关闭半透明开模式

为了保护玩家的装备和物品安全，已关闭了人族玩家被吸血鬼吸血后24小时会变为吸血鬼的特性

部分技能可以通过长按施法按钮自动连续施法
translation:
Monsters can be selected by clicking on them or using the monster selection button

Strength (STR) affects lethality and health.

Agility (DEX) affects hit rate and defense.

Knowledge (INT) can affect MP, SP and the specific magic intensity of priests and Ousters.

All equipment will be restricted by character ability value or level.

You can search for loot by defeating monsters, and you can get monster spiritual stones by searching again.

The monster spirit stones obtained can be sold to NPCs in exchange for money.

The green area on the mini map is the safe zone.

Skills cannot be used in the safe zone.

When you want to conduct a transaction, click the transaction object in the safe area, select the transaction, and wait for the reply.

can attack players of the same race in collective attack mode, but the tendency value will be reduced.

If you send multiple consecutive messages in the chat window, the chat window will be temporarily unavailable.

If you want to form a team with someone, you can find a suitable team through the team formation interface, send an application and wait for the reply.

If you want to whisper, you can click on the other party's name in the chat window and select private chat

Click on the small map in the upper right corner to open the large map.

If the propensity value is too low and you die, you will randomly lose the props you own.

Among people of the same race, attacking someone with a better tendency than your own will make your own tendency worse.

If you have any questions, please write to our customer service mailbox or call our customer service phone number.

If there is a bug, please contact GM or write to our customer service mailbox.

For questions about various activities, please write to our customer service mailbox or log on to our official website for inquiries.

Please keep player account information properly to prevent it from being stolen by hackers or being deceived, resulting in the loss of player account items.

Please avoid impolite words and deeds (insults, screen spam).

Please do not disclose your password or ID number to others.

The attack power of vampires and monsters will be enhanced at night.

Vitality (HP): Displays the character’s vitality value. When HP reaches 0, the character will die.

Hit rate (TOHIT): Shows the accuracy of the attack, which belongs to agility (DEX) and skills as well as the total skill level.

Damage value (DAMAGE): Shows the degree of damage that can be inflicted on the opponent, and is subordinate to strength (STR) and skill level.

Avoidance rate (DEFENSE): Displays defense ability and belongs to agility (DEX).

Defense rate (PROTECTION): Shows the character's ability to withstand attacks and belongs to strength (STR).

Reputation (FAME): Rise as the number of monsters killed increases.

When a simplified picture of character equipment appears in the upper left corner of the screen, the equipment marked in yellow or red on the picture must be repaired.

Each piece of equipment is marked with the ability value required to equip it.

When using props, props marked in red cannot be used.

When attacked first, the legitimate defense system will be activated.

When the legitimate defense is activated, counterattacks can be carried out within a certain time interval without being affected by the tendency value.

The dialog box and map have a translucent display function. The translucent mode can be turned on or off in Settings-Screen.

In order to protect the safety of players' equipment and items, the feature that human players will turn into vampires 24 hours after being sucked by a vampire has been turned off.

Some skills can be automatically cast continuously by long pressing the cast button.

source_zh:
背包是储存物品的界面。为了游戏的可玩性背包的容量有所限制。新版中出现的道具其大小和形状都各不一样，因此为了携带更多的道具就需要平时妥善整理物品。

使用NPC提供的仓库可以存放更多的平时不太使用的道具。而若要使用仓库就得支付一定数额的金钱买来保管箱。

点击窗口下端的‘以半透明显示’按钮即可使道具栏窗口半透明化，可以看到被遮盖的部分。
translation:
Backpack is an interface for storing items. The capacity of the backpack is limited for the sake of playability. The props that appear in the new version are all different in size and shape, so in order to carry more props, you need to organize your items properly.

Use the warehouse provided by NPC to store more props that are not usually used. If you want to use the warehouse, you have to pay a certain amount of money to buy a safe deposit box.

Click the ‘Show translucent’ button at the bottom of the window to make the toolbar window translucent, so you can see the covered part.

source_zh:
[b][背包界面][/b]

[打开界面]
在右下角菜单栏点击背包按钮即可打开背包界面。再次点击按钮界面就会关闭。

[道具丢弃]
要丢弃某个道具，在背包中点击道具并选择丢弃，该道具就会从背包里消失并出现在地面。

[快捷道具栏]
点击道具后选择“放入腰带”即可将道具移动至快捷道具栏。

[穿戴要求]
装备有穿戴要求，达不到要求时道具会显示为红颜色并无法被穿戴。

[道具使用]
单击道具后选择使用。
translation:
[b][Backpack interface][/b]

[Open interface]
Click the backpack button in the menu bar in the lower right corner to open the backpack interface. Click the button again and the interface will close.

[Props discarded]
To discard an item, click on the item in the backpack and select Discard. The item will disappear from the backpack and appear on the ground.

[Quick tool bar]
Click on the prop and select "Insert into Belt" to move the prop to the shortcut bar.

[Wearing requirements]
Equipment has wearing requirements. If the requirements are not met, the props will be displayed in red and cannot be worn.

[Props use]
Click on the prop and choose to use it.

source_zh: 装备界面显示了玩家当前穿戴的所有装备
translation: The equipment interface displays all the equipment currently worn by the player.

source_zh:
吸血鬼有强大的身体技能，因此不必要装备武器或额外的护具。吸血鬼一族擅长使用从古代流传下来的邪恶魔法咒语使自己的能力值提高。
吸血鬼 可装配的物品如下。

[装备清单]
项链(Necklace) × 1
外套(Coat) × 1
手镯(Bracelet) × 2
戒指(Ring) × 4
耳环(Earring) × 2
武器(Claw) × 2
护身符(Amulet) × 4

[装备穿戴]
选择要装备的物品，在背包左键点击想要穿着的装备，会弹出详细的装备信息以及操作按钮，装备可穿戴的部位会显示在左侧，默认为空位，点击其他位置即可选择想要穿戴的位置（如果该装备没有其他可装备的位置则不会显示）然后点击穿戴按钮即可将装备穿戴到指定的位置
translation:
Vampires have powerful physical skills, so there is no need to equip weapons or additional protective gear. The vampire family is good at using evil magic spells passed down from ancient times to improve their abilities.
Vampire can equip are as follows.

[Equipment List]
Necklace × 1
Jacket (Coat) × 1
Bracelet × 2
Ring (Ring) × 4
earrings (Earring) × 2
Weapon (Claw) × 2
Amulet (Amulet) × 4

[Equipment Wear]
Select the item to be equipped, left-click the equipment you want to wear in the backpack, and detailed equipment information and operation buttons will pop up. The wearable parts of the equipment will be displayed on the left, and the default is empty. Click on other positions to select the position you want to wear (if the equipment has no other equippable positions, it will not be displayed) and then click the wear button to wear the equipment to the specified position.

source_zh: 角色信息界面显示角色的具体属性和技能学习进度。
translation: The character information interface displays the character's specific attributes and skill learning progress.

source_zh:
[b][个人信息页][/b]
显示角色的能力值及公会信息，还有角色的各种能力值，从角色的属性栏可以看到角色的各种能力值及声望。如果已加入公会，还可以看到公会名及公会徽章。

[b][基础技能页][/b]
可以确认人物所获得的技能以及技能等级。

[b][下级阶级页][/b]
每提升一个阶级，都能选择每个阶级的技能。

[b][上级阶级页][/b]
每提升一个阶级，都能选择每个阶级的技能。

[b][转职技能页][/b]
可以学习转职后才可以获得的高级技能
translation:
[b][Personal information page][/b]
displays the character's ability value and guild information, as well as the character's various ability values. From the character's attribute bar, you can see the character's various ability values and reputation. If you have joined a guild, you can also see the guild name and guild badge.

[b][Basic Skills Page][/b]
You can confirm the skills and skill levels acquired by the character.

[b][lower class page][/b]
Every time you advance to a level, you can choose the skills of each level.

[b][Advanced level page][/b]
Every time you advance to a level, you can choose the skills of each level.

[b][Job transfer skills page][/b]
can learn advanced skills that can be obtained after changing jobs

source_zh:
使用仓库前需要跟仓库管理员购买，购买完毕后就可以在右下角的菜单栏中快速访问你的仓库。
仓库最多可以解锁5个保管箱，可以存放大量物品（宠物无法放入仓库），如有大量物品的存储需求，可以点击仓库其他保管箱分页来购买开启。
translation:
You need to purchase it from the warehouse administrator before using the warehouse. After purchasing, you can quickly access your warehouse in the menu bar in the lower right corner.
The warehouse can unlock up to 5 safe deposit boxes, which can store a large number of items (pets cannot be placed in the warehouse). If you need to store a large number of items, you can click on the other safe deposit boxes in the warehouse to purchase and open them.

source_zh:
[b][使用方法][/b]
[查看保管箱]
与仓库管理员对话并购买保管箱以后，与NPC对话，选择保险箱即可在弹出的保管箱界面查看储存的物品。

[保管物品]
在背包中点击需要存入的物品，选择放入即可将物品放入仓库。

[取出物品]
在仓库界面点击需要取出的物品，选择取出后即可将物品取出并放入背包。

[快捷操作]
在仓库中点击“快捷”按钮，即可通过直接点击物品，快速将物品存入或者取出仓库。
translation:
[b][How to use][/b]
[View safe box]
After talking to the warehouse manager and purchasing the safe, talk to the NPC and select the safe to view the stored items in the pop-up safe box interface.

[Items for safekeeping]
Click on the items to be stored in the backpack and select Put to put the items into the warehouse.

[Remove items]
Click on the item to be taken out on the warehouse interface. After selecting Take Out, the item can be taken out and put into the backpack.

[Quick operation]
Click the "Quick" button in the warehouse to quickly deposit or remove items from the warehouse by directly clicking on the items.

source_zh: 与担任交易职位的NPC对话会弹出商店界面。大部分情况下每位NPC仅出售特定的物品。但是可以收购所有类型的物品，听NPC们的自言自语就了解其出售的物品种类。
translation: Talking to the NPC in the trading position will pop up the store interface. In most cases each NPC only sells specific items. However, all types of items can be purchased. Listen to the NPCs talking to themselves to understand the types of items they sell.

source_zh:
[b][使用方法][/b]
商店中陈列的物品按价值，能力，性能分成三栏。

[一般物品]
不具有额外附魔属性的普通物品。

[特殊道具]
具有额外随机附魔属性的装备，比普通的装备更强力。

[神秘商店]
不确定的装备或道具。
translation:
[b][How to use][/b]
The items displayed in the store are divided into three columns according to value, ability and performance.

[General items]
Ordinary items without additional enchantment properties.

[Special props]
Equipment with additional random enchantment attributes, which is more powerful than ordinary equipment.

[Mysterious Shop]
Uncertain equipment or props.

source_zh: 使用古代忘却水晶可以回收所有已使用的属性点
translation:
Using the Ancient Forgotten Crystal can recycle all used attribute points
After using

source_zh:
[b][使用方法][/b]
[重置点数]
购买古代忘却水晶后，在此界面可以重置属性点
[消耗数量]
每次重置属性点会消耗一颗古代忘却水晶

[b][属性建议][/b]
[力量]
适合近战类的职业，提升攻击力和生命值
[敏捷]
适合灵活的职业，提升闪避率和防御率
[智力]
适合法术职业，会提升部分法术技能伤害以及法力值
translation:
[b][How to use][/b]
[Reset Points]
After purchasing the Ancient Forgotten Crystal, you can reset the attribute points in this interface.
[Consumption quantity]
Each time you reset an attribute point, an ancient crystal of oblivion will be consumed.

[b][Attribute suggestions][/b]
[Strength]
Suitable for melee occupations, improves attack power and health
[Agility]
Suitable for flexible professions, improve dodge rate and defense rate
[Intelligence]
is suitable for magic professions and will increase the damage and mana value of some spells and skills.

source_zh: 玩家可扮演不同种类的职业，并运用多样的技能和魔法展开战斗。
translation: Players can play different types of professions and use a variety of skills and magic to fight.

source_zh:
[b][人族][/b]
人族在使用不同种类的武器进行攻击时会获得该武器领域的熟练度以提升该领域的等级
领域等级的提升可以让人族学习对应领域的专属技能

[b][吸血鬼族][/b]
吸血鬼族击败敌人或者吸取敌人血液时会获得经验值来提升等级
虽然吸血鬼族只需要等级足够就可以学习任意流派的技能，但是也有战斗风格的区分，战士类的技能会受到力量值的加成，法术系的技能会受到智力水平的加成

[b][魔灵族][/b]
魔灵族在击败敌人后会获得经验值以提升等级，每次提升等级时就会获得技能点来解锁或提升技能等级。
translation:
[b][Terran][/b]
When humans use different types of weapons to attack, they will gain proficiency in that weapon field to improve the level in that field.
The improvement of field level allows humans to learn exclusive skills in the corresponding field

[b][Vampire][/b]
When vampires defeat enemies or absorb their blood, they will gain experience points to increase their level.
Although vampires only need to be of sufficient level to learn skills of any genre, there are also differences in fighting styles. Warrior skills will be bonused by strength, and spell skills will be bonused by intelligence level.

[b][Devil Tribe][/b]
After defeating enemies, the Ousters will gain experience points to level up. Each time they level up, they will gain skill points to unlock or upgrade skill levels.

source_zh:
人类和吸血鬼族以及魔灵族各具有很多不同风格的技能和魔法。
包含攻击技能、辅助魔法、恢复魔法、诅咒魔法、精灵魔法等，可以开展多样的战斗模式。
translation:
Humans, vampires and Ousters each have many different styles of skills and magic.
includes attack skills, auxiliary magic, recovery magic, curse magic, elf magic, etc., allowing for various combat modes.

source_zh:
[b][使用方法][/b]
[查看技能]
通过角色信息界面查看技能列表或者在技能编辑界面查看当前已学习的技能

[装备技能]
在技能编辑界面下，选择需要装备的技能然后再选择一个技能轮盘按钮即可将技能装备在轮盘上

[使用技能]

translation:
[b][How to use][/b]
chat system has the following 10 channels

[System Channel]
The system channel only displays system prompt information

[Comprehensive Channel]
Comprehensive channel will display the content of all channels

[World Channel]
All players in the entire server can communicate with each other in this channel

[Race Channel]
Only chat messages of the same race can be displayed in race channels.

[Nearby Channel]
Nearby channels only display chat information around the player

[Regional Channel]
regional channel displays all chat information in the player's current region

[Private chat channel]
Only private chat information is displayed under the private chat channel

[Team channel]
Only the communication information of players in the same team is displayed under the team channel.

[Guild Channel]
Guild channel only displays communication information between players in the same guild

[Alliance Channel]
The alliance channel only displays communication information between the same guild and all players under the alliance guild.

source_zh: 玩家在达到指定等级后，支付一定的费用即可创建自己的公会

source_zh:
[b][使用方法][/b]

[公会人数]
一个公会最多可以容纳100位成员。

[退出公会]
在公会界面下，点击退出公会即可退出。

[删除公会]
仅公会会长有权限删除公会，在删除公会前，需要踢出公会内所有其他成员。
translation:
[b][How to use][/b]
[Guild Creation]
Open the guild interface. When the player's level reaches the requirements, click Create Guild to edit the name and profile of the guild. After paying the fee to create a guild, the guild can be successfully created.

[Guild Number]
A guild can accommodate up to 100 members.

[Join Guild]
Open the guild interface, click on the guild name to view the guild's profile, click Apply to Join, and then submit the membership application. After approval by the president or administrator, you will automatically enter the guild.

[Exit the guild]
In the guild interface, click Exit Guild to exit.

[Delete Guild]
Only the guild leader has the authority to delete the guild. Before deleting the guild, all other members in the guild need to be kicked out.

You are not born weak, but if you want to survive in the world of Ousters, you must learn to master the darkness and prove your worth. Sora is the leader of this realm, and she holds the secrets of the growth of the Ousters. Your first step is to go to her and listen to her teachings on the rules of survival of the Ousters. Maybe she will tell you how to absorb dark energy, maybe she will test your will, but no matter what, you must embark on this road destined to be full of blood and power. Remember, in the world of Ousters, only the strong can be recognized, and you will take the first step to become a strong one.

source_zh: 魔族的力量来源于无尽的吞噬与进化。战斗不仅是杀戮的艺术，更是力量跃升的捷径。你的血脉已开始觉醒，但如果你不去掌握更深层次的技能，那你终究只是低等的生物，迟早被更强者碾碎。黑暗之力正在呼唤你，学习新的技能，掌控更深邃的魔能，让自身的战力得到质变。不要停下脚步，继续提升自己，直至化为真正的魔族霸主。战场无情，唯有不断学习、不断进化，才能成为吞噬一切的黑暗统治者！

Your bloodline has begun to awaken, but if you don't master deeper skills, you will ultimately be just an inferior creature and will be crushed by the stronger sooner or later. The power of darkness is calling you, learn new skills, control deeper magic energy, and achieve a qualitative change in your combat power. Don't stop and continue to improve yourself until you become a true Ousters overlord. The battlefield is ruthless. Only by constantly learning and evolving can you become the ruler of darkness that devours everything!

Ancient magic rituals require these spiritual stones to strengthen the blood contract, and the magicians in the alchemy workshop use them to create stronger weapons. You have accumulated enough results in your hands, and it is time to trade these spoils in exchange for more powerful resources. Whether they are used to strengthen yourself or exchange for magic weapons, they will ultimately help you climb to a higher peak of power. Give these spiritual stones to the buyers of the Ousters and let them release their final value on the altar of chaos to help you embark on the path of becoming a stronger person!

source_zh: [color=#41f6ff]混乱守护者[/color]突然在[color=#41f6ff]德罗比特_东北[/color]出现，前哨快撑不住了。你需要前往此处，听从前线指挥官安排。这可能是一场真正的兽潮。
translation: [color=#41f6ff]Chaos Guardian[/color]suddenly[color=#41f6ff]Drobit_Northeast[/color]appeared, and the outpost could no longer hold on. You need to go here and follow the instructions of the frontline commander. This could be a real beast wave.

source_zh: 北边吹来的风带着腐烂气息飘散至[color=#41f6ff]德罗比特_东北[/color]的各个角落，那片丛林已经不是原来的样子。你需要带领你的小队找到丛林找到这一切的根源。
translation: The wind blowing from the north carries the smell of decay to[color=#41f6ff]Drobit_Northeast[/color]In every corner, the jungle is no longer what it used to be. You need to lead your team into the jungle to find the root of it all.

source_zh: 昨天夜里，[color=#41f6ff]德罗比特_东北[/color]出现一道诡异的黑光。这让E.V.E高层感到十分不安。你必须前往调查原因。
translation: Last night,[color=#41f6ff]Drobit_Northeast[/color]A strange black light appeared. This made E.V.E executives very uneasy. You must go and investigate the cause.

source_zh: 几位斥候失联超过三天。最后一次通话是在[color=#41f6ff]艾森地牢地下一层[/color]，你要小心，这地方最近怪异得很。
translation: Several scouts have been out of contact for more than three days. The last call was at[color=#41f6ff]Basement 1 of Eisen Dungeon[/color], you have to be careful, this place has been very weird recently.

source_zh: 咆哮深渊的魔气不断上升，在[color=#41f6ff]艾森地牢地下一层[/color]忽然出现大量的魔物。E.V.E组织需要你和你的团队立即前往此处，抵御第一波炼狱怪潮。
translation: The demonic energy of the Roaring Abyss continues to rise.[color=#41f6ff]Basement 1 of Eisen Dungeon[/color]A large number of monsters suddenly appeared. The E.V.E organization needs you and your team to go here immediately to resist the first wave of infernal monsters.

source_zh: 深夜的野怪们的嘶吼声音吓得营地内的孩子们哭了一夜，边境塔台还报告发现多处脚印。现在组织要求你带上你的小队，去[color=#41f6ff]艾森地牢地下一层[/color]进行调查并清楚周围的威胁。
translation: The roars of wild monsters in the middle of the night scared the children in the camp to crying all night, and the border tower also reported the discovery of many footprints. Now the organization requires you to bring your team and go[color=#41f6ff]Basement 1 of Eisen Dungeon[/color]Investigate and become aware of surrounding threats.

source_zh: [color=#41f6ff]罗姆地牢地下一层[/color]有人疯狂涂写奇怪文字，有村民梦中喃喃念咒。E.V.E组织怀疑这与那边怪物的异变有关，你必须亲自前往。
translation: [color=#41f6ff]The underground floor of Rom Dungeon[/color]Some people scribbled strange words crazily, and some villagers murmured curses in their dreams. The E.V.E organization suspects that this is related to the mutation of the monster over there, and you must go there in person.

source_zh: 几名士兵伤口腐败，血液变黑。据说他们被“[color=#41f6ff]罗姆地牢地下一层[/color]”的魔物咬伤。你得亲自去调查那里发生了什么。
translation: The wounds of several soldiers were corrupted and their blood turned black. It is said that they were "[color=#41f6ff]The underground floor of Rom Dungeon[/color]” monster bite. You have to go and investigate what happened there yourself.

source_zh: [color=#41f6ff]罗姆地牢地下一层[/color]深处传来一阵阵尖啸，连低阶的魔物们都不敢靠近。必须找到愿意冒险之人，进入[color=#41f6ff]德罗比特_东南[/color]深处调查问题的根源。
translation: [color=#41f6ff]The underground floor of Rom Dungeon[/color]There were screams from the depths, and even the low-level monsters did not dare to approach. You must find someone willing to take the risk and enter[color=#41f6ff]Drobit_Southeast[/color]digs deep into the root of the problem.

source_zh: 组织中的牧师们听见大地之灵正在痛苦呻吟，[color=#41f6ff]艾森地牢地下2层[/color]是腐败的源头。作为E.V.E组织的一员，你必须承担净化沼泽的使命，请尽快前往此处。
translation: The priests in the organization heard the spirit of the earth moaning in pain,[color=#41f6ff]Basement 2 of Eisen Dungeon[/color]is the source of corruption. As a member of the E.V.E organization, you must undertake the mission of purifying the swamp. Please go here as soon as possible.

source_zh: [color=#41f6ff]艾森地牢地下2层[/color]出现大量“[color=#41f6ff]追讨者[/color]”，他们不断的破坏周边的一切。周边的居民已经向组织发起请求，请尽快前往此处，解救群众与水生火热之中。
translation: [color=#41f6ff]Basement 2 of Eisen Dungeon[/color]A large number of "[color=#41f6ff]Dun Wolfarch[/color]", they continue to destroy everything around them. The surrounding residents have requested the organization, please go here as soon as possible to rescue the people and the water in the fiery situation.

source_zh: 亡者的灵魂在哭泣，[color=#41f6ff]艾森地牢地下2层[/color]的墓园秩序被破坏。圣光需要你的剑刃，去安抚那些不该再行走的亡魂。
translation:
The souls of the dead are crying,[color=#41f6ff]Basement 2 of Eisen Dungeon[/color]'s cemetery order has been disrupted. The Holy Light needs your blade to appease the souls who should no longer walk.

translation: The spirit of the earth sent a warning, a large number of[color=#41f6ff]Hell Fiend[/color]tried to[color=#41f6ff]Rom Dungeon Basement 2[/color], destroying the sacred center of the earth. As a warrior of the E.V.E organization, you must wield your sword to protect the rhythm of the earth.

source_zh: 这些邪祟中竟然出现了变异种“[color=#41f6ff]高级地狱邪神[/color]，”一定要千万小心，这编制中的手段组织至今都没有完全了解清楚。
translation: There are mutant species among these evil spirits"[color=#41f6ff]Chief Hell Fiend[/color], "You must be extremely careful. The means and organization in this establishment are not fully understood yet."

source_zh: E.V.E战士的要求便是以血誓守护疆土。大批的怪物和异族人践踏了圣土，你需以杀伐回应，守住人族尊严。
translation: E.V.E warriors is to protect the territory with a blood oath. A large number of monsters and aliens have trampled on the holy land. You need to respond with killing to preserve the dignity of the human race.

source_zh: 神明告诉我，怪物们正在[color=#41f6ff]IK办公室[/color]中试图撕裂我们人族长久以来的秩序。战士们，不必心慈手软，歼灭它们。
translation: God told me that monsters are[color=#41f6ff]IK Office[/color]attempts to tear apart the long-standing order of our human race. Soldiers, don’t be merciful and annihilate them.

source_zh: [color=#41f6ff]IK办公室[/color]被“[color=#41f6ff]IK驼背[/color]”所占据，它们喋喋不休，施加精神污染。进入会议厅，消灭它们！
translation: [color=#41f6ff]IK Office[/color]was "[color=#41f6ff]Lunga Testa[/color]", they chatter endlessly and exert mental pollution. Enter the conference hall and destroy them!

source_zh: [color=#41f6ff]IK办公室[/color]充斥着大量形形色色的怪物，他们袭击办公区人员，并将此地占位己有。
translation: [color=#41f6ff]IK Office[/color]is filled with a large number of monsters of all kinds. They attack the people in the office area and take over the place for themselves.

source_zh: 那些曾经囚禁在地下的“[color=#41f6ff]夏米赛双头怪[/color]”挣脱束缚，四处杀戮。请尽快前往[color=#41f6ff]IK试验室[/color]阻止这场动荡进一步爆发。
translation: Those "who were once imprisoned underground"[color=#41f6ff]Siamese[/color]“Break free and kill everywhere. Please go as soon as possible[color=#41f6ff]IK laboratory[/color]prevent this unrest from erupting further.

source_zh: 神在哭泣，怪物们玷污了[color=#41f6ff]IK试验室[/color]。请快去净化这片污渊吧。
translation: God is crying, monsters have defiled[color=#41f6ff]IK laboratory[/color]. Please go and purify this filthy abyss.

source_zh: 成群的怪物试图前往[color=#41f6ff]IK试验室[/color]偷取能源。E.V.E下达最高指示，能量不得有失。战士们，此次任务不容有失！
translation: Groups of monsters try to go[color=#41f6ff]IK laboratory[/color]Steal energy. E.V.E issued the highest instructions, and there must be no loss of energy. Soldiers, there is no room for failure in this mission!

source_zh: 曾经那些研究的生物标本如今发生了变异，组织希望你前往[color=#41f6ff]IK试验室地下1层[/color]去调查一下原因
translation: The biological specimens that were once studied have now mutated, and the organization wants you to go[color=#41f6ff]IK laboratory basement 1st floor[/color]Let’s investigate the reason

source_zh: 愈合的力量已被扭曲。一个个怪物从生物培养皿中破壳而出，将恶意的缝合彻底拆解。请尽快前往[color=#41f6ff]IK试验室地下1层[/color]平息这次的灾难。
translation: The power of healing has been twisted. One by one, the monsters burst out of the biological petri dish, completely dismantling the malicious sutures. Please go as soon as possible[color=#41f6ff]IK laboratory basement 1st floor[/color]Calm down this disaster.

source_zh: 怪物的哀嚎声，嘶吼声不断的在[color=#41f6ff]IK试验室地下1层[/color]中回荡，这次的任务是给这个失败的实验收尾，一定不能让它们从地下逃出来。
translation: The monster’s wailing and roaring sounds continue to[color=#41f6ff]IK laboratory basement 1st floor[/color]. This mission is to put an end to this failed experiment. They must not be allowed to escape from the underground.

source_zh: 你从虚无中苏醒，仿佛跨越了无数岁月的黑暗与沉寂，灵魂中燃起微弱却坚定的冥火。四周弥漫着浓郁的阴霾与低语般的魂鸣，冥界的气息扑面而来。远处，一座被幽光笼罩的小镇伫立在荒芜之中，那是你命运的起点。一位掌控炼狱奥秘的古老指引者正在等待你的到来，为你揭开鬼族命运的序章，赋予走向强大与荣耀的第一份使命。去佛利可乐加斯处领取你第一个任务。
translation: You wake up from nothingness, as if you have transcended countless years of darkness and silence, and a weak but firm underworld fire is ignited in your soul. The surroundings were filled with thick haze and whispering soul sounds, and the breath of the underworld rushed towards his face. In the distance, a small town shrouded in gloom stands in the desolation. That is the starting point of your destiny. An ancient guide who controls the secrets of purgatory is waiting for your arrival to unveil the prelude to the fate of the Vampires and give you the first mission to become powerful and glorious. Go to Foli Colagas to receive your first quest.

source_zh: 暗袋是非常方便的装备，你可以把你在战斗中所需要用到的常用道具放到你的暗袋中。
translation: The secret bag is a very convenient equipment. You can put the common props you need in battle into your secret bag.

source_zh: [color=#41f6ff]莫德拉斯[/color]不是鬼，是残念堆积出来的火球。他们死过一次，又死了一次，却仍在痛。你得去[color=#41f6ff]林宝城地牢[/color]帮他们安静下来——用爆破的方式。
translation: [color=#41f6ff]Moderas[/color]It's not a ghost, it's a fireball caused by the accumulation of residual thoughts. They died once and again, but they still hurt. you have to go[color=#41f6ff]Linbaocheng Dungeon[/color]Help them quiet down - by blasting.

source_zh: [color=#41f6ff]破坏者[/color]是最烦的，它们生生不息，永生不灭。你想干这活？切记别让他们复活得比你下刀还快。
translation: [color=#41f6ff]Vandalizer[/color]is the most annoying, they live forever and live forever. You want to do this job? Don't let them resurrect faster than you can kill them.

source_zh: 我们看见月亮裂开了，那不是幻觉。逐月的魂影开始咬人的脚步声很轻，它们等在风里，你要去踩碎它们，别怕黑。
translation: We saw the moon crack, that was not an illusion. The ghost shadow of Zhuyue begins to bite people's footsteps very softly. They are waiting in the wind. You have to crush them. Don't be afraid of the dark.

source_zh: 黄泉不该有涌动，那意味着封印松了。你不是看守者，但现在你得做那事。去把那些爬出来的魂踩回地里，再撒土。
translation: The underworld shouldn't be surging, that means the seal is loose. You're not a caretaker, but now you have to do that. Go and trample those souls that crawled out back into the ground, and then spread the soil.

source_zh: [color=#41f6ff]巴托里地牢地下3层[/color]里有喘气声，像是在你耳边。那不是风，是林喉。你不杀它，它就咬你——或者你梦里的族人。别再犹豫。
translation: [color=#41f6ff]Bathory Dungeon underground level 3[/color]There is a gasping sound, as if it is in your ear. That wasn't the wind, it was Lin Hou. If you don't kill it, it will bite you - or the people in your dream. Don't hesitate any longer.

source_zh: 冥灯在哀鸣，它快灭了，主人说这是前兆。深渊的怪物们他们来了，你要深入地牢深处去，把虫母杀了，把灯再点亮。快点，再快点。
translation: The dark lamp is whining and is about to go out. The owner says this is a sign. The monsters from the abyss are coming. You have to go deep into the dungeon, kill the insect mother, and light the lamp again. Hurry up, hurry up.

source_zh: 那声音不是你听见的，是它在你脑子里。耳鸣谷的灵音失控了。你得找出源头，把那些发音的东西干掉，别让它再念你的名字。
translation: That voice is not what you hear, it is in your head. The spiritual sound in Tinnitus Valley is out of control. You have to find the source, get rid of those pronunciation things, and stop them from pronouncing your name.

source_zh: 我亲眼看见一人被它咬断魂链，他的身体还在说话，魂却变成了齿尖的火花。别被咬，咬了就碎了。你得快。
translation: I saw with my own eyes a man's soul chain being bitten off by it. His body was still talking, but his soul turned into sparks on the tips of its teeth. Don't get bitten, it will break into pieces. You have to be quick.

source_zh: 那个缝裂了，一只魂穿了过来，接着十只、百只。他们不属于我们这一界，一旦进来，他们就不走了。你得让他们在缝里断掉。
translation: The seam cracked, and one soul passed through, followed by ten, then a hundred. They don't belong to our world, and once they come in, they won't leave. You have to make them snap at the seams.

source_zh: 那些签过又违背的契印碎片聚起来了，它们长出了牙。你得去收拾烂摊子，别让它们再啃下一块族人的魂核。
translation: The fragments of the deed signed and broken gathered together, and they grew teeth. You have to clean up the mess and don't let them take another piece of the clan's soul core.

source_zh: [color=#41f6ff]莫德拉斯[/color]不是鬼，是残念堆积出来的火球。他们死过一次，又死了一次，却仍在痛。你得去[color=#41f6ff]林宝城地牢[/color]帮他们安静下来——用爆破的方式。
translation: [color=#41f6ff]Moderas[/color]It's not a ghost, it's a fireball caused by the accumulation of residual thoughts. They died once and again, but they still hurt. you have to go[color=#41f6ff]Linbaocheng Dungeon[/color]Help them quiet down - by blasting.

translation: [color=#41f6ff]Vandalizer[/color]is the most annoying, they live forever and live forever. You want to do this job? Don't let them resurrect faster than you can kill them.

source_zh: 卑誓者曾是族人，现在是毒瘤。他们把灵魂卖给了外面的东西。你得做审判官，用他们的誓刃封他们的口。
translation: The Oathbreakers were once a member of the tribe, now they are a cancer. They sold their souls to something outside. You must be the judge and seal their mouths with their sworn blades.

source_zh: [color=#41f6ff]巴托里地牢地下3层[/color]里有喘气声，像是在你耳边。那不是风，是林喉。你不杀它，它就咬你——或者你梦里的族人。别再犹豫。
translation: [color=#41f6ff]Bathory Dungeon underground level 3[/color]There is a gasping sound, as if it is in your ear. That wasn't the wind, it was Lin Hou. If you don't kill it, it will bite you - or the people in your dream. Don't hesitate any longer.

source_zh: 你有没有感觉地在鼓动？它不是活的，是病的。去把那些吸魂的根一根一根砍下来，再烧掉那片林。
translation: Do you feel the ground agitating? It is not alive, it is sick. Go cut down those soul-sucking roots one by one, and then burn the forest.

source_zh: 冥灯在哀鸣，它快灭了，主人说这是前兆。深渊的怪物们他们来了，你要深入地牢深处去，把虫母杀了，把灯再点亮。快点，再快点。
translation: The dark lamp is whining and is about to go out. The owner says this is a sign. The monsters from the abyss are coming. You have to go deep into the dungeon, kill the insect mother, and light the lamp again. Hurry up, hurry up.

source_zh: “獠骨荒野”出现“恶齿魂兽”，它们由死前不愿咽气的灵骸组成，具极高咬合与侵蚀力。请猎杀7只恶齿体，并击碎其颅核。
translation: "Evil-toothed Soul Beasts" appear in the "Bone Wilderness". They are composed of spiritual remains that do not want to die before dying, and have extremely high biting and corrosive power. Please hunt down 7 evil tooth bodies and crush their skull cores.

source_zh: 它说你软弱，说你失败，说你连砍一刀都抖。它说的都是真的，除非你去让它闭嘴。别和它吵，用刀。
translation: It says you are weak, that you are a failure, that you are afraid of even cutting with a knife. Everything it says is true unless you shut it up. Don't argue with it, use a knife.

source_zh: 那声音不是你听见的，是它在你脑子里。耳鸣谷的灵音失控了。你得找出源头，把那些发音的东西干掉，别让它再念你的名字。
translation: That voice is not what you hear, it is in your head. The spiritual sound in Tinnitus Valley is out of control. You have to find the source, get rid of those pronunciation things, and stop them from pronouncing your name.

source_zh: 他们喊‘自由’，喊‘救赎’，但他们的魂语是毒。听多了你会疯。别对话，直接下手，把舌头和魂一起拔掉。
translation: They shout ‘freedom’ and ‘salvation’, but their soul language is poison. Listen to it too much and you'll go crazy. Don't talk, just go ahead and pluck out the tongue and soul together.

source_zh: 那些签过又违背的契印碎片聚起来了，它们长出了牙。你得去收拾烂摊子，别让它们再啃下一块族人的灵魂。
translation: The fragments of the deed signed and broken gathered together, and they grew teeth. You have to clean up the mess before they take another piece of your tribe's soul.

source_zh: 骨头热了、裂了、叫了？那不是老化，是虫子在啃你的骨魂。去，把虫母从骨池捞出来活烧。
translation: Are the bones hot, cracked, or screaming? That's not aging, it's bugs eating your bones and soul. Go, fish the mother worm out of the bone pool and burn it alive.

source_zh: 死人没完没了地诅咒，你只要听进去一个字，你就跟他一样死。一刀封喉，后别回头。
translation: The dead curse endlessly. If you hear a word, you will die like him. Seal your throat with one knife and don't look back.

translation: The dark lamp is whining and is about to go out. The owner says this is a sign. The monsters from the abyss are coming. You have to go deep into the dungeon, kill the insect mother, and light the lamp again. Hurry up, hurry up.

source_zh: 骨头热了、裂了、叫了？那不是老化，是虫子在啃你的骨魂。去，把虫母从骨池捞出来活烧。
translation: Are the bones hot, cracked, or screaming? That's not aging, it's bugs eating your bones and soul. Go, fish the mother worm out of the bone pool and burn it alive.

source_zh: 他们喊‘自由’，喊‘救赎’，但他们的魂语是毒。听多了你会疯。别对话，直接下手，把舌头和魂一起拔掉。
translation: They shout ‘freedom’ and ‘salvation’, but their soul language is poison. Listen to it too much and you'll go crazy. Don't talk, just go ahead and pluck out the tongue and soul together.

source_zh: 死人没完没了地诅咒，你只要听进去一个字，你就跟他一样死。一刀封喉，后别回头。
translation: The dead curse endlessly. If you hear a word, you will die like him. Seal your throat with one knife and don't look back.

source_zh: 档案室被残魂侵染，怨魂书记徘徊其间，不断撕毁冥界记载，妄图破坏鬼族传承。你需前往[color=#41f6ff]IK办公室[/color]击杀它们，让一切重新归于肃静。
translation: The archives room was infected by the remnant souls, and the resentful spirit secretary lingered there, constantly tearing up the records of the underworld in an attempt to destroy the Vampires's inheritance. You need to go to[color=#41f6ff]IK Office[/color]Kill them and let everything return to silence.

source_zh: 成片的怪物们潜伏在[color=#41f6ff]IK办公室[/color]，口吐混乱咒文，使在场者精神错乱。你需清理这些鬼族的劣等亡魂，切断其亵渎言语。
translation: Films of monsters lurk[color=#41f6ff]IK Office[/color], spitting chaotic spells, making those present insane. You need to clean up the inferior souls of these ghosts and cut off their blasphemous words.

source_zh: [color=#41f6ff]IK办公室[/color]的账册被妖灵侵蚀，血契的文字不断翻涌，吞噬鬼族资源。你需前往此地进行清扫工作，让一切重新归于冥契之下。
translation: [color=#41f6ff]IK Office[/color]'s account book was eroded by demon spirits, and the words of the blood contract continued to surge, swallowing up the resources of the Vampires. You need to go here to clean up and bring everything back under the contract.

source_zh: 孽魔从破碎药瓶中涌出，散发腐尸气息，侵蚀[color=#41f6ff]IK试验室[/color]空气。必须尽快消灭，防止瘴气扩散。
translation: Evil spirits emerged from the broken medicine bottle, exuding the smell of rotten corpses and corroding[color=#41f6ff]IK laboratory[/color]Air. It must be eliminated as soon as possible to prevent the miasma from spreading.

source_zh: 疫尸在[color=#41f6ff]IK试验室[/color]中徘徊，传播恶性疫病。必须全部消灭，否则整个[color=#41f6ff]IK试验室[/color]将陷入瘟潮。
translation: The plague corpse is here[color=#41f6ff]IK laboratory[/color]wanders around and spreads vicious diseases. All must be eliminated, otherwise the entire[color=#41f6ff]IK laboratory[/color]will fall into the plague.

source_zh: 尸体与试剂融合，形成爆尸元素，爆炸波动危及[color=#41f6ff]IK试验室[/color]。必须清理干净。
translation: The corpse merges with the reagent to form an explosive element, and the explosion wave threatens[color=#41f6ff]IK laboratory[/color]. Must be cleaned up.

source_zh: 鬼徒挣脱锁链，逃离[color=#41f6ff]IK试验室地下1层[/color]，企图反噬鬼族。必须杀尽，重建囚笼秩序。
translation: The ghost breaks free from the chains and escapes[color=#41f6ff]IK laboratory basement 1st floor[/color], trying to counterattack the Vampires. They must be killed and order in the cage restored.

source_zh: 黑井腐化，尸灵徘徊在[color=#41f6ff]IK试验室地下1层[/color]的绿色毒液中。若不肃清，地下将变为污渊。
translation: The black well is corrupted, and corpse spirits are lingering[color=#41f6ff]IK laboratory basement 1st floor[/color]. If it is not cleaned up, the underground will become a filthy abyss.

source_zh: 那些残兽们控制[color=#41f6ff]IK试验室地下1层[/color]，试图篡改并夺取冥界信息。必须消灭它们，不要让主人心烦。
translation: Those remnant beasts control[color=#41f6ff]IK laboratory basement 1st floor[/color], trying to tamper with and seize information from the underworld. They must be eliminated without upsetting the owner.

source_zh: 黑暗的气息弥漫在你的灵魂之中，魔能在血脉中悸动，但这股力量尚未完全觉醒。你并非天生的弱者，但若想在魔族的世界中生存，必须学会掌控黑暗，并证明你的价值。索拉是这片领域的指引者，她掌握着魔族成长的秘密。你的第一步，便是去她那里聆听关于魔族生存法则的教诲。或许她会告诉你如何汲取黑暗能量，或许她会考验你的意志，但无论如何，你必须踏上这条注定充满鲜血与力量的道路。记住，在魔族的世界里，唯有强者才能被承认，而你，将迈出成为强者的第一步。
translation: The aura of darkness permeates your soul, and magic throbs in your blood, but this power has not yet fully awakened. You are not born weak, but if you want to survive in the world of Ousters, you must learn to master the darkness and prove your worth. Sora is the leader of this realm, and she holds the secrets of the growth of the Ousters. Your first step is to go to her and listen to her teachings on the rules of survival of the Ousters. Maybe she will tell you how to absorb dark energy, maybe she will test your will, but no matter what, you must embark on this road destined to be full of blood and power. Remember, in the world of Ousters, only the strong can be recognized, and you will take the first step to become a strong one.

source_zh: 臂环是非常方便的装备，你可以把你在战斗中所需要用到的常用道具放到你的腰带中。
translation: armband is a very convenient equipment. You can put the common props you need in battle into your belt.

source_zh: 你可知幽渊是通神之径？那幽噬行者啃咬的不只是魂体，是仪轨的信标。去杀它们，别让精灵们以为我们献上的是一团废雾。
translation: Did you know that Youyuan is the path to the gods? What the Ghost Devourer gnawed was not just the soul, but also the beacon of the ritual. Go kill them, don't let the elves think that what we offer is a waste of fog.

source_zh: 侍灵列阵如潮，缺一首便乱。去，把它们的首级摆回，让阵形再度如海涌动。
translation: The array of servant spirits is like a tide. If one is missing, there will be chaos. Go, put their heads back, and let the formation surge like the sea again.

source_zh: 你知仪轨为何乱？幽噬已啃掉它的目光。你去把它们杀净，让神继续看我们。
translation: Do you know why rituals are chaotic? Nether Bite has eaten away its gaze. You go and kill them all and let God continue to see us.

source_zh: 誓约只会毁灭。他们妄图逆用神名，再启崩律。你若迟疑，他就让誓火先烧你骨。
translation: The oath will only destroy. They tried to use God's name in vain, and then started to collapse the law. If you hesitate, he will let the oath fire burn your bones first.

source_zh: 水之精灵沉睡千年，不容被任何事物唤醒。你去截断那股杂乱声，让[color=#41f6ff]维多斯[/color]们永远地闭上嘴，让它知道我们依旧守律。
translation: The water spirit has been sleeping for thousands of years and cannot be awakened by anything. You go and cut off that clutter, let[color=#41f6ff]Widows[/color]Let us shut our mouths forever and let it know that we still abide by the law.

source_zh: 它的影像被雾偷走了，你去剖开雾的腹，把偷影的怪全杀了。记住，精灵们的影不能被任何人握在手中。
translation: Its image was stolen by the fog. Go and cut open the belly of the fog and kill all the monsters that stole the image. Remember, the shadows of the elves cannot be held in anyone's hands.

source_zh: 她让梦如潮，你就要做潮的堤。斩了那些邪神渊徒的头，把梦口用他们的颅骨堵上。
translation: She makes dreams like tides, so you have to be the embankment of the tides. Cut off the heads of those Evil God Abyss disciples and block the Meng Mouth with their skulls.

source_zh: 石碑是它的经卷，不容篡改。你去，将那些岩徒的骨头刻成反面经，让他们永远跪在碑前。
translation: The stone tablet is its scripture and cannot be tampered with. You go and carve the bones of those rock disciples into sutras and let them kneel in front of the monument forever.

source_zh: 火祭不能断，断了就是对神的亵渎。你去，把这些逆徒连骨头都烧成灰。
translation: The fire sacrifice cannot be interrupted, as to do so would be blasphemy against God. Go ahead and burn these rebels to ashes, right down to their bones.

source_zh: 尤瑞森的灵脉是祭坛的血河，若被吸干，整个族域将陷入无声的死境。你去，粉碎那些峡鬼的魂器，把流失的灵血重新引回它的心脏。
translation: Urizen's spiritual vein is the blood river of the altar. If it is sucked dry, the entire clan will fall into a silent death. You go, crush the Horcruxes of those gorge ghosts, and redirect the lost spiritual blood back to its heart.

source_zh: 你可知幽渊是通神之径？那幽噬行者啃咬的不只是魂体，是仪轨的信标。去杀它们，别让精灵们以为我们献上的是一团废雾。
translation: Did you know that Youyuan is the path to the gods? What the Ghost Devourer gnawed was not just the soul, but also the beacon of the ritual. Go kill them, don't let the elves think that what we offer is a waste of fog.

source_zh: “蛾”的翅膀不配承载神焰，若让它们羽化，焰灾将吞没祭域。你去剥下它们的“翅膀”，把蛹丢入火井，让精灵的焰在烈烧中得以净化。
translation: The wings of "moths" are not worthy of carrying divine flames. If they are allowed to become feathers, the flame disaster will engulf the sacrificial domain. You peel off their "wings" and throw the pupae into the fire well, so that the elves' flames can be purified in the burning.

source_zh: 石链锁魂，断则祭律倾覆。你去斩裂那兽的颅骨，用它的脊骨炼成新链，将逃逸的魂重新拴回牢中。
translation: The stone chain locks the soul, and if it is broken, the ritual law will be overturned. You go and cleave the skull of the beast, forge new chains from its spine, and tie the escaped soul back to its prison.

source_zh: 火脉是精灵与族人的契约之血，断之者等于掐死族心。你去将这些孽徒烧成灰烬，让火焰再次贯通祭坛的每一道纹路。
translation: The fire vein is the blood of the contract between the elves and the tribe. To cut it off is to strangle the heart of the tribe. You go and burn these villains to ashes, and let the flames penetrate every line of the altar again.

source_zh: 影息需要静，而裂吼是亵渎。你去割掉它们的喉，把喉骨扔进影井，让黑暗重新安静下来。
translation: Shadow Breath requires silence, but cracking roar is blasphemy. You cut their throats, throw the throat bones into the shadow well, and let the darkness quiet down again.

source_zh: 地脉是神的经脉，断则全域死寂。你去杀掉石徒，把断裂的脉重新接回祭坛，让律声再起。
translation: The earth veins are the meridians of the gods. If they are broken, the whole area will be dead. You go and kill the stone disciples, reconnect the broken veins to the altar, and let the sound of the rhythm rise again.

source_zh: 祭碑是精灵的法令，被碎则律崩。去，杀掉那些兽，用它们的血来补碑，让律重新刻进石中。
translation: The memorial tablet is the decree of the elves. If it is broken, the law will collapse. Go, kill those beasts, use their blood to repair the monument, and let the law be carved into the stone again.

translation: The underworld fire burns, and the technique of black sacrifice will destroy the foundation. you have to go[color=#41f6ff]Basement 2 of Eisen Dungeon[/color]Destroy them and guard the divine fire of the underworld.

translation: The master's oracle has come down, and the shadows cannot breed monsters. With blood as our nourishment, we go[color=#41f6ff]Basement 2 of Eisen Dungeon[/color]Cut away the shadows.

The drum of plague is beating, and the plague is spreading. You must become the purifying blade that will[color=#41f6ff]Rom Dungeon Basement 2[/color]'s Plague Corpse Annihilation.

translation: The bell rings in the clan leader’s ears, which is the cry of the dead. Followers of God, cut off the chains[color=#41f6ff]IK Office[/color], let its wail disappear.

source_zh: 虚伪的圣言无法动摇我们的意志，但它们污染心智。勇者，斩杀这些在[color=#41f6ff]IK办公室[/color]中怪物，让它们从此闭嘴！
translation: False words cannot shake our will, but they pollute the mind. Brave man, kill these[color=#41f6ff]IK Office[/color]monsters, shut them up from now on!

Underground[color=#41f6ff]IK laboratory[/color]is being spurned by the gods. Go quickly, the flame elves are protecting you, you will turn into flames and burn away your false life.

[color=#41f6ff]IK laboratory basement 1st floor[/color]have seriously affected the rest of the earth elves, annihilate them, quickly!

translation: In this vast and lush land, it is definitely not enough to just rely on your feet to move. You need to know how to summon your mounts, which can help you reach your destination faster.

translation: Low-level equipment cannot adapt to more difficult battles in the future. You need to understand how to further upgrade your equipment level.

translation: Equipment can be enchanted with different attributes. These attributes will play unexpected roles when you fight against various enemies. Learn how to bless your weapons.

translation: Without an organization, you will be isolated and helpless. Join or start your own guild to make your guild the most powerful existence on this continent.

source_zh: 你，是明理人。是啊，被他们击败得人不是一两个啊。长老级的吸血鬼们划定自己的界限后，一有机会就会互相吃掉对方。好不容易平静下来，他们又开始活动起来了。他们使用一颗含有魔力的宝石控制自己的力量。每个大师都带有这种宝石的项链，为了争夺这个东西他们都红着眼睛到处乱跑。
translation: You are a sensible person. Yes, not just one or two people were defeated by them. After the elder vampires have established their own boundaries, they will eat each other whenever they get the chance. After finally calming down, they began to move again. They control their powers using a magical gem. Every master has a necklace with this gemstone, and they are all running around with red eyes in order to fight for it.
I would like to know the price of the necklace.
Got it, I have to say goodbye.

source_zh: 呵呵，如果你有那个项链，我以高价物品交换。当然根据项链带有挂饰还是珠宝，价格也不同。怎么样？
translation: Haha, if you have that necklace, I will exchange it for a high-priced item. Of course, the prices vary depending on whether the necklace has pendants or jewelry. How about it?

source_zh: 用带有的挂饰与道具交换。
translation: Use the attached ornaments and props to exchange.

source_zh: 用带有的珠宝与物品交换。
translation: Use the attached jewelry in exchange for items.

source_zh: 你经常跟吸血鬼交战，一定很累吧。要处处小心，生命比什么都重要。重要的东西全部交给我，你就全神贯注地投入战斗吧。
translation: You must be very tired from fighting vampires all the time. Be careful at all times, life is more important than anything else. Leave all the important things to me, and concentrate on the battle.
I want to buy a safe deposit box.
Can you see what I bring?

source_zh: 哦？来了？现在有点忙，正构思着新的装备呢。不过没关系，有什么能帮你的？
translation: Oh? Coming? I'm a little busy right now, thinking about new equipment. But that's okay. How can I help you?

source_zh: 麻烦您修理我的这些装备，戴维。
我想移动到卡里高地牢（等级战争地带）。
translation: I want to move to Kali High Dungeon (Level War Zone).

source_zh: 我想移动到泰莫利圣地。
translation: I want to move to the Holy Land of Temori.

source_zh: 不，你继续吧，打扰你了，不好意思。
translation: No, go ahead. I'm sorry to bother you.

source_zh: 我可以带你去任何你想去的地方。
translation: I can take you wherever you want to go.
No, I don’t think about it for the time being.
What equipment do you want to repair?

source_zh: 要是受伤了，最好是立马到我这里来。过分相信自己力量而冲动是很容易受伤的，即便是小伤也让我检查一下吧。
translation: If you are injured, it is best to come to me immediately. It is easy to get injured if you believe too much in your own strength and get hurt impulsively. Let me check even if it is a small injury.

source_zh: 我想移动到新手训练地。
translation: I want to move to the novice training area.

source_zh: 我的耳环是不是很漂亮？当然这是仿制品，这里的首饰全部都是珍品。
translation: Are my earrings beautiful? Of course these are imitations and all the jewelry here are treasures.

source_zh: 我想卖掉我的一些物品。
translation: I want to sell some of my items.

source_zh: 克来夫，今天也繁忙啊，那么下次再见。
translation: Clive, you are busy today too, so see you next time.

source_zh: 需要防弹衣、腰带、头盔之类的就跟我说吧。虽然我也不是因为喜欢这个才卖的，反正是任务嘛。
translation: If you need body armor, belts, helmets, etc., just tell me. Although I didn’t sell it because I liked it, it was a mission anyway.

source_zh: 是的，我需要不错的防御道具。
translation: Yes, I need good defensive items.
I am here to sell things.

source_zh: 有时候一些拥有防具和武器的人，反而比别人失败得更快。因为真正的战士是在任何情况下，都可以把周围的一切当作武器使用。这不是说好的战士什么都不用带，只是说他们只要带基本物品就行。那你也来挑一挑吧。
translation: Sometimes some people who have armor and weapons fail faster than others. Because a true warrior can use everything around him as a weapon under any circumstances. This doesn't mean that good soldiers don't need to bring anything, it just means that they only need to bring basic items. Then come and take your pick too.
I want to buy good equipment.

source_zh: 我想卖掉不需要的东西。
translation: I want to sell something I don’t need.

source_zh: 如果有你喜欢的枪械，就在这里填上装备申请书。大概一周内能收到许可，所以最好还是快点，有几个很不错的你自己看一下。
translation: If you have a firearm you like, fill out the equipment application form here. It takes about a week to receive your permit, so it's best to hurry up and there are a few great ones to check out for yourself.

source_zh: 看看有没有称心的枪械。
translation: See if there are any firearms you like.
I have something to do, so I’ll take my leave now.

source_zh: 战斗时只有自己保护自己，没时间磨蹭。也不要顾虑背后，只注意前方，你的背后由你的同伴来守。没自信的话早点结束这种活。
translation: When fighting, you only have to protect yourself, there is no time to waste time. Don't worry about your back, just pay attention to the front. Your back will be guarded by your companions. If you don't have confidence, end this kind of work as soon as possible.

source_zh: 多谢您的提醒，不过我是来买SMG的。
translation: Thank you for the reminder, but I am here to buy SMG.

source_zh: 我想卖掉我的一些物品，苏坦。
translation: I want to sell some of my belongings, Sutan.

source_zh: 想删除你资料里的红线？形式和程序应该知道吧？好。要删除多少？
translation: Want to delete the red lines in your profile? You should know the form and procedure, right? good. How many to delete?

source_zh: 我要捐献10000元，调整倾向值。
translation: I want to donate 10,000 yuan to adjust the propensity value.

source_zh: 我要捐献50000元，调整倾向值。
translation: I want to donate 50,000 yuan to adjust the propensity value.

translation: I came here about the guild.
I would like to receive inspection services.

translation: I have no money, but I also want to donate money. I can help you.

source_zh: 为公会问题而来，具体关于什么事项？
translation: I came here for a guild question, what specifically is it about?

source_zh: 要退出？可以接受请求。但是你要知道，退出公会后不能马上被别的公会所接受。至少要过一周才能再次加入公会。还是要退出吗？
translation: Want to quit? Requests can be accepted. But you have to know that you cannot be accepted by other guilds immediately after you leave the guild. It will be at least a week before you can join the guild again. Still want to quit?

source_zh: 我知道了，但我还是想退出。
translation: I know, but I still want to quit.
Then let me think about it again.

source_zh: 每天都交战肯定很累吧，哪里受伤赶紧找我，我会竭尽全力给你治疗。
translation: It must be tiring to fight every day. If you are injured, come to me immediately and I will do my best to treat you.

source_zh: 辛森，这里受伤了，拜托你。

translation: I want to buy therapeutic medicine.

source_zh: 现在还能挺得住，下次再来。
translation: I can still stand it now, try again next time.

source_zh: 你好？这次有什么能帮你的？有什么修理的东西尽管告诉我吧。
translation: Hello? How can I help you this time? If you need anything repaired, please let me know.

source_zh: 你好？哥丽芬，帮我修理这些吧。
translation: Hello? Griffin, help me fix these.
Yes, I will definitely say thank you next time.
What equipment do you want to repair?

source_zh: 最近吸血鬼们的活动好像更频繁了，不能再放任，你们能不能再加把劲？这里有我在旅行中得到的东西，想瞧瞧吗？
translation: The activities of vampires seem to be more frequent recently. We can no longer let them go. Can you try harder? Here are some things I picked up on my travels, want to take a look?

source_zh: 看看，有没有我需要的东西呢？
translation: Take a look, is there anything I need?

source_zh: 给你看看这段时间我收集的东西。
translation: Let me show you what I collected during this time.

source_zh: 光坐着不行动，不是解决问题的方法，我会替你准备最好的战斗装备，你们来对付吸血鬼吧！
translation: Just sitting and not taking action is not the way to solve the problem. I will prepare the best combat equipment for you. Come and deal with the vampires!

source_zh: 知道了，尼古拉。那么，最好的装备呢？
translation: Got it, Nikolai. So, what about the best gear?
I want to sell my equipment.
I have to take my leave.

source_zh: 外面正在跟吸血鬼战斗吧？需要首饰的话就跟我说，尽量为你准备。
translation: Are there vampires fighting outside? If you need jewelry, just tell me and I will try my best to prepare it for you.

source_zh: 叶布基尼，能让我看看新进的首饰吗？
translation: Yebukini, can you show me the new jewelry?
I want to sell these things, what do you think?
I'm here to apply for marriage.

source_zh: 这就告辞了，辛苦了，叶布基尼。
translation: Goodbye now, thank you for your hard work, Yebukini.

source_zh: 爱人的一生中是很重要的。有能终生为伴的人是幸福的事情。有时错误的选择会给双方造成很大的伤害。为了自己，为了你爱的人请慎重选择。
translation: Love is very important in life. It is a blessing to have someone who can be your companion for life. Sometimes the wrong choice can cause great harm to both parties. Please choose carefully for yourself and the people you love.

source_zh: 我有喜欢的人了，我想登记结婚。
translation: I have someone I like and I want to register for marriage.

source_zh: 我忘了我爱人的名字，能告诉我吗？
translation: I forgot my lover's name, can you tell me?
I want to trouble you with something else.

source_zh: 你了解吸血鬼吗？当然你还年轻，对他们会不大了解。虽然用刀枪跟他们战斗很重要，但是从根本上了解他们的不死本质也十分重要。他们种族是不死的。要灭绝他们，嗯，啊，对不起。阅读这里的书籍可以让你知道吸血鬼们的一些事情。
translation: Do you know about vampires? Of course you are still young and don't know much about them. While it's important to fight them with swords and guns, it's also important to understand their fundamental undead nature. Their race is immortal. To exterminate them, um, ah, sorry. Reading the books here will teach you something about vampires.

source_zh: 请问你是什么人，对吸血鬼这么了解？
translation: Who are you to know so much about vampires?
Thank you, see you next time!

source_zh: 我没有自我介绍过吗？哦！对不起，就叫我卡因吧。好了，我要继续去研究了。
translation: Haven't I introduced myself? oh! Sorry, just call me Cain. Okay, I'm going to continue my research.
Thank you, see you next time!

source_zh: 你的记录中若有红线。捐钱作为E.V.E的活动基金吧，我们会当作没有看到那些红线。不过金额会随你的红线多寡而异。想捐赠吗？
translation: If there are red lines in your record. Donate money to E.V.E's activity fund, and we will pretend we don't see those red lines. However, the amount will vary depending on the size of your red line. Want to donate?

source_zh: 我没钱，但我也想捐钱，有劳你们。
translation: I have no money, but I also want to donate money. I can help you.

source_zh: 挑选饰品并非只看金光闪闪的外表，真正重要的是要戴上适合自己的属性才能发挥真正的效果。迫切想要提高自己力量的话，这些东西会有帮助。
translation: Choosing jewelry is not just about the shiny appearance. What is really important is to wear it with attributes that suit you to achieve the real effect. If you are desperate to improve your strength, these things will help.
Deserter, I want to buy something.

source_zh: 这些东西我能不能卖呢？
我要补充体力，参加战斗。
translation: I want to replenish my strength and join the battle.
I want to buy consumable tools.
I want to initialize class skills.

translation: If you need any weapons, just ask, I can get you anything. Why do you come to me?
I want to sell my props.
I want to join the war.

source_zh: 你好，希望你今天也平安，你来找我有什么事吗？
translation: Hello, I hope you are safe today. Do you have any business with me?
I want to buy a safe deposit box.
I want to see my safe.
I want to go to Pelona.
I want to change the tax rate of the city.

Designates the resurrection location outside the city.

translation: You are at peace today, right? Otherwise, my fist will not let you go. What's the matter with you?

translation: I want to sell tools, do you want to buy them?

translation: I need to replenish my physical strength before joining the battle.
I want to sell my tools.

Designates the resurrection location outside the city.

translation: Provide information in a timely manner. Do you have anything to do with me?
I want to buy a safe deposit box.
I want to see my safe.
I want to join the war.
I want to change the tax rate of the city.

source_zh: 攻城战是一个种族里团队的竞争，是互相争取城池所有权为目的，你来的目的是什么？
translation: Siege warfare is a competition between teams within a race. The purpose is to fight for the ownership of the city. What is the purpose of your coming?

source_zh: 为了占领城池，我想申请攻城战。
translation: In order to occupy the city, I want to apply for siege warfare.

source_zh: 为了帮助守护城池，我想申请攻城战。
translation: In order to help protect the city, I would like to apply for siege warfare.

source_zh: 想查看申请参战守城的公会。
translation: I want to check the guilds that have applied to participate in the battle to defend the city.

source_zh: 我想浏览等待战争的表格。
translation: I would like to view the waiting for war table.
I want to join the war.

source_zh: 欢迎，各个盟主都想要的最好的东西都在这里。好好看看，这里有合你身的衣物，想看吗？
translation: Welcome, the best things that every alliance leader wants are here. Take a good look, there are clothes here that suit you. Do you want to see them?
I want to sell the monster's head.
Come again next time and wish you good business.

source_zh: 如果你要用剑，盾牌是必不可少的，我可以帮你出售一些道具。
translation: If you want to use a sword, a shield is essential. I can help you sell some props.

source_zh: 我也需要一个盾牌，你能推荐一个好的吗？
translation: I also need a shield, can you recommend a good one?

source_zh: 我想卖掉这些，您觉得怎么样？
translation: I want to sell these, what do you think?

source_zh: 你能为我的武器镀银吗？
translation: Can you silver plate my weapon?

source_zh: 我还不需要盾牌，谢谢你。
translation: I don't need a shield yet, thank you.

source_zh: 将武器（刀、剑、十字架、权杖）进行镀银后可以增加攻击伤害（枪类武器通过银子弹现实镀银效果），同时对异族有减少最大生命值上限的效果。
translation: Silver-plating weapons (knives, swords, crosses, scepters) can increase attack damage (gun weapons can realize the silver-plating effect through silver bullets), and at the same time, it has the effect of reducing the maximum health limit for aliens.

source_zh: 到这种危险的地方，要注意安全。如果是我的话，我会立刻离开，你找我有什么事吗？
translation: When you go to such a dangerous place, you must pay attention to safety. If it were me, I would leave immediately. What do you want from me?

translation: If there is any damage, please help me repair it.

wants to buy healing potions and ammunition.

translation: How did you get here? If there is anything I can do to help you, please just say it and I will do my best.

source_zh: 战斗中受到吸血鬼的攻击，请给我治疗吧。
translation: I was attacked by a vampire during the battle, please heal me.

wants to buy healing potions and ammunition.

source_zh: 我是花园的水晶球，你不想失败在塔内，你就听从我的指令，你想我帮你做什么呢？
translation: I am the crystal ball in the garden. If you don’t want to fail in the tower, just follow my instructions. What do you want me to do for you?

source_zh: 99个远古种子兑换1个伊布石(升级项链套)。
translation: 99 ancient seeds can be exchanged for 1 Ibrahimite (upgraded necklace set).

source_zh: 30个远古十字架兑换1个项链套(随机1属性)。
translation: Exchange 30 ancient crosses for 1 necklace set (random 1 attribute).

source_zh: 消费5亿游戏币解除被绑定的项链套（放置背包左上角）。
translation: Spend 500 million game coins to unlock the bound necklace set (place it in the upper left corner of the backpack).

source_zh: 移动到下一层(暂未开放)。
translation: Move to the next floor (not yet open).

source_zh: 大地的守护者啊，感谢您教会我崇高的精神。请让我以纯净的思绪和纯真的心灵敬仰您。大地请赐予我力量，让我能过上充满真理的新生活。听说您的精灵名为“希奥拉姆”，请问您找我有什么事情吗？
translation: Guardian of the earth, thank you for teaching me the noble spirit. Please allow me to admire you with pure thoughts and pure heart. Earth please give me the strength to live a new life filled with truth. I heard that your elf's name is "Xiolam". Do you have anything to do with me?
I want to repair my tool.

source_zh: 我是为关于公会的事情来的。
translation: I came here about the guild.

source_zh: 为了利用大地精灵之角，签订合同。
translation: Sign a contract in order to use the Earth Elf's Horn.

source_zh: 我想借用血的圣书标志。
translation: I want to borrow the holy book symbol of blood.
I want to move to Pelona.
Then I will take my leave.

source_zh: 为公会问题而来，具体关于什么事项？
translation: I came here for a guild question, what specifically is it about?
I'm here to create a guild.

source_zh: 想看一下正在召人的公会。
translation: I want to see the guild that is recruiting people.

source_zh: 您要退出公会？如果您退出的话，不能马上再加入其他公会了，至少要过一周的时间才能获得再次加入其他公会的权利，您确定您要退出吗？
translation: Do you want to quit the guild? If you quit, you will not be able to join other guilds immediately. It will take at least a week before you can get the right to join other guilds again. Are you sure you want to quit?

source_zh: 我知道了，但我还是想退出。
translation: I know, but I still want to quit.
Then let me think about it again.

source_zh: 自由决斗地带有允许同种族间决斗的“奥达尼亚”和不限种族可以享受自由决斗的“巴纳特尔”两种选择。
translation: The free duel zone has two options: "Odania", which allows duels between the same race, and "Banatl", which allows free duels regardless of race.
I want to go to Banater.

source_zh: 跟大地精灵之角签订合同的话，在大地政令的地点可以自由自在的移动。利用的时候当然需要付出代价。管理这里的大地妖精们特别贪婪。确定要跟大地精灵之角签合同吗？
translation: If you sign a contract with the Land Elf's Corner, you can move freely to the location of the Land Decree. Of course there is a price to pay when taking advantage. The earth elves who manage this place are particularly greedy. Are you sure you want to sign a contract with Land Elf Horn?

source_zh: 银制 SMG 专用子弹-250
利用腕力和沉重的刀刃给予重创的技术。是刀系列中最基础的技术。使用时会有武器杀伤力的奖励。
translation: A technique that uses wrist strength and a heavy blade to inflict heavy damage. It is the most basic technology in the knife series. There will be a bonus to weapon lethality when used.

source_zh: 近程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Short-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 是一种挥刀的技术其形状如同上升的漩涡故而得来的名字。武器的基本杀伤力会得到奖励。
translation: is a technique of wielding a sword. Its shape is like a rising whirlpool, hence the name. The weapon's base lethality is rewarded.

source_zh: 近程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Short-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 长时间训练刀法的人们在战斗时，能够很自然地把全部精力投入到武器上。作为一种消极技术，拿着刀的时候总是很实用。
translation: People who have trained in sword skills for a long time can naturally devote all their energy to the weapon when fighting. As a passive technique, it is always useful when holding a knife.

source_zh: 被动技能，增加自身命中率，领域等级影响技能效果。
translation: Passive skill, increases own hit rate, domain level affects skill effect.

source_zh: 快速挥刀产生残像使对方混乱的技术。因敌人不知道你要攻击的部位所以命中的几率会很高。此技术持续期间有命中率的奖励。
translation: A technique for quickly swinging a sword to create an afterimage that confuses the opponent. Since the enemy doesn't know where you are going to attack, the chance of hitting is very high. There is a hit rate bonus during the duration of this technique.

source_zh: 增益技能，增加自身命中率百分比，技能等级影响技能效果。
translation: Gain skills, increase your own hit rate percentage, skill level affects skill effects.

source_zh: 东洋武士们一直以来很重视信心。事实上用长久的时间来修炼而成的精神力往往会给肉体带来惊人的变化。经过极度痛苦而修炼出来的精神力可以给对抗强敌的武士们超越界限的强大的体力。
translation: Oriental samurai have always valued confidence. In fact, the mental power cultivated over a long period of time often brings about amazing changes to the physical body. The mental power cultivated through extreme pain can give warriors strong physical strength beyond their limits to fight against powerful enemies.

source_zh: 被动技能，增加自身生命力百分比。
translation: Passive skill, increases the percentage of own vitality.

source_zh: 从右上到左下，从左到右，从右下到左上，斩一次的技术。也叫做“三角波”的三角形攻击技术。可得到武器杀伤力的奖励。
translation: A technique of cutting once from the upper right to the lower left, from the left to the right, from the lower right to the upper left. A triangle attack technique also called "triangle wave". Receive bonuses for weapon lethality.

source_zh: 近程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Short-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 长时间修炼刀法的人们在用刀战斗时，可以更好的集中自己的精力，从而更好的保护自己。这个技能是被动技能，拿着刀时提升自己的防御力。
translation: People who have practiced sword skills for a long time can better concentrate their energy when fighting with swords, thereby better protecting themselves. This skill is a passive skill that increases your defense when holding a knife.

source_zh: 被动技能，增加自身回避率，领域等级影响技能效果。
translation: Passive skill, increases self-avoidance rate, domain level affects skill effect.

source_zh: 完全不顾防御而用只以攻击为主的一击必杀技术给对方猛烈而凶悍的进攻的技术。可得到武器杀伤力的奖励。
translation: A technique that completely ignores defense and uses a one-hit kill technique that focuses only on attack to give the opponent a fierce and ferocious attack. Receive bonuses for weapon lethality.

source_zh: 近程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Short-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 利用快捷的步伐瞬间缩短与敌人的距离,并进行攻击的技术。追踪1~6步前的，正在逃跑的敌人，或者快速接近敌人时使用的技术。
translation: A technique that uses quick steps to instantly shorten the distance from the enemy and attack. A technique used to track the fleeing enemy 1 to 6 steps ahead, or to quickly approach the enemy.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，可快速移动到目标身边。
translation: Long-range single-target attack skill, which can quickly move to the target.

source_zh: 作为一种激发体能潜力的技术能在一段时间内提高超越自身体能极限的能力。体能达到极限时能力值得上升幅度会急速飙升。在此技术持续期间力量和敏捷会上升。
translation: , as a technology that stimulates physical potential, can improve the ability to exceed one's physical limits over a period of time. When your physical fitness reaches its limit, your ability value will increase rapidly. Strength and agility increase while this technique lasts.

source_zh: 增益技能，增加自身力量和敏捷,技能等级和自身剩余生命力影响增益效果。
translation: Gain skills, increase own strength and agility, skill level and own remaining vitality affect the gain effect.

source_zh: 乱砍对方躯体的技术。因刀的重影如同旋风一般而起的名称。可得到武器的基本杀伤力的奖励。
translation: The technique of slashing the opponent's body randomly. The name comes from the fact that the double image of the sword is like a whirlwind. Can be rewarded with the basic lethality of the weapon.

source_zh: 近程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Short-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 旋转两圈后用圆心力和爆发力给予一次强力打击的技术，其力量可以斩断大象的腰。使用时得到武器杀伤力的奖励。
translation: is a technique that uses the force of the center of the circle and explosive power to deliver a powerful blow after two revolutions. Its power can cut off the waist of an elephant. Gain a bonus to the weapon's lethality when used.

source_zh: 近程群体3×3范围攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Short-range group 3×3 range attack skill, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 利用刀给敌人发射多次强烈的光，使敌人受到连续攻击的魔法。受到此攻击的吸血鬼们会像被强烈的太阳光照一般痛苦不堪。
translation: A magic that uses a knife to emit multiple strong lights to the enemy, causing the enemy to be attacked continuously. Vampires affected by this attack will suffer as much pain as if they were exposed to strong sunlight.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote single target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 最大限度地利用自身剩余能量攻击对方的持续性技术。在攻击持续的期间可得到5%~10%杀伤力的奖励。
translation: A continuous technique that maximizes the use of one's own remaining energy to attack the opponent. While the attack continues, you can get a bonus of 5%~10% of the lethality.

source_zh: 增益技能，增加自身伤害值，力量和技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: Gain skills, increase your own damage value, strength and skill level affect the gain effect.

source_zh: 能将水中明月一刀劈开的快刀，速度惊人。其锋利的刀刃和极快的速度可以在瞬间消灭很多敌人。刀那庄重和快速的使用技巧把许许多多的敌人逼向了死亡。
translation: A sharp knife that can split the bright moon in the water with a single strike, with amazing speed. Its sharp blade and extremely fast speed can destroy many enemies in an instant. The majesty and swiftness of the sword's use drove many enemies to their deaths.

source_zh: 近程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Short-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 在东洋的一本书中写到“长久以来修炼刀法的人可具备劈开大地的技术”。这个技能就是以此书为基础发展而来的。此技术可以劈开地面使人感到地震般的震动，穿透射程以内一条直线上的所有事物并给予破坏。
translation: It is written in a Japanese book that "those who have practiced swordsmanship for a long time can have the skills to split the earth." This skill was developed based on this book. This technique can split the ground and cause earthquake-like vibrations, penetrating and damaging everything in a straight line within range.

source_zh: 远程群体线性6格范围攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Long-range group linear 6-block range attack skill, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 有红色火焰燃烧的这种魔法虽然体力消耗大，但具有能给敌人致命一击的强大威力。在一定时间内释放出体内所有热量变成光战士并给眼前的敌人致命打击。
translation: This magic with red flames consumes a lot of physical strength, but it has powerful power that can deliver a fatal blow to the enemy. Release all the heat in the body within a certain period of time to become a light warrior and deliver a fatal blow to the enemy in front of you.

source_zh: 增益技能，增加自身伤害值百分比、命中率百分比，降低回避率百分比、防御率百分比，力量和技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: buff skill, increases the percentage of self-damage and hit rate, reduces the percentage of avoidance rate and defense rate, and strength and skill level affect the gain effect.

source_zh: 修炼刀术的武人若把精神力量赋予刀中就能使出特别绚丽的刀术。这种由刀射出的绚烂的刀气可以迷惑对方的视线，而且能给对方很大伤害。
translation: If a warrior who practices swordsmanship puts spiritual power into the sword, he can perform particularly brilliant swordsmanship. This gorgeous sword energy shot from the sword can confuse the opponent's sight and cause great damage to the opponent.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote single target attack skill, skill level affects skill damage.

source_zh: 东洋武术中，有一种可引起旋风的武术。隐居并长期修炼的武人可用武器做出旋风把所有攻击自身的人或物卷走。须克服因做出旋风而耗尽自己的精神力。
translation: In Eastern martial arts, there is a martial art that can cause whirlwinds. Warriors who live in seclusion and practice for a long time can use their weapons to create a whirlwind to sweep away all people or things that attack them. You must overcome the exhaustion of your mental energy by creating a whirlwind.

source_zh: 近程单体攻击技能，有一定几率使目标强制旋转效果，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
