translation: is a short-range single-target attack skill that has a certain chance of causing the target to be forced to rotate. Strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 利用刀产生强大的大气流，形成空气防御膜。敌人的攻击经过防御膜之后会明显变弱。
translation: uses the knife to generate strong air flow and form an air defense film. The enemy's attack will be significantly weakened after passing through the defensive film.

source_zh: 增益技能，百分比减少受到的近程物理攻击伤害，技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: buff skill, which reduces the damage received from short-range physical attacks by a percentage. The skill level affects the buff effect.

source_zh: 刀法炼到极高境界的武士可以用刀与大地的力量进行沟通。可将强大的大地力量投射到很广阔的区域，但是具有耗时较多的缺点。武器的基本杀伤力上，会根据技术等级，增加奖励杀伤力。
translation: A samurai who has mastered sword skills to an extremely high level can use his sword to communicate with the power of the earth. It can project powerful earth power to a very wide area, but it has the disadvantage of being more time consuming. The basic lethality of the weapon will be increased with bonus lethality based on the technical level.

source_zh: 远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 5×5 range attack skill, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 这个功能是为了补充刀的低防御而研究出的。连续攻击使敌人无法进行攻击，同时攻击时带火焰，具有强大攻击力
translation: This function was developed to supplement the low defense of the knife. Continuous attacks make the enemy unable to attack. At the same time, they attack with flames, which has powerful attack power.

source_zh: 远程单体多段攻击技能，可快速移动到目标身边，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: is a long-range single-target multi-stage attack skill that can quickly move to the target. The skill level affects the skill damage.

source_zh: 使用刀的强力技能之一的飓风，是相对威力较小，对抗多数的敌人时存在着一些缺点的剑类技能。为了弥补这样的缺点，刀的主人们花了很多的心思，结果终于研究出名为狂野飓风的，可以对抗大量的敌人的绝佳技能。
translation: Hurricane, one of the powerful sword-using skills, is a sword-type skill that is relatively weak and has some shortcomings when used against most enemies. In order to make up for this shortcoming, the owners of the sword spent a lot of thought, and finally developed an excellent skill called Wild Hurricane, which can fight against a large number of enemies.

source_zh: 近程群体3×3范围攻击技能，有一定几率使目标强制旋转效果，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: is a short-range group attack skill with a 3×3 range. There is a certain chance that the target will be forced to rotate. Strength and skill level affect the skill damage.

source_zh: 在刀刃上用火形成球体，凝聚之后投掷出去的技能。一共有4个阶段的大小不同变化的气球。随着蓄力的时间不同，破坏力和攻击范围也不一样。蓄力完成的火球可以立刻使用，也可以在指定的时间内蓄力，并发出无比强力的攻击。
translation: A skill that uses fire to form a sphere on the blade, condenses it, and throws it out. There are 4 stages of balloons of different sizes. As the charging time is different, the destructive power and attack range are also different. The charged fireball can be used immediately, or it can be charged within a specified time and launch an extremely powerful attack.

source_zh: 远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 5×5 range attack skill, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 一个杀伤风速的技能，像光矛一样攻击敌人,范围攻击，力量影响杀伤。
translation: A skill that kills wind speed. It attacks the enemy like a light spear. It has a range attack and its power affects the damage.

source_zh: 远程群体线性3格范围攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group linear 3-block range attack skill, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 一股抵制敌人的强大怨恨从敌人的脚下产生锋利的龙卷风得到提升，这股强大的风力就像一飞冲天的巨龙,被攻击着无法动弹。
translation: A powerful resentment against the enemy is enhanced by the sharp tornado generated from the enemy's feet. This powerful wind is like a dragon soaring into the sky, unable to move after being attacked.

source_zh: 转职远程群体攻击技能，制造龙卷风攻击目标，有一定几率使目标强制旋转效果，力量和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: The long-distance group attack skill of changing classes creates a tornado to attack the target. There is a certain chance that the target will be forced to rotate. Strength and the level of changing classes affect the skill damage.

source_zh: 一个大跳跃冲向敌人,在指定位置会产生爆炸并且造成多个敌人伤害，它的威力取决于你的能力。
translation: A large jump rushes towards the enemy. It will explode at the designated location and cause damage to multiple enemies. Its power depends on your ability.

source_zh: 转职远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，有一定几率触发持续伤害效果，可快速移动到目标身边，力量和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: is a 5×5 range attack skill for long-distance group transfers. It has a certain chance of triggering a continuous damage effect. It can quickly move to the target. Strength and job transfer level affect the skill damage.

source_zh: 经过一段长时间的训练后,那些刀战士可以学习一种强大的斩、削手法。这种技巧可以产生一种巨大的风暴,并且造成地陷，它对你在面临多个敌人时比较实用。
translation: After a long period of training, those sword warriors can learn a powerful cutting and whittling technique. This technique can create a huge storm and create a sinkhole, which is useful when you are facing multiple enemies.

source_zh: 转职远程群体线性4格范围攻击技能，力量和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Class-transfer remote group linear 4-block range attack skill, strength and class-transfer level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 用快剑攻击时利用腕力在瞬时间给予两次打击的技术。是发挥了剑独有的柔韧与速度的基本技术。可得到武器基本杀伤力的奖励。
translation: A technique that uses wrist strength to strike twice in an instant when attacking with a fast sword. It is a basic technique that utilizes the unique flexibility and speed of the sword. You can get rewards based on the weapon's basic lethality.

source_zh: 近程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Short-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 从敌人的一个肩膀到另一边的腰部，从下到上，从上到下连续3次攻击的技术。可得到武器杀伤力的奖励。
translation: A technique to attack the enemy three times in a row from one shoulder to the other waist, from bottom to top, and from top to bottom. Receive bonuses for weapon lethality.

source_zh: 近程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Short-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 长期修炼剑法的人们在每次战斗时都可以达到最高境界，并很自然的施展各种极限技术。
translation: People who have practiced swordsmanship for a long time can reach the highest level in every battle and naturally perform various extreme techniques.

source_zh: 被动技能，增加自身杀伤力，领域等级影响技能效果。
translation: Passive skill, increases its own lethality, and the field level affects the skill effect.

source_zh: 快速挥动手中的剑并用其残像混乱对方的技术。由于敌人无法判断要攻击哪个部位因此可提高命中率。在持续期间可得到命中率的奖励。
translation: A technique that quickly swings the sword in its hand and confuses the opponent with its afterimage. This increases your hit rate since the enemy cannot tell which part to attack. Hit rate bonuses can be obtained during the duration.

source_zh: 增益技能，增加自身命中率百分比，敏捷和技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: buff skill, increases the percentage of own hit rate, agility and skill level affect the buff effect.

source_zh: 在一些战斗中需要面对面地和敌人展开战斗，这个时候只要能够生存下来就代表着战斗的胜利。只要一个人对胜利的欲望越大，对生存的毅力也自然地从肉体中引发出最极端的体力，以至于使用者往往会失去意识。
translation: In some battles, you need to fight the enemy face to face. At this time, as long as you can survive, it means victory in the battle. As long as a person's desire for victory is greater, the perseverance for survival will naturally trigger the most extreme physical strength from the body, so that the user often loses consciousness.

source_zh: 被动技能，增加自身生命力百分比。
translation: Passive skill, increases the percentage of own vitality.

source_zh: 以z字形态刺伤对方，犹如闪电一般的，到达的剑术之最快境界的技术。可得到武器杀伤力的奖励。
translation: Stabs the opponent in a z-shape like lightning, a technique that reaches the fastest level of swordsmanship. Receive bonuses for weapon lethality.

source_zh: 近程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Short-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 长期努力修炼剑术的人们即使是拿着盾牌战斗也会打倒敌人的最高境界，而且能自如运用盾的极限技术。
translation: People who have worked hard to practice swordsmanship for a long time can defeat the enemy to the highest level even when fighting with a shield, and can freely use the extreme skills of the shield.

source_zh: 被动技能，增加自身防御率，领域等级影响技能效果。
translation: Passive skill, increases own defense rate, domain level affects skill effect.

source_zh: 这是抓住敌人进攻时的破绽并迅速做出反击的技术。但是，要明白自己还得受一点伤害。在此技术持续期间若对方攻击到了你，可实现自动反击。
translation: This is a technique that seizes the flaw in the enemy's attack and quickly counterattacks. But, understand that you still have to hurt a little. During the duration of this technique, if the opponent attacks you, you can automatically counterattack.

source_zh: 增益技能，受到近身物理攻击时，会自动反击目标，技能等级影响反击伤害。
translation: gain skill, when receiving a close physical attack, it will automatically counterattack the target. The skill level affects the counterattack damage.

source_zh: 将敌人瞬间斩6次的速度极快剑光灵闪的连斩技术。使用此技术时会有武器杀伤力的奖励。
translation: A continuous slashing technique that cuts the enemy 6 times instantly with extremely fast sword light and lightning. There is a bonus to weapon lethality when using this technique.

source_zh: 近程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Short-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 用快速的步伐在瞬间缩短与敌人的距离并给予攻击的技术，可以攻击3~8米前的敌人。这是想快速接近并攻击逃亡敌人或者远程攻击的敌人时使用的技术。
translation: uses fast steps to instantly shorten the distance from the enemy and attack them. It can attack enemies 3 to 8 meters in front. This is a technique used when you want to quickly approach and attack a fleeing enemy or an enemy that attacks from a distance.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，可快速移动到目标身边。
translation: Long-range single-target attack skill, which can quickly move to the target.

source_zh: 将对方从脚到头一直劈上去的技术。由于其伤口就像一支缠绕着的蛇因此而得其名。使用时得到武器基本杀伤力的奖励。
translation: A technique to chop the opponent from feet to head. It got its name because its wound resembles a coiled snake. When used, you are rewarded with the weapon's basic lethality.

source_zh: 近程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Short-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 将刺，砍，斩融为一身的技术。作为剑系列最初的广域攻击技术可同时攻击3个敌人。
translation: A technique that combines stabbing, slashing, and chopping. As the first wide-area attack technology in the sword series, it can attack 3 enemies at the same time.

source_zh: 近程群体横向3格范围攻击技能，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: is a short-range group attack skill with a horizontal 3-block range. The skill level affects the skill damage.

source_zh: 利用闪闪剑光，如同吸血鬼们暴露在太阳之下，给予大范围内的敌人攻击的魔法。
translation: A magic that uses the flashing sword light to attack enemies in a wide range like vampires exposed to the sun.

source_zh: 远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 3×3 range attack skill, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 以闪电般的速度挥剑给予对方巨大伤害的技术。使用此技术可以大幅提高攻击速度，可在瞬间挥动9次剑攻击敌人。
translation: The technique of swinging the sword at lightning speed to inflict huge damage to the opponent. Using this technique can greatly increase the attack speed, and can swing the sword 9 times to attack the enemy in an instant.

source_zh: 近程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Short-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 将剑质变轻以形成高速攻击的剑法，还可以看穿敌人的攻击
translation: A sword technique that makes the sword lighter to form a high-speed attack, and can also see through the enemy's attack

source_zh: 增益技能，增加自身敏捷，领域和技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: Gain skills, increase own agility, domain and skill level affect the gain effect.

source_zh: 速度快得似乎可以把风砍成两半的利用剑的速度的技术。主要靠腕力完成的此技术虽然简单但破坏力强。技术使用时有半月状的残像，用此给予对方打击。
translation: A technique that utilizes the speed of a sword so fast that it seems like it can cut the wind in half. Performed primarily with wrist strength, this technique is simple but highly destructive. There is a half-moon-shaped afterimage when the technique is used, and it can be used to inflict blows on the opponent.

source_zh: 远程群体线性6格范围攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Long-range group linear 6-block range attack skill, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 长时间修炼剑术的达人们悟出了用精神力使自己的体力极大化的方法。剑术达人所使用的技术，一般人连模仿都模仿不了。
translation: Experts who have practiced swordsmanship for a long time have figured out how to use mental power to maximize their physical strength. The techniques used by sword masters cannot even be imitated by ordinary people.

source_zh: 增益技能，增加自身或队友生命力上限，力量和技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: Buff skill, increases the upper limit of one's own or teammates' vitality. Strength and skill level affect the buff effect.

source_zh: 经常修炼的剑士有时能悟出宇宙和大自然的规律并把自然界的能量聚积与剑上。是一种有着惊人破坏力的技术，可以借助闪电的力量发挥威力。
translation: Swordsmen who practice regularly can sometimes understand the laws of the universe and nature and accumulate the energy of nature on their swords. It is a technology with astonishing destructive power that can exert its power with the help of lightning.

source_zh: 远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 3×3 range attack skill, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 能够自如控制剑气的人们可以给手中的剑赋予精神力量，即使没有足够的力量也可以使用剑。
translation: People who can freely control the sword energy can give spiritual power to the sword in their hands, and can use the sword even if they don't have enough strength.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote single target attack skill, skill level affects skill damage.

source_zh: 源于古印度的剑法，使用时产生炙热的剑气伤害对手
translation: is a sword technique originated from ancient India. When used, it produces hot sword energy to harm the opponent.

source_zh: 近程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Short-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 用锋利的剑攻击对方的要害使之短暂麻木的技术。
translation: A technique that uses a sharp sword to attack the opponent's vital points to temporarily numb them.

source_zh: 远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 3×3 range attack skill, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 快速挥动剑，形成剑膜进行防御的技术。有效时间内可减少50%的攻击。还能给对方施加一定的伤害。
translation: A technique of quickly swinging the sword to form a sword membrane for defense. It can reduce attacks by 50% during the effective time. It can also cause certain damage to the opponent.

source_zh: 增益技能，百分比减少受到的近程物理攻击伤害，附带对发起攻击的目标反射伤害效果，技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: buff skill, which reduces the damage received from short-range physical attacks by a percentage, and also has a reflection damage effect on the target that launches the attack. The skill level affects the buff effect.

source_zh: 剑术极高的武士可以利用剑，与上天的力量进行沟通。他们可以将强大的雷电的力量投射到广泛的区域。
translation: A warrior with extremely high swordsmanship can use the sword to communicate with the power of heaven. They can project the power of powerful thunder and lightning over a wide area.

source_zh: 远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 5×5 range attack skill, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 攻击敌人的弱点，用意念控制剑进行攻击。这个技术是可以自由自在利用意念控制剑的剑法，是武士中最顶级的剑法
translation: Attack the enemy's weakness and control the sword with your mind to attack. This technique is a sword technique that allows you to freely control the sword with your thoughts. It is the top sword technique among samurai.

source_zh: 远程单体多段攻击技能，可快速移动到目标身边，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: is a long-range single-target multi-stage attack skill that can quickly move to the target. The skill level affects the skill damage.

source_zh: 与剑同甘共苦，并专心致志地修炼的达人达到了完全与剑合为一体的境界。达到这种境界时可以使用无形的剑掷向远距离的敌人，如果达到可以自由自在地修练剑气境界的时候，达人可以连共振膜也一同抛向敌人，被这种剑袭击的敌人将会陷入自身难保的困境。
translation: The master who shares the joys and sorrows with the sword and practices with concentration reaches the state of being completely integrated with the sword. When you reach this state, you can use the invisible sword to throw it at distant enemies. If you reach the state where you can practice sword energy freely, the master can throw the resonance membrane at the enemy as well. The enemy attacked by this kind of sword will fall into a predicament that cannot protect itself.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，附带强制击退效果，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote single target attack skill, with forced knockback effect. Skill level affects skill damage.

source_zh: 能够从空中召唤巨型闪电的气体剑，并投掷在指定的位置。凋落在地上的电剑可以施放强大的电流，并且在这之后的一定时间内，该范围地域上的攻击破坏率会有些许增加。
translation: A gas sword that can summon giant lightning from the air and throw it at a designated location. The electric sword lying on the ground can cast a powerful current, and for a certain period of time after that, the attack damage rate in the area will increase slightly.

source_zh: 远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，附带5×5范围伤害增幅效果，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 5×5 range attack skill, with 5×5 range damage amplification effect. Strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 它是一个猛烈的技能,可从天空召唤几道强雷电于类似媒介的剑身上,攻击敌人。它可造成范围巨大攻击,就像天神的愤怒发泄谴责于人类身上般可怕。
translation: It is a violent skill that can summon several strong thunder and lightning from the sky on a sword similar to a medium to attack the enemy. It can cause a huge range of attacks, which is as terrifying as the anger of gods venting its condemnation on humans.

source_zh: 远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 3×3 range attack skill, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 急速驾驶摩托,并且旋转前轮,就像个心轴围绕自己吹卷整个敌人。这个技能只限于摩托车,是一种对使用个人车子便进行攻击的实用交通工具。
translation: Drive the motorcycle quickly and spin the front wheel, like a spindle that spins the entire enemy around itself. This skill is limited to motorcycles, and is a practical means of transportation that can be used to attack personal vehicles.

source_zh: 转职远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，力量和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: 5×5 range attack skills for remote group transfer. Strength and job transfer level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 长距离在剑上增加了圣银的力量,范围攻击技能，力量影响攻击能力。
translation: The long distance adds the power of holy silver to the sword, range attack skills, and the power affects the attack ability.

source_zh: 转职远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，附带5×5范围持续伤害效果，力量和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: 5×5 range attack skill for remote group transfer, with 5×5 range continuous damage effect. Strength and job transfer level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 这个技能可以召唤只被天上的不死神操纵的光能，审判之光射向敌人，使用者能力强大并且可与神交流，它可以由小增大范围伤害。
translation: This skill can summon light energy that is only controlled by the immortal gods in the sky. The light of judgment is shot at the enemy. The user is powerful and can communicate with gods. It can increase the range of damage from small to small.

source_zh: 转职远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，力量和转职技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: The 3×3 range attack skill of the long-distance group for job transfer. Strength and job transfer skill level affect the skill damage.

source_zh: 可快速换弹夹的技术。枪用多了就会很自然地迅速换弹夹。
translation: Technology that can quickly change the magazine. When the gun is used a lot, it will naturally change the magazine quickly.

source_zh: 被动技能，增加更换弹夹的速度。
translation: Passive skill, increases the speed of changing magazines.

source_zh: 使用此技术可以连发2枪。射击速度因枪的种类而异，最快的依次为SMG,AR,SR/SG。不过连发时会影响命中率，但技术提高，命中率受到的影响会减少，到了顶级阶段就完全不会受到影响。
translation: Use this technology to fire 2 shots in a row. The firing speed varies depending on the type of gun, with the fastest being SMG, AR, SR/SG. However, the hit rate will be affected when firing continuously, but as the technology improves, the impact on the hit rate will be reduced, and it will not be affected at all at the top level.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote single target attack skill, skill level affects skill damage.

source_zh: 注射瞬间加快新陈代谢的药，可以增加创口的恢复速度
translation: Injection of medicine that instantly speeds up metabolism can increase the speed of wound recovery.

source_zh: 增益技能，恢复自身生命力，技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: Gain skills, restore your own vitality, skill level affects the gain effect.

source_zh: 拿着AR,SMG使用此技术可进行连续射击。没有连发功能的SG,SR则不能使用此技术。连发时会友命中率的惩罚，但技术升高惩罚会减少而到了宗师阶段就不会有任何惩罚。
translation: Holding AR, SMG can use this technology for continuous shooting. SG and SR without burst function cannot use this technology. There will be a penalty on your friend's hit rate when firing continuously, but the penalty will be reduced as the skill increases and there will be no penalty at the master stage.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote single target attack skill, skill level affects skill damage.

source_zh: 拿着AR,SMG,SG使用此技术可进行广域攻击。此时，攻击范围的大小随枪的种类而不同，没有连发功能的SR则不能进行广域攻击。使用此技术时会有杀伤力和命中率的惩罚，但如果达到了大师阶段就不会有任何惩罚。
translation: Holding AR, SMG, and SG can use this technology to carry out wide-area attacks. At this time, the size of the attack range varies with the type of gun. SR without the burst function cannot perform wide-area attacks. There is a penalty to lethality and hit rate when using this technique, but there is no penalty if you reach the Master stage.

source_zh: 远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 3×3 range attack skill, skill level affects skill damage.

source_zh: 训练有素的军人在快速移动的同时也可以进行精准的射击。而在他们当中实力突出的军人则专门瞄准敌人的头部并一枪击倒。拿着AR,SMG,SG使用此技术时有近距离攻击经验加成。拿着SR不能使用此技术。
translation: Well-trained soldiers can shoot accurately while moving quickly. The most powerful soldiers among them specifically aimed at the enemy's head and shot him down. When using this technique with an AR, SMG, or SG, there is a close attack experience bonus. This technique cannot be used while holding SR.

source_zh: 远程攻击技能，当佩戴SG枪时为群体3×3范围攻击技能，佩戴其余枪型为单体攻击技能，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: is a long-range attack skill. When wearing the SG gun, it is a group 3×3 range attack skill. When wearing other gun types, it is a single-target attack skill. The skill level affects the skill damage.

source_zh: 增加AR(AssaultRifle),SMG(Sub-Machine-Gun),SR(SniperRifle),SG(SHOTGun)系列枪支的威力，练这个功能可以发挥枪支的所有威力
translation: increases the power of AR (AssaultRifle), SMG (Sub-Machine-Gun), SR (SniperRifle), SG (SHOTGun) series guns. Practicing this function can bring out all the power of guns.

source_zh: 被动技能，增加自身命中率、伤害值、有效打击率，佩戴枪型影响被动效果。
translation: Passive skill, increases one's own hit rate, damage value, and effective strike rate. Wearing a gun type affects the passive effect.

source_zh: 拿着AR,SMG时使用此技术可以进行连续射击。没有连发功能的SG,SR则不能使用此技术。连续射击时会有命中率的惩罚，但随着技术的提高惩罚也会减少而到了大师阶段就不会有任何惩罚。
translation: Use this technology to shoot continuously when holding an AR or SMG. SG and SR without burst function cannot use this technology. There will be a hit rate penalty when shooting continuously, but the penalty will decrease as the skill improves and there will be no penalty at the master level.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，附带命中加成效果，敏捷和技能等级影响命中加成效果，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote single-target attack skill, with hit bonus effect. Agility and skill level affect the hit bonus effect, and strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 出色的狙击手可在任何地方成功隐藏自身并狙击敌人。使用此技术可以避开别人的眼睛悄悄隐藏。在此状态下用SR狙击会得到命中率和杀伤力的奖励。但是在隐蔽的时候移动或者说话都会暴露自己，因此要多加小心。继续训练这种技术，隐蔽持续时间会延长而延时会缩短。
translation: An excellent sniper can successfully hide himself and snipe enemies anywhere. Use this technique to hide quietly from other people's eyes. Sniping with SR in this state will gain bonuses in hit rate and lethality. However, moving or talking while hiding will expose yourself, so be careful. As you continue to train this technique, the concealment duration will increase and the delay will decrease.

source_zh: 增益技能，使自己处于隐身状态，当佩戴SR枪时会额外增加伤害值百分比、命中率百分比，力量和技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: The buff skill makes you invisible. When wearing the SR gun, it will increase the damage value percentage and hit rate percentage. Strength and skill level affect the buff effect.

source_zh: 军人除了具有精确的射击技术之外，也会进行针对自身体质的严酷训练，以保证他们可以与敌人进行面对面的肉搏战。这个技能是一个被动技能，随着技能等级的上升，人物的HP上限也会随之提高。
translation: In addition to having precise shooting skills, soldiers will also undergo rigorous training based on their physical fitness to ensure that they can engage in face-to-face hand-to-hand combat with the enemy. This skill is a passive skill. As the skill level increases, the character's HP limit will also increase.

source_zh: 被动技能，增加自身生命力百分比、回避率百分比，领域等级影响被动效果。
translation: Passive skill, increases the percentage of own vitality and evasion rate, and the field level affects the passive effect.

source_zh: 最近刚上市的强火力的枪械可穿透多人并给予伤害。使用此技术可以给予在射程以内一条直线上的多个敌人以打击。穿透性较弱的SG则不能用此技术。这种技术也会有杀伤力的惩罚，不过到了宗师阶段惩罚也会消失。
translation: The powerful firearm recently launched on the market can penetrate multiple people and cause damage. Use this technique to hit multiple enemies in a straight line within range. This technology cannot be used for SGs with weak penetration. This technique will also have a lethality penalty, but the penalty will disappear at the Grandmaster stage.

source_zh: 远程线性攻击技能，当佩戴SG枪时无法使用此技能。
translation: Long-range linear attack skill, this skill cannot be used when wearing the SG gun.

source_zh: 学会后可以使用大容量的弹夹
translation: After learning, you can use large-capacity magazines

source_zh: 被动技能，可以使用大容量弹夹。
translation: Passive skill, can use large-capacity magazines.

source_zh: 要在激烈的战斗当中生存下来，找到一个可以掩护的东西隐蔽起来是相当重要的。与吸血鬼的战斗中，隐蔽的重要性也很明显。
translation: To survive in a fierce battle, it is very important to find something that can cover you. The importance of concealment is also evident in the battle against vampires.

source_zh: 增益技能，增加自身回避率、防御率，敏捷、力量和技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: gain skills, increase own evasion rate, defense rate, agility, strength and skill level affect the gain effect.

source_zh: 随着技术的发展扫雷装备也越来越小型化且便于携带。用这项技术可找到布在地面上的地雷，此外还能发现地下隐藏着的吸血鬼或陷阱，还有其他未知的危险。
translation: With the development of technology, mine clearance equipment has become increasingly smaller and easier to carry. This technology can be used to find mines laid on the ground, as well as vampires or traps hidden underground, as well as other unknown dangers.

source_zh: 增益技能，使自身或队友可以发现陷阱、隐蔽、隐身、狙击等状态，技能和目标等级影响增益效果。
translation: Buff skills allow you or your teammates to discover traps, concealment, invisibility, sniping, etc. Skills and target levels affect the buff effects.

source_zh: 被击中后伤口形成三叉型伤口,增加伤害
translation: After being hit, the wound forms a tridental wound, increasing the damage

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，附带命中加成效果，敏捷和技能等级影响命中加成效果和技能伤害。
translation: A long-range single-target attack skill with a hit bonus effect. Agility and skill level affect the hit bonus effect and skill damage.

source_zh: 进一步增加AR(AssaultRifle),SMG(Sub-Machine-Gun),SR(SniperRifle),SG(SHOTGun)系列枪支的威力
translation: further increases the power of AR (AssaultRifle), SMG (Sub-Machine-Gun), SR (SniperRifle), SG (SHOTGun) series of guns

source_zh: 被动技能，增加自身命中率、伤害值、有效打击率，佩戴枪型影响被动效果。
translation: Passive skill, increases one's own hit rate, damage value, and effective strike rate. Wearing a gun type affects the passive effect.

source_zh: 利用敌人的弱点使对手暂时无法行动
translation: Take advantage of the enemy's weakness to temporarily incapacitate the opponent.

source_zh: 地板技能，在地面施放陷阱，使处于陷阱范围内的敌人有一定几率受到陷阱的限制，无法移动，无法使用技能，技能等级影响技能效果。
translation: Floor skill, casts a trap on the ground, so that enemies within the trap range have a certain chance of being restricted by the trap, unable to move or use skills. The skill level affects the skill effect.

source_zh: 接近大师阶段的军人观察敌情的眼力会达到极限值。因此可以一一观察敌人的动静，并练就能一眼识破敌人弱点的眼力。
translation: The eyesight of soldiers approaching the master stage in observing the enemy's situation will reach the limit. Therefore, you can observe the enemy's movements one by one and practice your eyesight to see through the enemy's weaknesses at a glance.

source_zh: 增益技能，增加自身伤害值、有效打击、视野，技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: Buff skill, increases own damage value, effective strike, field of vision, skill level affects the buff effect.

source_zh: 可以使枪支产生快速和广范的攻击，适合运用于敌人众多的战斗环境
translation: can make the gun produce fast and wide-range attacks, suitable for use in combat environments with many enemies

source_zh: 远程群体攻击技能，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group attack skill, skill level affects skill damage.

source_zh: 长期使用枪的人类懂得如何使用相同的子弹却让攻击力更为强大。提高子弹的飞行速度，子弹射出后就像是一道光。使用此技术可以连发四枪。速度因枪的种类而异，速度最快的依次为SMG,AR,SR/SG.
translation: Human beings who have used guns for a long time know how to use the same bullets to make the attack more powerful. Increase the bullet's flight speed, and the bullet will look like a beam of light after being fired. Using this technique it is possible to fire four shots in a row. The speed varies depending on the type of gun. The fastest ones are SMG, AR, SR/SG.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，附带命中加成效果，技能等级影响命中加成效果和技能伤害。
translation: is a long-range single-target attack skill with a hit bonus effect. The skill level affects the hit bonus effect and skill damage.

source_zh: 一名好军人要懂得冷静判断状况，并在最有效的位置集中火力。军部为了人类布置了很多炮兵部队，玩家必要时可以引导炮击，猛烈轰炸某个区域。但是，会在邀请火炮支援之后的一段时间之后，才会执行炮火攻击，因此要掌握好时间差。杀伤力和校准距离因技术等级而异。
translation: A good soldier must know how to calmly judge the situation and concentrate firepower at the most effective location. The military has deployed a lot of artillery units for humans. Players can direct artillery strikes and violently bombard a certain area when necessary. However, the artillery attack will not be carried out until some time after artillery support is invited, so the time difference must be grasped. Lethality and calibrated range vary by technology level.

source_zh: 远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 5×5 range attack skill, skill level affects skill damage.

source_zh: 可以降低吸血族移动速度
translation: can reduce the movement speed of vampires

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，有一定几率降低目标移动速度效果，技能等级影响命中加成效果和技能伤害。
translation: Long-range single-target attack skill has a certain chance of reducing the target's movement speed. The skill level affects the hit bonus effect and skill damage.

source_zh: 在一团混乱的战场上为了生死而拼搏的军人们本能地产生的名为最终一击的技能。在敌人和你的距离达到武器火力最强的距离时，它可以使所有火力集中起来以达到最强的破坏力，同时还可以一直维持间隔时间距离。
translation: Soldiers fighting for life and death on a chaotic battlefield instinctively produce a skill called the final blow. When the distance between the enemy and you reaches the maximum distance of weapon firepower, it can concentrate all the firepower to achieve the strongest destructive power, while also maintaining the separation time distance.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，附带强制击退效果，技能等级影响击退效果和技能伤害。
translation: Long-range single target attack skill, with forced knockback effect. The skill level affects the knockback effect and skill damage.

source_zh: 生成搭乘型炮塔后，在固定状态下的一定时间内发动强烈的攻击，以起到掩护作用的技能。不过有一个缺点就是炮塔一旦生成就只能定在原地，不能移动。
translation: After generating a ride-on turret, it can launch a strong attack within a fixed period of time to act as a cover. However, one disadvantage is that once the turret is generated, it can only stay in place and cannot move.

source_zh: 变身技能，变化为炮塔状态，增加伤害值、附带减免50%受到的伤害，此技能使用后，角色无法移动，是炮塔火力技能
translation: Transformation skill, changes into turret state, increases damage value, and reduces damage received by 50%. After using this skill, the character cannot move, it is a turret firepower skill

source_zh: 远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，需要处于安装炮塔状态下使用，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 3×3 range attack skill. It needs to be used with the turret installed. The skill level affects the skill damage.

source_zh: 远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，需要处于安装炮塔状态下使用，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 3×3 range attack skill. It needs to be used with the turret installed. The skill level affects the skill damage.

source_zh: 当你领悟这个练习课程,你可操纵这强大伤害火箭发射器。这个火箭发射器容易使用,与它的杀伤对比,可轻松安装以及卸装。但它无法连续发射,因为反射反映。
translation: When you master this training course, you can control this powerful damage rocket launcher. This rocket launcher is easy to use, and in contrast to its lethality, it can be easily installed and removed. But it cannot emit continuously because of reflection reflection.

source_zh: 远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 3×3 range attack skill, skill level affects skill damage.

source_zh: 新的发展型的子弹在血液中爆炸产生一种化学物质效果。总之,他不太安全因为无法快速供应，完美的物品是很难生产的。
translation: The new development bullet explodes in the blood to produce a chemical effect. In short, it is not very safe because it cannot be supplied quickly, and perfect items are difficult to produce.

source_zh: 转职远程单体攻击技能，附带感染效果，如果目标在感染时间内被击杀，目标无法被其他角色复活，力量和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: The long-range single-target attack skill for job transfer has an infection effect. If the target is killed within the infection time, the target cannot be resurrected by other characters. Strength and job transfer level affect the skill damage.

source_zh: 卫星轰炸,每次使用有延迟，是枪手不能少的技能。
translation: Satellite bombing, there is a delay every time it is used, it is an indispensable skill for gunners.

source_zh: 转职远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，有一定几率触发致盲效果，力量和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: The 5×5 range attack skill of the long-distance group after job transfer has a certain chance of triggering the blinding effect. Strength and job transfer level affect the skill damage.

source_zh: 这个器械比离子火箭炮更高级，组装之后,可架设枪支。武器研究者秘密发明，因为它拥有强大的杀伤，它并不很安全,极少军队和专家才懂得使用。
translation: This device is more advanced than the ion rocket launcher. After assembly, a gun can be set up. Weapon researchers invented it secretly. Because it has powerful lethality, it is not very safe and only very few troops and experts know how to use it.

source_zh: 转职远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，敏捷和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: 3×3 range attack skill for remote group of job transfer, agility and job transfer level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 有天赋或受过特殊教育的有自信心的圣职者可借助圣灵之手治愈自己或他人的伤口。此魔法可治疗自身或别的人类所受到的小伤。不过在治疗别人时会有惩罚，随着技术等级的上升治愈的程度也会有所提高，并减少惩罚。
translation: Confident clergymen who are gifted or have received special education can heal their own or others' wounds with the help of the Holy Spirit. This magic can heal minor injuries suffered by oneself or other humans. However, there will be a penalty when treating others. As the skill level increases, the degree of healing will increase and the penalty will be reduced.

source_zh: 远程单体恢复血量技能，可以给自身或同族角色使用，技能等级影响恢复效果。
translation: Remote single target health recovery skill, which can be used on yourself or characters of the same race. The skill level affects the recovery effect.

source_zh: 将神圣的力量，以弓箭的形式发射，攻击敌人的技术。也可进行远距离攻击。
translation: A technique that launches sacred power in the form of bows and arrows to attack the enemy. Can also perform long-distance attacks.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote single target attack skills, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 吸血鬼只向人类使用致命的各种毒。此魔法是借助圣灵之手治愈被中毒的人的魔法。施毒的吸血鬼的级别越高，毒性越强需要更高的熟练度。给别人解毒会有所惩罚。
translation: Vampires only use various deadly poisons on humans. This magic is a magic that heals a poisoned person with the help of the Holy Spirit. The higher the level of the vampire casting the poison, the stronger the poison and the higher the proficiency required. There is a penalty for detoxing someone else.

source_zh: 远程单体解除负面状态技能，可以解除同族角色部分毒系负面状态，技能等级和施放负面状态技能的角色等级影响解除效果。
translation: is a remote single-target negative status removal skill that can remove some of the poisonous negative status of characters of the same race. The skill level and the level of the character who casts the negative status skill affect the removal effect.

source_zh: 信仰坚定的圣职者们可在吸血鬼的强毒之中保护自己或别人一段时间。此魔法借助圣灵的力量来提高自己或其他人对毒的抵抗力。熟练度越高抵抗力增加量也越大，而施给别人时会有所惩罚。
translation: Priests with strong faith can protect themselves or others from the poison of vampires for a period of time. This magic uses the power of the Holy Spirit to increase one's own or others' resistance to poison. The higher the proficiency, the greater the increase in resistance, and there will be a penalty when giving it to others.

source_zh: 增益技能，增加自身或同族角色毒性魔法抵抗力，智力影响增益效果。
translation: Buff skill, increases the poisonous magic resistance of oneself or characters of the same race, and intelligence affects the buffing effect.

source_zh: 对吸血鬼这种邪恶力量长期进行过研究的圣职者们发现，出自他们信仰心而治愈的奇迹反而会给这些邪恶力量更大的伤害。将这种神圣的魔法施于吸血鬼身上可使吸血鬼忍受巨大痛苦并受到较小伤害。
translation: Priests who have long studied the evil forces of vampires have discovered that the miracles of healing stemming from their faith will actually cause greater harm to these evil forces. Casting this holy magic on a vampire causes the vampire to endure great pain and suffer minor damage.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote single target attack skills, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 有天赋或受过特殊教育的有自信心的圣职者可借助圣灵之手治愈自己或他人的伤口。此魔法可治疗自身或别的人类所受到的较深的伤。不过在治疗别人时会有惩罚，随着技术等级的上升治愈的程度也会有所提高，并减少惩罚。
translation: Confident clergymen who are gifted or have received special education can heal their own or others' wounds with the help of the Holy Spirit. This magic can heal deep wounds suffered by oneself or other humans. However, there will be a penalty when treating others. As the skill level increases, the degree of healing will increase and the penalty will be reduced.

source_zh: 远程群体3×3范围恢复血量技能，技能等级影响技能恢复效果。
translation: Remote group 3×3 range health recovery skill, skill level affects skill recovery effect.

source_zh: 吸血鬼们用类似于黑魔法的魔法给予人们诅咒。这种魔法虽然能在一段时间后自己消失，但最好还是尽快解除。将这种魔法用在被诅咒的人类身上，会解除诅咒。不过吸血鬼的级别越高，或诅咒自身的级别越高就会需要更高的熟练度。
translation: Vampires use magic similar to black magic to curse people. Although this kind of magic can disappear on its own after a period of time, it is best to remove it as soon as possible. Using this magic on a cursed human will break the curse. However, the higher the level of the vampire, or the higher the level of the curse itself, the higher the proficiency required.

source_zh: 远程单体解除负面状态技能，可以解除同族角色部分诅咒系负面状态，技能等级和施放负面状态技能的角色等级影响解除效果。
translation: is a remote single-target negative status removal skill that can remove some curse-related negative statuses from characters of the same race. The skill level and the level of the character who casts the negative status skills affect the removal effect.

source_zh: 调查结果显示被诅咒的人们多数是意志力弱而且自信不够的人。但是，出色的圣职者可用强大的祝福的力量从吸血鬼的诅咒中保护自己和他人。对诅咒的抵抗力大小取决于熟练度的高低，施给别人时会有所惩罚。
translation: Survey results show that most of the cursed people are people with weak willpower and insufficient self-confidence. However, outstanding clerics can use the power of powerful blessings to protect themselves and others from the vampire's curse. The resistance to the curse depends on the level of proficiency, and there will be a penalty when inflicting it on others.

source_zh: 增益技能，增加自身或同族角色诅咒魔法抵抗力，智力影响增益效果。
translation: Buff skills, increase the curse magic resistance of oneself or characters of the same race, intelligence affects the buff effect.

source_zh: 用圣职者的圣力治愈快要死去的人的魔法。圣职者们用自己治愈的力量使快要死的人得到重生以显示圣灵的启示。此魔法对圣职者来说是必须经历的阶段，因此很多圣职者救助受伤的人们时使用此魔法以显示圣灵的启示。
translation: A magic that uses the holy power of the clergy to heal the dying. Priests demonstrated the revelation of the Holy Spirit by using their healing power to regenerate dying people. This magic is a stage that priests must go through, so many priests use this magic to show the revelation of the Holy Spirit when they rescue injured people.

source_zh: 复活技能，可以复活处于濒临死亡状态的同族角色。
translation: Resurrection skill can resurrect characters of the same race who are on the verge of death.

source_zh: 对吸血鬼这种邪恶力量长期进行过研究的圣职者们发现，出自他们信仰心而治愈的奇迹反而会给这些邪恶力量更大的伤害。将这种神圣的魔法施于吸血鬼身上可使吸血鬼忍受巨大痛苦并受到较大伤害。
translation: Priests who have long studied the evil forces of vampires have discovered that miracles of healing stemming from their faith will actually cause greater harm to these evil forces. Applying this sacred magic to a vampire can cause the vampire to endure great pain and suffer greater damage.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote single target attack skills, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 可以用来治疗人类战士
translation: can be used to heal human warriors

source_zh: 制造技能，可以将药瓶变化为恢复圣水，领域等级影响制造效果。
translation: Manufacturing skill can change the medicine bottle into recovery holy water. The field level affects the manufacturing effect.

source_zh: 有天赋或受过特殊教育的有自信心的圣职者可借助圣灵之手治愈自己或他人的伤口。此魔法可治疗自身或别的人类所受到的致命伤。不过在治疗别人时会有惩罚，随着技术等级的上升治愈的程度也会有所提高，并减少惩罚。
translation: Confident clergymen who are gifted or have received special education can heal their own or others' wounds with the help of the Holy Spirit's hand. This magic can heal fatal wounds suffered by oneself or other humans. However, there will be a penalty when treating others. As the skill level increases, the degree of healing will increase and the penalty will be reduced.

source_zh: 远程群体5×5范围恢复血量技能，智力和技能等级影响恢复效果。
translation: Remote group 5×5 range blood volume recovery skill, intelligence and skill level affect the recovery effect.

source_zh: 圣职者们用祈祷来使自己的精神得到净化。为了守护自己高贵而圣洁的灵魂他们每天都会在主面前以祷告忏悔自己的罪恶。他们手持主身后背着的十字架向主祈祷净化心灵并恢复精神力。
translation: Priests use prayer to purify their spirits. In order to protect their noble and holy souls, they confess their sins in prayer before the Lord every day. They held the cross carried behind the Lord and prayed to the Lord to purify their hearts and restore their spiritual power.

source_zh: 被动技能，百分比恢复自身魔法值，智力影响恢复效果。
translation: Passive skill, percentage recovery of own magic value, intelligence affects the recovery effect.

source_zh: 吸血鬼们有时会用魔法制造出强酸性液体以攻击人类。对此圣职者们找到了能使人在酸性液体中免受伤害的魔法。使用此魔法能提高自身或他人对酸的抵抗力。技术等级越高抵抗力的增量也会加大，赋予别人时会有所惩罚。
translation: Vampires sometimes use magic to create strong acidic liquids to attack humans. In response, the clergy found a magic that could protect people from harm in acidic liquids. Using this magic can increase one's own or others' resistance to acid. The higher the technical level, the greater the increase in resistance will be, and there will be a penalty when giving it to others.

source_zh: 增益技能，增加自身或同族角色酸性魔法抵抗力，智力影响增益效果。
translation: Buff skill, increases the acid magic resistance of oneself or characters of the same race, and intelligence affects the buff effect.

source_zh: 以消耗自己的精神力为代价，在一定时间内100%抵御吸血鬼的魔法攻击。但对于物理攻击不起作用。
translation: At the cost of consuming your own mental power, you can 100% resist vampire magic attacks for a certain period of time. But has no effect on physical attacks.

source_zh: 增益技能，百分比减少受到的魔法伤害。
translation: Buff skill, percentage reduction of magic damage received.

source_zh: 信仰坚定的圣职者们有时可创造出只有牺牲自己性命才能获得的伟大奇迹。此魔法可以使人消耗HP而不是MP来实用其他魔法。
translation: Priests with strong faith can sometimes perform great miracles that can only be achieved by sacrificing their own lives. This magic allows people to use HP instead of MP to use other magic.

source_zh: 增益技能，当自身魔法值不足时，可以使用生命值替代不足的魔法值。
translation: gain skill, when one's own magic value is insufficient, the health value can be used to replace the insufficient magic value.

source_zh: 长期以来对邪恶力量的存在进行研究的圣职者们，发现出自他们信仰而治愈的奇迹反而会给这些邪恶力量更大的打击。将这种神圣的魔法施于吸血鬼身上可使吸血鬼忍受巨大痛苦并受到致命伤害。
translation: The clergy who have long studied the existence of evil forces have discovered that the miracles of healing stemming from their faith will inflict a greater blow to these evil forces. Casting this holy magic on a vampire can cause the vampire to endure great pain and suffer fatal injuries.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，附带使目标无法移动、无法使用技能和伤害减免效果，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: is a long-range single-target attack skill, which also makes the target unable to move, use skills and damage reduction effects. Intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 将碱性液体涂抹在盔甲上以增加对于酸性攻击的防御能力
translation: Apply alkaline liquid to armor to increase defense against acid attacks

source_zh: 增益技能，增加自身或同族角色血性魔法抵抗力，智力影响增益效果。
translation: Buff skill, increases the blood magic resistance of oneself or characters of the same race, and intelligence affects the buff effect.

source_zh: 用圣令在人间实现奇迹是有限制的。但是，数百年才能诞生出一个的伟大的圣人可以使自己的力量在人间得以实现。此魔法可以解除人类身上的所有毒，诅咒，酸等魔法，并能一次治愈几乎所有的伤口。
translation: There are limits to using holy orders to achieve miracles on earth. However, it takes hundreds of years for a great saint to be born who can realize his power in the human world. This magic can remove all poison, curses, acid and other magic from humans, and can heal almost all wounds at once.

source_zh: 远程单体恢复血量技能，附带解除部分负面状态效果，可以给自身或同族角色使用，智力和技能等级影响恢复效果。
translation: is a long-range single-target health recovery skill, which also removes some negative status effects. It can be used on yourself or characters of the same race. Intelligence and skill level affect the recovery effect.

source_zh: 长时间对吸血鬼进行过研究的圣职者们发现由自身的信仰引来的光给邪恶力量带来的破坏力是更加惊人的。被圣光照射的吸血鬼会受到致命打击。
translation: Priests who have studied vampires for a long time have discovered that the destructive power of light caused by their own beliefs to evil forces is even more astonishing. Vampires illuminated by the Holy Light will suffer a fatal blow.

source_zh: 远程群体5×5范围多段攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 5×5 range multi-stage attack skill, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 长时间修炼的圣职者们的神圣祈祷力量能使疯狂的怪物们也暂时沉溺于和平的氛围。
translation: The holy prayer power of the clergy who have practiced for a long time can make even the crazy monsters temporarily indulge in a peaceful atmosphere.

source_zh: 远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，附带消除怪物对自身的仇恨值。
translation: Remote group 3×3 range attack skill, which also eliminates the hatred value of monsters towards itself.

source_zh: 可以救治收到强烈攻击而处半死状态的自己的肉体，但如果再处半死状态，受到的伤害更大
translation: can heal your own body that is half-dead after receiving a strong attack, but if you are still half-dead, you will suffer greater damage.

source_zh: 复活技能，当自身处于濒临死亡状态，可以通过转生术复活1次自己。
translation: Resurrection skill, when you are on the verge of death, you can resurrect yourself once through reincarnation.

source_zh: 赐给经历过多次苦行的圣职者的圣灵之恩宠，据巴尔地干地下书库的古代纪录在很少数圣职者身上发现这个恩宠。如果对神的信仰真挚，可使人的伤口快速恢复。
translation: The grace of the Holy Spirit given to clergy who have experienced many times of asceticism. According to the ancient records of the Baltican Underground Library, this grace has been found in very few clergy. If one's faith in God is sincere, one's wounds can be healed quickly.

source_zh: 增益技能，增加自身或队友药物恢复效果。
translation: Gain skills to increase the drug recovery effect of yourself or teammates.

source_zh: 长时间与吸血鬼战斗的圣职者们，对其很高的恢复能力非常关心。他们坚信人类也能具有这种能力，并最终找到了可以获得与吸血鬼相当的恢复能力的办法。
translation: Priests who have fought vampires for a long time are very concerned about their high recovery ability. They believed humans could have this ability too, and eventually found a way to gain a level of recovery comparable to that of vampires.

source_zh: 远程群体3×3范围恢复血量技能，智力和技能等级影响恢复效果。
translation: Remote group 3×3 range health recovery skill, intelligence and skill level affect the recovery effect.

source_zh: 在与吸血鬼战斗的同时，圣职者们还在继续为解救他们的灵魂而努力。因此找到了可以将亡灵引向安息处的方法。可以影响到包括吸血鬼在内的所有不死类的怪兽。
translation: While fighting the vampires, the Priests continue to work to free their souls. Thus methods were found that could lead the souls of the dead to their resting place. Can affect all undead monsters including vampires.

source_zh: 以自身为中心群体5×5范围攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: A 5×5 range attack skill centered on itself. Intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 可以治愈高级吸鬼造成的吸血伤害
translation: can cure blood-sucking damage caused by advanced vampires

source_zh: 远程单体恢复血量技能，附带解除部分负面状态效果，可以给自身或同族角色使用，智力和技能等级影响恢复效果。
translation: is a long-range single-target health recovery skill, which also removes some negative status effects. It can be used on yourself or characters of the same race. Intelligence and skill level affect the recovery effect.

source_zh: 领会到人类肉体真谛的圣职者可以召唤自己的分身，得到可以能发射圣灵力量的光球的攻击魔法。使用修罗-破魔法可以召唤自己的分身包围敌人并发动攻击，这是治疗系的最高攻击魔法。
translation: Priests who understand the true meaning of human flesh can summon their own clones and obtain attack magic that can emit light balls with the power of the Holy Spirit. Using Shura-Broken Magic, you can summon your own clones to surround the enemy and launch attacks. This is the highest attack magic in the healing system.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote single target attack skills, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 把一定范围内濒死的人物同时复活的技能。复活的人物在一定时间内魔法抵抗力会有提高。
translation: A skill that resurrects dying characters within a certain range at the same time. Resurrected characters will have improved magic resistance for a certain period of time.

source_zh: 远程群体3×3范围复活技能，可以复活濒临死亡状态的同族角色，技能等级影响复活效果。
translation: Remote group 3×3 range resurrection skill, which can resurrect characters of the same race who are on the verge of death. The skill level affects the resurrection effect.

source_zh: 在你的祈祷过程中,空中凝聚光能,然后转换成光体。它彻底毁灭范围内的所有敌人，召唤强大的光能,取决于角色的智力。
translation: During your prayer process, light energy is condensed in the air and then converted into light body. It completely destroys all enemies within range, summoning powerful light energy, depending on the character's intelligence.

source_zh: 远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 5×5 range attack skill, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 在激烈的战场上,医生很难给所有伤者使用一个治疗技能。一些高级医生发明新回复能力可探测到人类光环并且进行远程蔓延性治疗以节省不少时间。
translation: In a fierce battlefield, it is difficult for doctors to use one treatment skill for all the injured. Some senior doctors have invented new healing abilities that can detect human auras and perform long-distance spreading treatments to save a lot of time.

source_zh: 转职远程群体5×5范围恢复血量技能，可以复活濒临死亡状态的同族角色，智力和转职等级影响复活效果。
translation: A 5×5 range health recovery skill for remote group transfers. It can resurrect characters of the same race who are on the verge of death. Intelligence and job transfer level affect the resurrection effect.

source_zh: 它给予敌人神圣的伤害以及转换魔王的能力给自己，智力严重影响其能力。
translation: It inflicts divine damage to the enemy and converts the ability of the Demon Lord to itself, and intelligence seriously affects its ability.

source_zh: 转职远程单体攻击技能，有一定几率持续伤害效果，智力和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: The long-range single-target attack skill of class change has a certain chance of continuous damage. Intelligence and class change level affect the skill damage.

source_zh: 从古老的起源开始,这个技能在战役中被不死之人使用着。它只被几个人操纵，使用审判之光时,光将伤害所有敌人。
translation: From ancient origins, this skill has been used by the immortals in battle. It is controlled by only a few people, and when using the Light of Judgment, the light will damage all enemies.

source_zh: 转职远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，智力和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: The 5×5 range attack skill for remote group transfer. Intelligence and job transfer level affect the skill damage.

source_zh: 吸血鬼们最畏惧具有很高信仰心的神父们的圣水。吸血鬼的肉身一旦碰到这种圣水就会立即萎缩。使用这种的魔法圣职者可将一般的水变成圣水。在使吸血鬼受伤，或者使用别的祝福魔法时圣水是必须的工具。
translation: Vampires are most afraid of the holy water of priests with high faith. Once the vampire's body touches this holy water, it will immediately shrink. Priests who use this magic can turn ordinary water into holy water. Holy water is a necessary tool when injuring vampires or using other blessing magic.

source_zh: 制造技能，可以将圣水瓶变化为攻击圣水，领域等级影响制造效果。
translation: Manufacturing skill can change the holy water bottle into attack holy water. The field level affects the manufacturing effect.

source_zh: 发射光球攻击对方。也可进行远距离攻击。
translation: launches light balls to attack the opponent. Can also perform long-distance attacks.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote single target attack skills, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 圣职者们一个人处于黑暗中时可以召唤圣光驱散黑暗。使用此魔法可使周围地带变亮并扩大视野。熟练度越高照亮的范围也越广。
translation: When the priests are alone in darkness, they can summon the Holy Light to dispel the darkness. Use this magic to brighten the surrounding area and expand your field of vision. The higher the proficiency, the wider the illuminated range.

source_zh: 增益技能，增加自身视野，技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: Gain skills, increase your own vision, skill level affects the gain effect.

source_zh: 通过圣灵的眼睛可以发现任何藏匿着的邪恶力量。使用此魔法可找出藏在地下的吸血鬼的踪迹。不过只能自己一个人看到而别人则看不到。即圣职者要通过对话或者行动指出吸血鬼的位置。
translation: Any hidden evil power can be discovered through the eyes of the Holy Spirit. Use this magic to find traces of vampires hiding underground. But only you can see it and no one else can. That is, the cleric must point out the location of the vampire through dialogue or actions.

source_zh: 增益技能，使自身或队友拥有探测隐蔽状态的能力。
translation: gain skill, giving yourself or your teammates the ability to detect concealment.

source_zh: 可通过圣职者真挚的祈祷来激发。能够给予邪恶力量相当大的破毁，随圣职者信仰的程度可自由自在地使用。技术越熟练给吸血鬼的杀伤力越强。
translation: can be inspired by the sincere prayers of the clergy. It can cause considerable damage to evil forces and can be used freely according to the degree of faith of the cleric. The more proficient the technology, the stronger the lethality of the vampire.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote single target attack skills, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 出色的圣职者们通过祝福自己或他人，来提高能力使得在战斗中处于不败之地。使用此魔法能把自己或其他人的所有能力值提高一定程度。熟练度越高增加能力值得持续时间和增加幅度都会越高。
translation: Excellent priests improve their abilities by blessing themselves or others to become invincible in battle. Using this magic can increase all abilities of yourself or others to a certain extent. The higher the proficiency, the higher the duration and increase range of the increased ability value.

source_zh: 增益技能，百分比增加自身或同族角色力量、敏捷、智力，智力和技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: Gain skills, percentage increases the strength, agility, intelligence of oneself or a character of the same race, intelligence and skill level affect the gain effect.

source_zh: 吸血鬼们可召唤能麻痹人的所有视觉和听觉地邪恶的黑暗之雾。使用此魔法可召唤能够驱走吸血鬼招来的浓雾的神圣的光。
translation: Vampires can summon an evil dark mist that paralyzes all vision and hearing. Use this magic to summon a sacred light that can drive away the fog attracted by vampires.

source_zh: 远程群体破除黑暗之触、黑暗神力效果，技能等级影响破除效果。
translation: Remote groups can break the effects of touch of darkness and dark divine power. The skill level affects the breaking effect.

source_zh: 吸血鬼们很本能地惧怕光和火。特别是如果他们的眼睛看到了强光就会在一段时内失明。圣职者们具有召唤强光的能力并以此驱赶吸血鬼。使用此魔法可使吸血鬼暂时失明。
translation: Vampires are instinctively afraid of light and fire. Especially if their eyes are exposed to bright light, they will go blind for a period of time. Priests have the ability to summon bright lights and use them to drive away vampires. Using this magic can temporarily blind a vampire.

source_zh: 远程单体降低目标视野技能，技能等级影响技能施放成功率。
translation: The remote single target reduces the target's vision skill, and the skill level affects the success rate of skill casting.

source_zh: 让藏在地下的吸血鬼出来使用一般方法是几乎不可能做到的。使用此魔法可以净化大地本身使得吸血鬼因无法忍受而自己钻出地表。熟练度提高时净化范围也会扩大。
translation: It is almost impossible to get a vampire hiding underground to come out using normal methods. Using this magic can purify the earth itself so that vampires can't bear it and crawl out of the ground on their own. As proficiency increases, the purification range will also expand.

source_zh: 远程群体5×5范围解除隐蔽效果，技能等级和目标等级影响解除效果。
translation: The remote group can remove the concealment effect within a 5×5 range. The skill level and target level affect the removal effect.

source_zh: 有效防止以地为媒介的魔法攻击
translation: Effectively prevents magic attacks based on the ground

source_zh: 远程群体3×3范围地板技能，在技能范围内无法施放黑暗之触、黑暗神力、酸性沼泽、地狱火海等技能。
translation: is a remote group 3×3 area floor skill. Skills such as Touch of Darkness, Dark Power, Acidic Swamp, and Sea of ​​Hellfire cannot be cast within the skill range.

source_zh: 圣职者可将圣力转换成环的形状围住吸血鬼。被包围的吸血鬼在一段时间内不能行动，而在圣力消失时受到强打击。
translation: The priest can convert the holy power into the shape of a ring to surround the vampire. Surrounded vampires are unable to move for a period of time and receive a strong blow when the holy power disappears.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote single target attack skills, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 直接参战的圣职者们可以给同僚的武器赐予祝福使得提高杀伤力。使用此魔法可以在一段时间内提高自己或别的人类手中的剑或刀，十字架等武器的杀伤力。熟练度越高杀伤力的增加量和持续时间。
translation: Priests who directly participate in the battle can bless their colleagues' weapons to increase their lethality. Using this magic can increase the lethality of swords, knives, crosses and other weapons in the hands of yourself or other humans for a period of time. The higher the proficiency, the increased amount and duration of lethality.

source_zh: 增益技能，给自身或同族角色增加物理伤害和魔法伤害，智力和技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: Buff skill, which increases physical damage and magic damage to yourself or characters of the same race. Intelligence and skill level affect the buff effect.

source_zh: 圣职者们通过做冥想来净化精神。每天他们都做冥想轻声呼唤主的名字，忏悔自己的罪过丢弃心中的邪恶。圣职者们通过这种途径能使自己松懈了的精神力量得以强化。圣职者们不会忘记拿着主赐予他们的十字架冥想。
translation: Priests practice meditation to purify their spirits. Every day they meditate and softly call the name of the Lord, repent of their sins and discard the evil in their hearts. Priests can strengthen their lax spiritual power through this method. The clergy never forget to meditate on the cross given to them by the Lord.

source_zh: 被动技能，百分比恢复自身魔法值，智力影响恢复效果。
translation: Passive skill, percentage recovery of own magic value, intelligence affects the recovery effect.

source_zh: 查出圣灵的眼睛无法找出的吸血鬼的魔法。使用此魔法可找出一段时间内进入视野的隐身状态的吸血鬼。不过别人看不到吸血鬼。要通过对话告诉别人吸血鬼的位置并用区域魔法进攻攻击。
translation: Detect vampire magic that the eyes of the Holy Spirit cannot find. Use this spell to find invisible vampires that have been in view for a period of time. But no one else can see the vampire. Tell others the location of the vampire through dialogue and attack with area magic attacks.

source_zh: 增益技能，使自身或队友拥有侦测隐身状态的能力。
translation: buff skill, giving yourself or your teammates the ability to detect stealth status.

source_zh: 将自己受到的打击，一部分反弹给对方。对方的攻击力越强，反弹的也越多，因此让对方难以攻击。
translation: Reflects part of the blow he receives to the opponent. The stronger the opponent's attack power, the more it will rebound, thus making it difficult for the opponent to attack.

source_zh: 增益技能，受到近身物理攻击时，会将伤害的一定比例反射给攻击者，智力和技能等级影响反射伤害。
translation: gain skill, when receiving a close physical attack, a certain proportion of the damage will be reflected to the attacker. Intelligence and skill level affect the reflected damage.

source_zh: 利用神圣的光环冻结敌人攻势的魔法。圣职者施魔法的时候吸血鬼攻击的一部分将反弹到自身。此魔法只能在自身施展，而且只有少数有实力的圣职者才拥有这种魔法。
translation: A magic that uses a sacred aura to freeze the enemy's attack. When the cleric casts magic, part of the vampire's attack will be reflected back to himself. This magic can only be cast on oneself, and only a few powerful priests possess this magic.

source_zh: 增益技能，受到部分伤害时，会将伤害的一定比例反馈给攻击者，同时用魔法值抵消受到的伤害。
translation: buff skill, when receiving partial damage, a certain proportion of the damage will be fed back to the attacker, and at the same time, the magic value will be used to offset the damage received.

source_zh: 用圣职者做出的圣光使透明的吸血鬼慢慢现身的魔法。圣职者的这种技术起初只能让小范围内隐身状态的吸血鬼现身，随着熟练度提高可扩大范围。
translation: A magic that uses the holy light created by the priest to slowly reveal a transparent vampire. This technique of the priest can only make invisible vampires appear in a small area at first. As the proficiency increases, the range can be expanded.

source_zh: 远程群体5×5范围解除隐身状态。
长期以来对邪恶力量进行研究的圣职者们发现由自身信仰激发出的光能给邪恶力量带来更大的打击。被这种神圣的光照射到的吸血鬼将受到致命打击。
translation: Priests who have long studied evil forces have discovered that the light energy inspired by their own beliefs brings a greater blow to evil forces. Vampires exposed to this divine light will be fatally struck.

source_zh: 远程群体5×5范围多段攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 5×5 range multi-stage attack skill, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 经过长期修炼的圣职者可通过耗尽自己的生命来制造某种禁区。在一定时间内，将无法进出这个禁区。
translation: Priests who have practiced for a long time can create some kind of restricted area by draining their own lives. It will be impossible to enter or exit this restricted area for a certain period of time.

source_zh: 地板技能，以自身为中心施放3×3范围的屏障，让任何目标都无法进入技能范围。
translation: Floor skill, casts a 3×3 range barrier centered on itself, preventing any target from entering the skill range.

source_zh: 将神的力量附加到盔甲上使被施法者的防御力暂时增加，但会降低体力
translation: Adding God's power to armor temporarily increases the caster's defense, but reduces physical strength.

source_zh: 增益技能，给自身或同族角色增加回避率，智力和技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: buff skill, which increases the evasion rate for yourself or characters of the same race. Intelligence and skill level affect the buff effect.

source_zh: 将强大的精神力散发于周围，使敌人陷入恐怖与混乱的高级技术。以施展人为中心的一定半径内的所有敌人都会进入休眠状态。且入睡同时还会受到伤害。
translation: is an advanced technique that spreads powerful spiritual power around, plunging enemies into terror and chaos. All enemies within a certain radius centered on the caster will enter a dormant state. And you will be hurt while falling asleep.

source_zh: 以自身为中心群体5×5范围攻击技能，附带催眠效果，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: A 5×5 range attack skill centered on oneself, with a hypnotic effect. Intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 具有很高精神力的圣职者可以具体表现自己的灵魂。练就此技术可以将自己灵魂的一部分转换成具体的形态保护自己。
translation: Priests with high spiritual power can embody their souls. By practicing this technique, you can transform part of your soul into a specific form to protect yourself.

source_zh: 增益技能，召唤精灵护卫，对靠近自身的目标造成伤害，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Gain skills, summon elf guards, cause damage to targets close to you, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 利用神的力量惩罚心灵受到污染的堕落者，使他们的灵魂脱离肉体，逐渐死亡
translation: Use the power of God to punish the corrupted whose souls are polluted, causing their souls to separate from their bodies and gradually die.

source_zh: 远程单体攻击技能，附带持续伤害效果，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote single target attack skill, with continuous damage effect, skill level affects skill damage.

source_zh: 教皇厅的圣职者们对吸血鬼的黑暗魔法进行了很长时间的研究，终于发现了能使其无效的魔法光明。受到圣职者的光明魔法的人类们可以在黑暗中看清藏身于其中的所有吸血鬼。在黑暗中也能拥有跟平常一样的视野。
translation: The clergy of the Holy See have been studying the dark magic of vampires for a long time, and finally discovered the magical light that can make it invalid. Humans who are affected by the light magic of the priests can see all the vampires hiding in the darkness. You can have the same vision as usual in the dark.

source_zh: 增益技能，使自身或同族角色拥有透视黑暗之触、黑暗神力的能力。
translation: Gain skills, giving yourself or characters of the same race the ability to see through the touch of darkness and the power of darkness.

source_zh: 可以随便调整攻击范围大小的技能。选择攻击中心地点后用鼠标拖动即可调整攻击范围。攻击范围和破坏力成反比，只攻击一块时能够发挥最强的破坏力。
translation: A skill that can adjust the size of the attack range at will. Select the attack center location and drag it with the mouse to adjust the attack range. The attack range and destructive power are inversely proportional, and the strongest destructive power can be exerted when attacking only one piece.

source_zh: 远程群体5×5范围多段攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Remote group 5×5 range multi-stage attack skill, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 祝福最高等级的辅助魔法，使用于人类身上,可增加他们的回避,防御。相反,使用于异族可造成回避,防御减少。它本身就是个攻防兼备的技能。
translation: Bless the highest level of auxiliary magic, which can be used on humans to increase their avoidance and defense. On the contrary, using it on foreign races can cause avoidance and reduce defense. It is an offensive and defensive skill in itself.

source_zh: 增（减）益技能，给自身或同族角色使用增加生命力、回避率、防御率，智力和技能等级影响增益效果；给其他目标使用，降低目标生命力、回避率，技能等级影响减益效果。
translation: Buff-increasing (debuffing) skills can be used on oneself or characters of the same race to increase vitality, evasion rate, and defense rate. Intelligence and skill level affect the benefit effect; used on other targets, the target's vitality and evasion rate can be reduced. Skill level affects the debuff effect.

source_zh: 那些重生的人经过高级训练后,可凭周围的波腐蚀范围目标。虽然格蓝替没有强大的力量,他可减弱多个敌人,达到扭转战斗的效果。
translation: After advanced training, those who are reborn can use the surrounding waves to corrode targets in the range. Although Granti doesn't have great strength, he can weaken multiple enemies and turn the battle around.

source_zh: 转职远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，如果目标为怪物附带生命力互换机制，智力和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: is a 5×5 range attack skill for remote group transfer. If the target is a monster, it comes with a vitality exchange mechanism. Intelligence and job transfer level affect the skill damage.

source_zh: 它带着天堂的土壤来到这个真实的世界。吸血鬼和魔灵将失去能力,并且被伤害，提升智力和敏捷学习这个技能。
translation: It brings the soil of heaven to this real world. Vampires and Ousters will lose their abilities and be damaged, and their intelligence and agility will be improved by learning this skill.

source_zh: 转职远程群体5×5范围地板技能，在技能范围内造成持续伤害，附带消除黑暗之触、酸性沼泽、黑暗神力、艳黄之毒、荧绿之毒、血墙、冰之领域、地狱火海、地狱火、大地之怒、神耀印记等技能，智力和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: A 5×5 area floor skill for remote group transfer, which causes continuous damage within the skill range. It also eliminates the touch of darkness, acidic swamp, dark power, yellow poison, green poison, blood wall, ice field, sea of ​​​​fire, hellfire, wrath of the earth, divine mark and other skills. Intelligence and job transfer level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 集中精力,召唤荆棘光环保护抵制敌人的攻击。可攻击周围的敌人，智力影响杀伤。
translation: Concentrate and summon a halo of thorns to protect and resist enemy attacks. Can attack surrounding enemies, and intelligence affects the damage.

source_zh: 转职增益技能，召唤精灵护卫，对靠近自身的目标造成伤害，智力和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Job transfer gain skills, summon elf guards, causing damage to targets close to you, intelligence and job transfer level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 熟练掌握毒性的吸血鬼，将一些弱性毒气聚集于自己尖尖的指甲上并攻击敌人。此时，被攻击人除了机械伤害之外还会受到附加的毒性伤害。但对于具有抗毒本能的吸血鬼这种附加伤害不会起任何作用。
translation: A vampire who is proficient in poison, gathers some weak poisonous gas on his pointed nails and attacks the enemy. At this time, the attacked person will also suffer additional poisonous damage in addition to mechanical damage. But this additional damage will have no effect on vampires with anti-venom instincts.

source_zh: 毒系近程单体攻击技能，智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Poison-type short-range single-target attack skill, intelligence affects skill damage.

source_zh: 召唤绿色致命毒气的魔法。这种毒气不会扩散且容易分辨所以易于躲闪，可是一旦接触到了就会对呼吸道产生严重伤害，若长时间接触还会有生命危险。由于吸血鬼们不需要呼吸因此这种毒气对他们不构成任何威胁。
translation: Magic that summons green deadly poisonous gas. This poisonous gas does not spread and is easy to distinguish, so it is easy to dodge. However, once it comes into contact, it will cause serious damage to the respiratory tract and may be life-threatening if exposed for a long time. Since vampires do not need to breathe, this poison poses no threat to them.

source_zh: 毒系地板技能，远程施放绿毒，使处于绿毒范围内的目标有几率受到持续减少生命力的效果，智力影响技能释放成功率和伤害。
translation: Poison-type floor skill, which casts green poison remotely, so that targets within the green poison range have a chance of being continuously reduced by the effect of reducing vitality. Intelligence affects the success rate and damage of skill release.

source_zh: 召唤可暂时降低人的视力的黄色毒气的魔法。被中毒后眼睛会迷糊只能看到近身的很小范围，而不能攻击远处的敌人。不过不吸入这种毒气而躲开了之后可完全不受毒气的影响。
translation: A magic that summons yellow poisonous gas that temporarily reduces a person's vision. After being poisoned, your eyes will be blurred and you can only see a small area close to you, but you will not be able to attack distant enemies. However, after avoiding the poisonous gas without inhaling it, you will be completely unaffected by the poisonous gas.

source_zh: 毒系地板技能，远程施放黄毒，使处于黄毒范围内的敌人有几率受到视野降低效果，智力影响技能释放成功率和伤害。
translation: Poison-type floor skill, which casts yellow poison remotely, so that enemies within the yellow poison range have a chance of being affected by vision-reducing effects, and intelligence affects the success rate and damage of skill release.

source_zh: 若将此魔法施于特定生物，在这个生物的周围总是跟随着绿色毒气。一旦中了此魔法，就算是进行治疗，毒气还是会在身体周围，体力仍然会一直下降。到目前为止尚我们未找到解毒方法。所以只能祈祷不被施毒成功了。
translation: If this magic is cast on a specific creature, green poisonous gas will always follow the creature. Once you are under this spell, even if you receive treatment, the poisonous gas will still be around your body and your physical strength will continue to decrease. So far we have not found an antidote. So I can only pray that I won't be poisoned.

source_zh: 毒系远程单体攻击技能，使目标持续降低生命力，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Poison-based long-range single-target attack skills continuously reduce the target's vitality, intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting, and strength and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 召唤可使人的集中力衰退的蓝色毒气的魔法。使用此魔法可以让人类的MP持续下降使得他们无法使用技术和魔法。这种毒可持续到所有MP全部消失，而只有圣职者的魔法才能解毒。
translation: A magic that summons blue poisonous gas that weakens a person's concentration. Using this magic can cause humans' MP to continue to decrease, making them unable to use technology and magic. This poison lasts until all MP disappears, and only the magic of the priest can detoxify it.

source_zh: 毒系远程单体攻击技能，使目标持续降低魔法值，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Poison-type long-range single-target attack skill, which continuously reduces the target's magic value, intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting, and strength and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 利用毒给予对方很多伤害的魔法。此魔法可以使敌人一次性受到很大伤害而且其攻击速度也很快。不过要消耗很多体力。
translation: A magic that uses poison to inflict a lot of damage to the opponent. This magic can cause the enemy to take a lot of damage at once and its attack speed is also very fast. But it takes a lot of energy.

source_zh: 毒系远程单体攻击技能，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Poison type long-range single target attack skill, intelligence affects skill casting success rate, strength and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 从天上发起猛烈毒攻击的技术。绿色的毒是给进入供给范围的所有物体用致命毒攻击的广域魔法。是为一次性抹杀多数敌人的毒性攻击但是要消耗很多体力。
translation: A technique that launches violent poison attacks from the sky. Green poison is a wide-area magic that attacks all objects that enter the supply range with deadly poison. It is a poisonous attack that can kill many enemies at once, but it consumes a lot of stamina.

source_zh: 毒系远程群体3×3范围多段攻击技能，智力影响技能施放成功率，阶级技能影响技能范围，力量和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Poison system long-range group 3×3 range multi-stage attack skills, intelligence affects skill casting success rate, class skills affect skill range, strength and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 使强酸性液体渗透到指甲间并以此进行攻击的技术。此时，被害一方除了受到物理上的破坏以外还受到附加的酸性破坏。强酸对人类和吸血鬼都具有破坏力，并降低正在使用的工具的耐久性。
translation: Technology that allows strong acidic liquid to penetrate between nails and attack them. At this time, in addition to physical damage, the victim also suffered additional acid damage. The acid is destructive to both humans and vampires, and reduces the durability of the tools being used.

source_zh: 酸系近程单体攻击技能，力量和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Acid-based short-range single-target attack skill, strength and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 一些级别较高的吸血鬼们，可在空中制造出强酸性液体并投向敌人。这种腐蚀性极强的酸性液体不仅能损伤人体，枪和刀还有防具等金属物品同样也能遭到破坏。
translation: Some higher-level vampires can create strong acidic liquids in the air and throw them at enemies. This highly corrosive acidic liquid can not only damage the human body, but also metal objects such as guns, knives, and armor.

source_zh: 酸系远程单体攻击技能，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Acid-based long-range single-target attack skill, intelligence affects skill casting success rate, and strength and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 吸血鬼们可在瞬间制造出强效酸性液体并散发于空中。这种魔法是酸矢的强化版，可以喷射更多的酸性液体球。这种酸可以融化掉对方的整个躯体，包括金属和宝石在内都会在瞬间化为灰烬。
translation: Vampires can instantly create powerful acidic liquids and disperse them into the air. This magic is an enhanced version of Acid Arrow, which can spray more acidic liquid balls. This acid can melt the opponent's entire body, including metals and gems, and they will be reduced to ashes in an instant.

source_zh: 酸系远程单体攻击技能，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Acid-based long-range single-target attack skill, intelligence affects skill casting success rate, and strength and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 吸血鬼们用这种可以腐蚀皮肤的酸随心所欲地进行攻击。即使是要消耗非常多的体力，他们只求能用一次强有力的攻击还以对方致命打击。由此发展的此魔法在具有强大威力的同时还要消耗相当大的体力。
translation: Vampires use this skin-corrosive acid to attack at will. Even if it takes a lot of physical strength, they just want to use a powerful attack to deal a fatal blow to the opponent. The magic developed from this is not only powerful but also consumes a lot of physical strength.

source_zh: 酸系远程单体攻击技能，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Acid-based long-range single-target attack skill, intelligence affects skill casting success rate, and strength and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 向地面散播酸性液体的魔法。过一段时间会消失但在消失之前给所有通过的人酸性伤害。道具的耐久性也会受影响但是通过之后不会再有任何伤害。
translation: Magic that spreads acidic liquid to the ground. It will disappear after a while but give acid damage to everyone who passes before disappearing. The durability of the item will also be affected but there will be no further damage after passing it.

source_zh: 酸系地板技能，远程施放沼泽，使处于沼泽范围内的目标持续减少生命力，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Acid floor skill, cast swamp remotely, causing targets within the swamp to continuously reduce their vitality, intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting, and strength and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 吸血鬼们可以使用大量的酸液随心所欲地进行攻击。使用这个魔法时虽然体力消耗较大，但是却能给大范围内的生物以致命的打击。
translation: Vampires can use large amounts of acid to attack at will. Although it consumes a lot of physical strength when using this magic, it can deal a fatal blow to creatures in a wide range.

source_zh: 酸系远程群体3×3范围多段攻击技能，智力影响技能施放成功率，阶级技能影响技能范围，力量和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Acid type long-range group 3×3 range multi-stage attack skill, intelligence affects skill casting success rate, class skills affect skill range, strength and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 这个魔法是利用酸进行攻击，并把仇恨变成视觉上的假像，从而使敌人恐怖致死！
translation: This magic uses acid to attack and turns hatred into a visual illusion, thus making the enemy frightened to death!

source_zh: 酸系远程单体多段攻击技能，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量、敏捷和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Acid type long-range single-target multi-stage attack skill, intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting, and strength, agility and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 低级的吸血鬼使用毒或酸魔法，而长久以来以吸血为生的吸血鬼们连强大的黑魔法也可以使用。使用此魔法可以召唤来恶灵使得被害人被麻痹动弹不得。这种麻痹会在一段时间后消失但大部分人类们会在麻痹期间被吸血鬼杀死。圣职者的神圣魔法可以解除这种诅咒。
translation: Low-level vampires use poison or acid magic, but vampires who have long relied on blood for a living can also use powerful black magic. Using this magic, evil spirits can be summoned to paralyze the victim. This paralysis wears off after a while but most humans are killed by vampires during the period of paralysis. The holy magic of the clergy can lift this curse.

source_zh: 诅咒系减益技能，使目标无法移动、无法使用技能，智力影响技能施放成功率。
translation: Curse debuff skills make the target unable to move and use skills, and intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting.

source_zh: 吸血鬼可使用邪恶黑魔法的诅咒把人的命运引向不幸。此魔法可召唤黑暗的恶灵使被害者丧失很多防御力并奔向不幸。更为特殊的是这种魔法在人类和吸血鬼身上都能实现。可以用圣职者的恩宠解除此魔法，或等一段时间魔法效果就会消失。
translation: Vampires can use the curse of evil black magic to lead people's fate to misfortune. This magic can summon dark evil spirits to make the victim lose a lot of defense and run toward misfortune. What's even more special is that this kind of magic can be realized on both humans and vampires. This magic can be removed with the grace of a priest, or the magic effect will disappear after a period of time.

source_zh: 诅咒系减益技能，百分比降低目标回避率和防御率，智力影响技能施放成功率。
translation: Curse debuff skills, which reduce the target's avoidance rate and defense rate by a percentage, and intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting.

source_zh: 召唤富有魅力的女妖来引诱对方的此魔法使被诅咒的一方无论是吸血鬼还是人类都无法进行理性思考只能被女妖的魅力所迷惑住。一旦被诅咒就会使命中和伤害急剧下降，而当召唤结束后会恢复正常。
translation: This magic that summons a charming banshee to seduce the other party makes the cursed party, whether a vampire or a human, unable to think rationally and can only be beguiled by the charm of the banshee. Once cursed, the hit and damage will drop sharply, and return to normal when the summon ends.

source_zh: 诅咒系减益技能，百分比降低目标命中率和伤害值，智力影响技能施放成功率。
translation: Curse debuff skills, which reduce the target's hit rate and damage value by a percentage, and intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting.

source_zh: 是吸血鬼的诅咒魔法的最后阶段，用吸血鬼制造的幻影使人感到死亡的恐怖的魔法。犹如恶魔的灵魂吞噬人类般，被诅咒的人类对吸血鬼魔法的抵抗力会急剧减少。使用此魔法吸血鬼可将自己使用的魔法的效果极大化。
translation: is the final stage of vampire curse magic, a magic that uses the phantom created by the vampire to make people feel the horror of death. Just like demon souls devouring humans, the cursed humans' resistance to vampire magic will be drastically reduced. Using this magic vampire can maximize the effects of the magic he uses.

source_zh: 诅咒系减益技能，降低目标总抵抗能力，智力影响技能施放成功率。
translation: Curse debuff skills reduce the target's total resistance, and intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting.

source_zh: 诅咒系魔法中最邪恶的魔法，迷幻术的恶灵在软弱的人类的心中抢走了能够区分事物的意识，使得人类在幻想中徘徊。在幻想中徘徊的人类们为了摆脱迷幻术而挣扎着，不过结果还是用枪口互相对着对方。
translation: The most evil magic in curse magic, the evil spirit of psychedelic magic steals the consciousness that can distinguish things from the hearts of weak humans, causing humans to wander in fantasy. The human beings who were wandering in the fantasy struggled to get rid of the hallucinations, but in the end they still turned their guns on each other.

source_zh: 诅咒系减益技能，使目标会失去辨识能力，智力影响技能施放成功率。
translation: Curse-based debuff skills cause the target to lose its ability to identify, and its intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting.

source_zh: 吸血鬼们在远处也能召唤自己的安息处。进入棺以后可以治愈自己受到的所有伤害。当吸血鬼在棺里的时候会受到回避和防御的惩罚。在棺里的时候受到攻击，还是会受到伤害的因此不能被猎人发现。
translation: Vampires can summon their resting places from afar. After entering the coffin, you can heal all injuries you have received. A vampire takes avoidance and defense penalties while in a coffin. If you are attacked while in the coffin, you will still be hurt, so you cannot be discovered by Slayers.

source_zh: 召唤系变身技能，使自身变化为棺材状态，增加恢复生命力效果，百分比增加回避率和防御率。
translation: The summoning transformation skill changes oneself into a coffin state, increases the effect of restoring vitality, and increases the evasion rate and defense rate by a percentage.

source_zh: 即使是跟恶魔没有什么区别的吸血鬼，也会屈服于真正的恶魔。吸血鬼们为了得到自己想要的东西会不惜使用一切手段，其中一些还会把自己的灵魂出卖给恶魔莫皮斯托。
translation: Even vampires who are no different from demons will succumb to real demons. Vampires will use any means to get what they want, and some of them will sell their souls to the demon Mopisto.

source_zh: 召唤系增益技能，增加自身命中率、回避率、防御率，当自身生命力低于三分之一时，自动取消增益效果。此状态下无法自动恢复生命力，无法使用药水。
translation: Summoning system gain skill, which increases one's own hit rate, evasion rate, and defense rate. When one's own health is less than one-third, the gain effect will be automatically canceled. In this state, vitality cannot be restored automatically and potions cannot be used.

source_zh: 能形成用鲜血组成的名为血腺的召唤体，它是可以使周边地区遭到的攻击增强的招唤系魔法。被召唤的血腺可以在一定时间内的一定地点上向周围喷血，以增强攻击。
translation: can form a summoned body called a blood gland made of blood. It is a summoning magic that can enhance the attacks in the surrounding area. The summoned blood glands can spray blood to the surroundings at a certain location for a certain period of time to enhance the attack.

source_zh: 召唤系技能，召唤血管自动追击附近目标，辅助自身作战。
translation: Summoning skill, summons blood vessels to automatically chase nearby targets and assist oneself in combat.

source_zh: 熟练这个魔法,可以召唤恶魔,即死前所有生物必须看到的,给予敌人极痛伤害。恶魔自身的可怕力量可造成范围攻击，提升智力可增加其成功召唤率。
translation: If you are proficient in this magic, you can summon a demon, which all creatures must see before death, and inflict extremely painful damage to the enemy. The terrifying power of the demon itself can cause area attacks, and improving its intelligence can increase its successful summoning rate.

source_zh: 召唤系远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，智力影响技能施放成功率和技能伤害。
translation: Summoning remote group 5×5 range attack skill, intelligence affects skill casting success rate and skill damage.

source_zh: 吸血鬼们可利用黑魔法开启和关闭空间，也可移动。他们让一个具有记忆功能的特殊的蓝宝石记住地点然后开启空间并移动。因此即使是白天吸血鬼们也可随便行动而不受到光的影响。
translation: Vampires can use black magic to open and close spaces, and can also move. They let a special sapphire with memory function remember the location and then open the space and move around. Therefore, even during the day, vampires can move around without being affected by light.

source_zh: 血系传送技能，使用道具记忆印章，可以将自身传送至已标记的地图坐标点，智力影响传送次数。
translation: Bloodline teleportation skill. Using the prop memory seal, you can teleport yourself to the marked map coordinate point. Intelligence affects the number of teleportations.

source_zh: 为了能用血之旋涡魔法而使用以血液为能量的特殊宝石在到已经到过的地方做标记，吸血鬼们可以利用具有这种使用宝石的魔法自由的穿梭于不同的空间。使用此法术时血液的能量将被深埋于地下，而且每个宝石只有记得一个地点的能量，这个宝石也只能找到这个地方。
translation: In order to use blood vortex magic, special gems powered by blood are used to mark the places they have visited. Vampires can use the magic of using gems to freely travel through different spaces. When using this spell, the energy of the blood will be buried deep underground, and each gem can only remember the energy of one location, and this gem can only find this place.

source_zh: 血系传送标记技能，使用道具空记忆印章，可以标记此时自身所在的地图坐标点。
