translation: bloodline teleportation marking skill, using the prop empty memory seal, you can mark the map coordinate point where you are at this time.

source_zh: 在同僚快要死去的时候吸血鬼们也会给对方分一点自己的血。他们通过把自己的血分给种族，来加强彼此间的团结。
translation: When their colleagues are about to die, vampires will also share some of their own blood with each other. They strengthened their solidarity with each other by sharing their blood with the race.

source_zh: 血系复活技能，消耗自身生命力来恢复同族角色生命力，当同族角色处于濒临死亡状态，生命力大于三分之一时，同族角色会自动复活。
translation: Bloodline resurrection skill consumes one's own life force to restore the life force of characters of the same family. When the character of the same family is on the verge of death and the life force is greater than one-third, the character of the same family will be automatically resurrected.

source_zh: 将血的能量聚积在指甲间攻击敌人的魔法。由于血的缘故指甲变长了并释放出更强的攻击力，这个力量远远比使用毒或酸的攻击大得多。被攻击的对象就算进行了防御还是会被击破装备的！
translation: A magic that accumulates the energy of blood between the nails to attack the enemy. The nails grow longer due to the blood and release a stronger attack power, which is far greater than attacks using poison or acid. Even if the attacked object is defensive, its equipment will still be broken!

source_zh: 血系近程单体攻击技能，力量和敏捷影响技能伤害。
translation: Bloodline short-range single-target attack skills, strength and agility affect skill damage.

source_zh: 吸血鬼们可以自如地运用体内的血来进行攻击。这种技术是将血液做成锋利的物体并发射并攻击的魔法。作为远程魔法虽然相对有些弱但牵制靠近的人类还是绰绰有余。
translation: Vampires can freely use the blood in their bodies to attack. This technique is magic that turns blood into sharp objects and launches them to attack. Although it is relatively weak as a long-range magic, it is more than enough to contain approaching humans.

source_zh: 血系远程单体攻击技能，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Blood-based long-range single-target attack skills, intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting, and strength and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 完全精通血墙技术的吸血鬼能将此转换为血帐篷并用其莫大的攻击力给予大范围内的敌人致命打击。
translation: A vampire who is fully proficient in blood wall technology can convert this into a blood tent and use its huge attack power to deal a fatal blow to enemies in a wide range.

source_zh: 血系以自身为中心群体5×5范围攻击技能，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量、敏捷、智力影响技能伤害。
translation: The blood system has a 5×5 range attack skill with itself as the center. Intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting, and strength, agility, and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 吸血鬼们可以自如使用聚集于体内的血。他们欲发展出更强效更具杀伤力的魔法。这种魔法体力消耗大，但能一次性给于对方许多伤害。
translation: Vampires can freely use the blood collected in their bodies. They want to develop more powerful and more lethal magic. This kind of magic consumes a lot of physical energy, but it can inflict a lot of damage to the opponent at once.

source_zh: 血系远程单体攻击技能，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Blood-based long-range single-target attack skills, intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting, and strength and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 吸血鬼们可以自如的运用通过吸血聚集于体内的血的力量。他们是用聚集在体内的人血做成球体并给予对方物理攻击的技术。
translation: Vampires can freely use the power of blood accumulated in the body through sucking blood. They use the human blood collected in the body to form a sphere and give the opponent physical attacks.

source_zh: 血系远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量、敏捷和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Bloodline remote group 3×3 range attack skill, intelligence affects skill casting success rate, strength, agility and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 吸血鬼们可以自如地使用蓄于体内的血。将聚集着的血喷出并做成枪的形状，以此来攻击对方。高高射向空中的血枪坠落时的威力是相当大的。
translation: Vampires can freely use the blood stored in their bodies. It squirts out the accumulated blood and forms it into the shape of a gun to attack the opponent. The blood gun shot high into the air is quite powerful when it falls.

source_zh: 血系远程单体攻击技能，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量、敏捷和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Blood type long-range single target attack skill, intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting, and strength, agility and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 长期研究过魔法的吸血鬼们可将体内聚集的血液固体化并进行攻击。血墙是利用血的能量在大地上筑起血墙的技术，可以给人类致命的伤害。
translation: Vampires who have studied magic for a long time can solidify the blood accumulated in their bodies and attack. Blood wall is a technology that uses the energy of blood to build a blood wall on the earth, which can cause fatal harm to humans.

source_zh: 血系地板技能，远程施放群体1×4范围攻击技能，使处于血墙范围内的目标受到持续伤害，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Blood-based floor skill, which casts a group 1×4 range attack skill remotely, causing targets within the blood wall to suffer continuous damage. Intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting, and strength and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 将大量的血喷向前方扫射敌人的技术。血的消耗量大，但其杀伤力也非同小可，可以说是利用血的极限技术。
translation: A technique that sprays large amounts of blood forward to strafe enemies. The consumption of blood is large, but its lethality is also extraordinary. It can be said to be the ultimate technique for utilizing blood.

source_zh: 血系远程群体范围攻击技能，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量、敏捷和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Bloodline long-range group range attack skills, intelligence affects skill casting success rate, strength, agility and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 吸血族专用强力魔法，用强大腿部肌肉产生跳跃，离开敌人的视野再进行攻击，具有强大攻击力
translation: A powerful magic specially designed for vampires. It uses powerful leg muscles to jump and leave the enemy's sight before attacking. It has powerful attack power.

source_zh: 血系远程单体攻击技能，可快速移动到目标身边，力量、敏捷和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: Blood-based long-range single-target attack skill, which can quickly move to the target. Strength, agility and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 所有的吸血鬼在出行时都会让随从们为自己准备一个可以休息的棺材。但是，如果碰上突发情况-例如遇到了强敌，或为了新鲜的血液远行时与棺材距离太远或者太阳马上要升起自己却来不及回到棺材的时候就会马上在周围的地面上挖一个洞作为临时藏身之处。吸血鬼挖的洞一般的人是很难发现的，但是专门的吸血鬼猎人可以感知吸血鬼身上散发出的邪恶的气息从而发现洞。
translation: When traveling, all vampires will ask their followers to prepare a coffin for them to rest in. However, if there is an unexpected situation - such as encountering a strong enemy, or being too far away from the coffin when traveling for fresh blood, or the sun is about to rise but there is no time to return to the coffin, they will immediately dig a hole in the surrounding ground as a temporary hiding place. The holes dug by vampires are difficult for ordinary people to find, but specialized vampire Slayers can detect the holes by sensing the evil aura emanating from vampires.

source_zh: 默认系变身技能，使自身变身为埋地状态，对人族和魔族附带隐藏效果，增加自身生命力恢复效果。
translation: is a default transformation skill that transforms oneself into a buried state, has a hidden effect on humans and Ousters, and increases one's own vitality recovery effect.

source_zh: 聪明的古代吸血鬼认识到小吸血鬼虽然伶俐，但缺乏身体能力，因此近战攻击相对比较弱。他们开始研究魔法来弥补这个缺陷，最终使得小吸血鬼也具有了强大的近战攻击能力。
translation: The wise ancient vampires realized that although the young vampires were intelligent, they lacked physical abilities and therefore were relatively weak in melee attacks. They began to study magic to make up for this shortcoming, and eventually the little vampire also had powerful melee attack capabilities.

source_zh: 默认系远程单体攻击技能，力量和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: is a long-range single-target attack skill by default. Strength and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 召唤能使任何人的视觉和听觉在瞬间成为无用之物的，邪恶的黑暗之雾的魔法。具有红外线视觉能力的吸血鬼仍能清楚地看到物体，特别是这种雾不仅用于隐藏吸血鬼的行踪而且也能使人们在重雾中迷失方向。很多人曾经由于这种雾成了吸血鬼的食物。
translation: A magic that summons an evil dark mist that can render anyone's vision and hearing useless in an instant. Vampires with infrared vision can still see objects clearly, especially since this fog is used not only to hide the vampire's whereabouts but also to disorient people in heavy fog. Many people have become vampire food because of this fog.

source_zh: 默认系远程群体3×3范围地板技能，在技能范围内可以隐藏自身行踪，人族或魔族角色进入技能范围会降低视野，智力影响技能施放成功率，阶级技能影响技能范围。
translation: is a remote group 3×3 area floor skill by default. You can hide your whereabouts within the skill range. Human or Ousters characters entering the skill range will reduce their vision. Intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting, and class skills affect the skill range.

source_zh: 吸血鬼利用天生具有的魔法能力，可以轻易的变形成为其他动物的样子。其中小而迅速的蝙蝠是潜逃时的最佳选择。吸血鬼变成蝙蝠后移动速度会提高200%，而且不会受到刀和剑之类的近战武器的伤害。但是变成蝙蝠之后不能进行攻击和吸血，防御力也会急剧下降，因此不小心的话会更容易死掉。
translation: Vampires can easily transform into other animals by using their natural magical abilities. Among them, small and fast bats are the best choice when absconding. After transforming into a bat, a vampire will move 200% faster and will not be damaged by melee weapons such as knives and swords. However, after turning into a bat, you cannot attack or suck blood, and your defense will drop sharply, so you will die more easily if you are not careful.

source_zh: 默认系变身技能，使自身变身为蝙蝠状态，增加自身移动速度，百分比降低自身回避率和防御率。
translation: The default transformation skill is to transform oneself into a bat state, increase one's own movement speed, and reduce one's own evasion rate and defense rate by a percentage.

source_zh: 吸血鬼利用天生具有的魔法能力，可以轻易地变形成为其他动物的样子。快速而强力的狼也是吸血鬼经选择变形的动物之一。变成狼之后移动速度会提高150%，因此远距离移动时吸血鬼经常使用这个魔法。吸血鬼在变成狼之后还可以进攻，更能吃掉怪物的尸体以增加自己的HP。但是防御力相比吸血鬼状态时要低一点，所以使用在战斗中是不太合算的变身魔法。
translation: Vampires can easily transform into other animals by using their natural magical abilities. The fast and powerful wolf is also one of the animals vampires choose to transform into. After turning into a wolf, the movement speed will be increased by 150%, so vampires often use this magic when moving long distances. Vampires can still attack after turning into wolves, and can even eat monster corpses to increase their HP. However, the defense power is a little lower than that in the vampire state, so it is not cost-effective to use transformation magic in battle.

source_zh: 默认系变身技能，使自身变身为小狼状态，增加自身命中率、伤害值、移动速度，百分比降低自身回避率和防御率。
translation: The default transformation skill is to transform oneself into a wolf state, increase one's hit rate, damage value, movement speed, and reduce one's own evasion rate and defense rate by a percentage.

source_zh: 狼族拥有相当惊人的敏捷性攻击力，相对的，他们的防御力会比较的弱，但是，狼族会有一种独特的魔法，通过嚎叫提高自己的能力，我们的祖先与狼族签订了血的契约，从而使得我们也能延续的使用着这个神奇的魔法
translation: The wolves have quite amazing agility and attack power. In contrast, their defense is relatively weak. However, the wolves have a unique magic that improves their abilities through howling. Our ancestors signed a blood contract with the wolves, so that we can continue to use this magical magic.

source_zh: 默认系增益技能，增加自身回避率、防御率。
translation: is a gain skill by default, which increases one's own evasion rate and defense rate.

source_zh: 傍晚一个人走在街上有没有过被人盯着的感觉？有过无论你怎么找也找不到任何人但就是让你毛骨悚然的经历吗？这就说明你以前遇到过吸血鬼。一些年老的吸血鬼可以在不为人所知地情况下用魔法将自己隐藏并行动。隐身了的吸血鬼可以悄声无息地移动，但在攻击人的瞬间会原形毕露。巴提干的优秀的圣职者们可以识破这些透明的吸血鬼并拥有可以使这种魔法失效的神圣力量。
translation: Have you ever felt like you were being stared at when walking alone on the street in the evening? Have you ever had an experience where you couldn't find anyone no matter how hard you looked, but it just gave you the creeps? This means you have encountered vampires before. Some older vampires can use magic to hide themselves and move without being noticed. An invisible vampire can move silently, but will reveal its true colors the moment it attacks someone. The outstanding clerics of Baltican can see through these transparent vampires and possess the divine power to disable such magic.

source_zh: 默认系增益技能，使自身处于隐藏状态，附带持续降低生命力效果，人族、魔族无法看到自己。
translation: is a buff skill by default, which makes oneself in a hidden state, with the effect of continuously reducing vitality. Humans and Ousters cannot see themselves.

source_zh: 瞬间喷发吸血鬼体内的血，掀起飓风般动静的技术。此技术用于缩短与对方的距离或躲避攻击时，由于快速移动而产生的重影能把对方迷惑住。可以瞬间移动2~6米，保持自己的距离。
translation: A technique that instantly erupts the blood in a vampire's body, creating a hurricane-like movement. This technique is used to shorten the distance with the opponent or when avoiding attacks. The ghost image produced by fast movement can confuse the opponent. You can move 2 to 6 meters instantly and keep your distance.

source_zh: 默认系位移技能，可快速移动到指定位置，敏捷影响施放距离。
translation: is a displacement skill by default, which can quickly move to a designated location, and agility affects the casting distance.

source_zh: 由于武士们的盔甲越来越厚，物理攻击已经失去了意义。但是利用指甲的攻击是可以通过对方的血液延续自己生命和魔力的重要工具。因此吸血鬼们每次吸收对方的血，将更为锐利的魔力吹入指甲中。
translation: As the armor of the samurai became thicker and thicker, physical attacks had lost their meaning. However, attacks using nails are an important tool that can extend one's life and magic power through the opponent's blood. Therefore, every time the vampires absorb each other's blood, they blow sharper magic into their nails.

source_zh: 默认系被动技能，增加自身伤害值。
translation: is a passive skill by default, which increases its own damage value.

source_zh: 年老吸血鬼的数量不会增长，是因为吸血鬼也会有以外事故或者被那些追击的人类夺走性命。眼看着最亲近的吸血鬼死去，这些野蛮并强大的吸血鬼们有时也会体现出不太与自身相称的同族之爱，并极度愤怒。得知愤怒时力量加倍的秘密的智商比较高的吸血鬼们经过共同探索现在已经可以故意燃烧自身的血并获得惊人的能量。
translation: The number of old vampires will not increase because vampires will also have accidents or be killed by chasing humans. Seeing the vampires closest to them die, these savage and powerful vampires sometimes show love for their own kind that is not commensurate with themselves, and become extremely angry. Vampires with higher IQs who have learned the secret of doubling their strength when angry can now deliberately burn their own blood and gain amazing energy through joint exploration.

source_zh: 默认系增益技能，增加自身伤害值、命中率，力量和敏捷影响增益效果。
translation: is a gain skill by default, which increases its own damage value, hit rate, strength and agility to affect the gain effect.

source_zh: 将皮肤变的像石头般坚硬,还可以燃烧石头的宇宙，能弹出一些枪弹
translation: makes the skin as hard as stone, can also burn the stone universe, and can eject some bullets

source_zh: 默认系增益技能，有一定几率抵消人族枪领域攻击技能伤害，此状态下无法自动恢复生命力，无法变身小狼和狼人，智力影响增益效果。
translation: is a buff skill by default. It has a certain chance to offset the damage caused by human gun field attack skills. In this state, it cannot automatically restore vitality, transform into a wolf or a werewolf, and intelligence affects the buff effect.

source_zh: 我们伟大的魔法师终于揭开了传说中被封闭的神秘魔法，使得我们可以变身成为狼族最强的战士--狼人，从而让我们拥有了强大的攻击和防御能力。
translation: Our great magician finally unveiled the mysterious magic that was sealed in the legend, allowing us to transform into the strongest warrior of the wolf clan - the werewolf, thus giving us powerful attack and defense capabilities.

source_zh: 默认系变身技能，使自身变身为狼人状态，增加自身伤害值、总抵抗能力，增加百分比命中率。
translation: The default transformation skill is to transform oneself into a werewolf state, increase one's own damage value, total resistance ability, and increase the percentage hit rate.

source_zh: 随着吸血族智能的发达，他们的魔法能力也变强
translation: As the intelligence of vampires develops, their magical abilities also become stronger.

source_zh: 默认系远程群体3×3范围地板技能，在技能范围内可以隐藏自身行踪，人族或魔族角色进入技能范围会降低视野，附带减免伤害效果，智力影响技能施放成功率。
translation: is a remote group 3×3 area floor skill by default. You can hide your whereabouts within the skill range. Human or Ousters characters entering the skill range will reduce their field of vision, with damage reduction effects, and intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting.

source_zh: 吸血族对血容易兴奋，这个功能使吸血处冷静状态而提高他们的能力
translation: Vampires are easily excited by blood. This function puts the vampires in a calm state and improves their abilities.

source_zh: 默认系远程单体攻击技能，力量和智力影响技能伤害。
translation: is a long-range single-target attack skill by default. Strength and intelligence affect skill damage.

source_zh: 吸血鬼长老可以用积累下来的精神力控制一些物体。用此技术引导宇宙空间的陨石，坠落在某个地点，其周围就会受到非常可怕的冲击破坏。
translation: Vampire elders can use their accumulated mental power to control some objects. If a meteorite that uses this technology to guide space falls into a certain location, its surroundings will be subject to terrible impact and damage.

source_zh: 默认系远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，智力影响技能施放成功率，力量、敏捷影响技能伤害。
translation: is a remote group attack skill with a 5×5 range by default. Intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting, and strength and agility affect skill damage.

source_zh: 在接近状态下，一定范围内迅速攻击目标的广域技能。不过要使用技能，必须装备一把HP消耗很大的双刃剑。
translation: A wide-area skill that quickly attacks the target within a certain range when in close proximity. However, in order to use the skill, you must be equipped with a double-edged sword that consumes a lot of HP.

source_zh: 默认系远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，力量和敏捷影响技能伤害。
translation: is a remote group 3×3 range attack skill by default. Strength and agility affect skill damage.

source_zh: 在吸血鬼体内种族的根源,当你燃烧血液,产生巨大的能量。使用这个技能,可给予敌人极大的伤害。当运行于身体时这种能量呈现红光,当你的敌人看到时,他们会感到害怕。
translation: The root of the race in the vampire body, when you burn blood, generate huge energy. Using this skill, you can inflict great damage to the enemy. This energy appears red when running through the body, and when your enemies see it, they will feel scared.

source_zh: 默认系远程单体多段攻击技能，可快速移动到目标身边，附带强制击退效果，力量和敏捷影响技能伤害。
translation: is a long-range single-target multi-stage attack skill by default. It can quickly move to the target and has a forced knockback effect. Strength and agility affect skill damage.

source_zh:
吸血鬼通过吸血可享受不完全的永生。太久没有喝到血的吸血鬼会像一个饥饿的人一样慢慢死去。但是，相对于人来说能挺住相当长的时间，不过一定要在舒适的棺里充分睡眠。
渗透在血液中的特殊的力量是让吸血鬼死掉的肉身移动的真正原动力。吸血鬼能以消耗自己所吸取的血来施展特殊的魔法。这种魔力存在于有理性的，自知自身本性的所有吸血鬼身上。
translation: Vampires can enjoy incomplete immortality by sucking blood. A vampire who goes too long without drinking blood will slowly die like a starving person. However, it can last for a relatively long time compared to humans, but it must be fully slept in a comfortable coffin.The special power permeating the blood is the real driving force that makes the vampire's dead body move. Vampires can use the blood they suck to cast special magic. This magic exists in all vampires who are rational and aware of their own nature.

source_zh: 近程单体技能，当目标生命力低于三分之一时，可使用此技能吸收目标生命力并增加自身生命力，被吸血后的人族玩家会百分比降低命中率、伤害值、回避率、防御率。
translation: Short-range single-target skill. When the target's health is less than one-third, you can use this skill to absorb the target's health and increase your own health. After being sucked, the human player's hit rate, damage value, evasion rate, and defense rate will be reduced by a percentage.

source_zh: 当你变身成一只狼人,用这个技能代替吸血。当你吸干敌人的鲜血时,你会得到强大的力量。假如敌人力量薄弱,你可以直取其心脏。尽情享受从这活生生的心到足够满足你的黑暗欲望。
translation: When you transform into a werewolf, use this skill instead of draining blood. When you drain the blood of your enemies, you gain great power. If the enemy is weak, you can go straight for his heart. Enjoy everything from this living heart to enough to satisfy your dark desires.

source_zh: 默认系变身附带技能，变身狼人时可使用此技能攻击目标，当目标生命力低于三分之一时，有一定几率直接击杀目标。
translation: is a default skill that comes with the transformation. You can use this skill to attack the target when transforming into a werewolf. When the target's health is less than one-third, there is a certain chance of directly killing the target.

source_zh: 默认系变身附带技能，变身小狼时可使用此技能吞噬尸体，附带瞬间恢复自身生命力效果。
translation: The default transformation comes with skills. When transforming into a wolf, you can use this skill to devour corpses and have the effect of instantly restoring your own vitality.

source_zh: 默认系变身附带技能，变身小狼时可使用此技能吞噬尸体，附带瞬间恢复自身生命力效果。
translation: The default transformation comes with skills. When transforming into a wolf, you can use this skill to devour corpses and have the effect of instantly restoring your own vitality.

source_zh: 高级吸血鬼凭借血之契约可召唤野狼攻击敌人。血之契约操作者和野狼是主仆关系，狼靠吃尸体增加能量。
translation: Advanced vampires can use the blood contract to summon wild wolves to attack the enemy. The blood contract operator has a master-servant relationship with the wild wolf, and the wolf increases its energy by eating corpses.

source_zh: 转职远程单体多段攻击技能，附带强制击退效果，力量、敏捷和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: A long-range single-target multi-stage attack skill for job transfer, with a forced knockback effect. Strength, agility and job transfer level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 吸血鬼利用邪恶的灵魂使被其攻击者心态失常，那些被邪恶灵魂附体的人将失去意识。所以,他们的所有行为举止完全和原来截然不同。
translation: Vampires use evil spirits to make their attackers mentally disturbed, and those possessed by evil spirits will lose consciousness. Therefore, all their behaviors are completely different from before.

source_zh: 转职减益技能，附带降低目标移动和部分技能攻击速度效果，智力影响技能施放成功率。
translation: Job-changing debuff skills, with the effect of reducing target movement and attack speed of some skills, and intelligence affects the success rate of skill casting.

source_zh: 这个魔法将挥霍你的血液，这个诅咒魔法可以在一定的时间内困住周围的怪物，提升智力可增加范围麻痹的时效。
translation: This magic will squander your blood. This curse magic can trap surrounding monsters for a certain period of time. Improving intelligence can increase the duration of area paralysis.

source_zh: 转职减益技能，给自身增加诅咒效果，降低自身生命力、回避率、防御率，力量、敏捷和转职等级影响减益效果。此技能是血之盛宴技能的前置条件。
translation: Job transfer debuff skills add a curse effect to yourself, reduce your own vitality, evasion rate, defense rate, strength, agility and job transfer level affect the debuff effect. This skill is a prerequisite for the Blood Feast skill.

source_zh: 死灵的血既是好食物也是强大的武器，刺向敌人,他们会被诅咒和击退，它的威力是根据你的力量和敏捷的。
translation: The blood of the undead is both good food and a powerful weapon. Sting the enemy and they will be cursed and knocked back. Its power is based on your strength and agility.

source_zh: 转职远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，附带降低目标生命力、回避率、防御率效果，并快速移动到目标身边，力量、敏捷和转职等级影响技能伤害。使用此技能需要提前使用血之诅咒技能。
translation: A 5×5 area attack skill for remote group transfers, with the effect of reducing the target's vitality, evasion rate, and defense rate, and quickly moves to the target. Strength, agility, and job transfer levels affect skill damage. Using this skill requires using the Blood Curse skill in advance.

source_zh: 当你学会这个技能后,你可以转换你的血液成矛,并且给予敌人巨大的杀伤,无法躲避.它的威力是根据智力和敏捷的。
translation: When you learn this skill, you can convert your blood into a spear, and inflict huge damage to the enemy, which cannot be avoided. Its power is based on intelligence and agility.

source_zh: 转职远程单体攻击技能，附带群体5×5范围二次攻击，敏捷、智力和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: The long-range single-target attack skill for job transfer, with a group 5×5 range secondary attack. Agility, intelligence and job transfer level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 它是个强大的技能就像它那残酷而具毁灭性的名字，对周围的敌人快速乱舞，敏捷,力量影响其威力。
translation: It is a powerful skill just like its cruel and destructive name. It dances rapidly on the surrounding enemies, and its agility and strength affect its power.

source_zh: 转职远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，力量、敏捷和转职技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: The 3×3 range attack skill for long-range group transfer. Strength, agility and job transfer skill level affect the skill damage.

source_zh: 很久以前,吸血鬼可增加自身毒性，强壮的吸血鬼可激发毒液四溢，范围攻击。
translation: A long time ago, vampires could increase their own toxicity. Strong vampires could trigger venom to overflow and attack in a range.

source_zh: 转职远程群体5×5范围多段攻击技能，智力和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: A multi-stage attack skill with a 5×5 range for long-range group transfer. Intelligence and job transfer level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 可以从尸体吸收灵魂恢复自己的EP，制造HP恢复工具的技术。要制作HP恢复工具蛹要有幼虫。
translation: A technology that can absorb souls from corpses to restore one's own EP and create HP recovery tools. To make HP recovery tool pupae, you need larvae.

source_zh: 通用技能，可以吸收尸体恢复自身EP值，当背包拥有幼虫时，可将幼虫制造为恢复生命力的蛹。
translation: is a general skill that can absorb corpses to restore one's own EP value. When the backpack contains larvae, the larvae can be made into pupae to restore vitality.

source_zh: 乘着风精灵迅速移动的魔法，回避能力和魔法抵抗力随着角色等级而增加。此技能使用需要召唤风精灵的风精灵召唤石，风精灵召唤石可在商店购买。已经消耗完的风精灵召唤石可以修理再次使用。
translation: Riding on the magic of the wind spirit to move quickly, the evasion ability and magic resistance increase with the character level. This skill uses the Wind Elf Summoning Stone that requires summoning the Wind Elf. The Wind Elf Summoning Stone can be purchased in the store. The consumed Sylph Summoning Stone can be repaired and used again.

source_zh: 通用技能，当自身拥有风精灵召唤石时，可使用此技能召唤风精灵，提升自身移动速度、防御率、抵抗力总和。
translation: is a general skill. When you have the Wind Elf Summoning Stone, you can use this skill to summon the Wind Elf to increase your movement speed, defense rate, and total resistance.

source_zh:
逐渐自动恢复EP的技术，恢复量取决于技术等级。

通过风的中级精灵叙利艾尔的呵护，可以慢慢借来灵力。
translation: is a technology that gradually automatically restores EP. The amount of recovery depends on the technical level.Through the care of Suriel, the intermediate spirit of the wind, spiritual power can be slowly borrowed.

source_zh: 风系被动技能，持续恢复自身EP值，技能等级影响恢复效果。
translation: Wind passive skill, which continuously restores one's own EP value. The skill level affects the recovery effect.

source_zh:
在攻击魔法上赋予额外的杀伤力和补充功能。奖励的杀伤力和成功率取决于技能等级。

传授风的上级精灵震的强大风能量的魔法
translation: gives extra lethality and supplementary functions to attack magic. Bonus lethality and success rate depend on skill level.teaches the magic of powerful wind energy from the superior spirit of the wind, Zhen

source_zh: 风系被动技能，有一定几率触发魔法暴击效果，增加部分技能魔法伤害，附带强制击退效果，技能等级影响暴击伤害。
translation: Wind-based passive skills have a certain chance of triggering magic critical hit effects, increase the magic damage of some skills, and have a forced knockback effect. The skill level affects critical hit damage.

source_zh:
用EP抵挡一部分魔法杀伤力的技术，由EP的减少率取决于技术等级。

此魔法可以用给你借助力量的英灵们的呵护，抵御一部分魔法伤害。
translation:
is a technology that uses EP to resist part of the magic's lethality. The reduction rate of EP depends on the technology level.

This magic can be used to protect you from some magical damage with the help of heroic spirits.

source_zh: 风系主动技能，使自身附带精灵效果，可以通过消耗EP值来抵消部分魔法伤害，技能等级影响抵消效果。
translation: Wind-type active skill gives itself an elf effect, which can offset part of the magic damage by consuming EP values. The skill level affects the offset effect.

source_zh: 瞬间移动到指定的位置，无视移动途中的所有障碍物。
translation: Instantly move to the designated location, ignoring all obstacles on the way.

source_zh: 通用位移技能，可快速移动到指定位置，技能等级影响施放距离。
translation: is a general displacement skill that can quickly move to a designated location. The skill level affects the casting distance.

source_zh:
初级攻击技术，杀伤力随力量和技术等级增加。

奥斯特兹们具有强大的身体能力。为了培养这种能力，就要使用恰克拉姆武器。
translation: Primary attack technology, the lethality increases with strength and technical level.Osterz have great physical abilities. In order to develop this ability, Chakram weapons are used.

source_zh: 战斗系近程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat-type short-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh:
暂时提高自己防御力的技术，防御奖励随技术等级增加。
持续时间随敏捷和技术等级而增加，延时随敏捷减少。

将精神界的精灵中的悲哀精灵梅尔罗与自己的精神相融合的技术。做出泛出蓝光的悲哀的表情，模仿梅尔罗保护自己。
translation: A technique that temporarily improves one's defense power. The defense reward increases with the skill level.The duration increases with agility and skill level, and the delay decreases with agility.A technology that fuses Mellor, the sad elf among the elves in the spiritual world, with his own spirit. Make a sad expression that glows blue, imitating Melro to protect yourself.

source_zh: 战斗系增益技能，增加自身回避率，技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: Combat-type gain skills, increase one's own evasion rate, skill level affects the gain effect.

source_zh:
近距离攻击技术，杀伤力随强壮和技术等级增加。

召唤彩虹精灵伊利西斯的精气的技术，发散缕缕的光芒。受到攻击的人会产生自己全身被光线索缠绕的幻觉。
translation: Close attack technology, the lethality increases with strength and skill level.A technique that summons the spirit of the rainbow spirit Ilysses to emit rays of light. Those who are attacked will hallucinate that their entire bodies are wrapped in light threads.

source_zh: 战斗系近程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat-type short-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh:
增加命中率的技术，命中随着技术等级上升。

更相信自己能力的它们，由信任精灵佩伊特里斯赋予一种可以精确而又迅速攻击的能力。
translation: A technology that increases the hit rate. The hit rate increases with the skill level.They believe more in their own abilities, and are given the ability to attack accurately and quickly by the trusting elf Peitris.

source_zh: 战斗系被动技能，增加自身命中率，技能等级影响命中率加成效果。
translation: Combat-type passive skills increase one's own hit rate. The skill level affects the hit rate bonus effect.

source_zh:
用特定正确率增加致命攻击的攻击技术，其杀伤力由武器杀伤力和技能等级决定。

受到感情精灵布雷克罗志的呵护的技术，可以给予受到他的呵护的人勇气。
translation: An attack technique that increases fatal attacks with a specific accuracy rate. Its lethality is determined by the weapon's lethality and skill level.The technology of being protected by the emotional spirit Blake Rozhi can give courage to those who are protected by him.

source_zh: 战斗系近程单体攻击技能，有一定几率触发附加伤害，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat-type short-range single-target attack skills have a certain chance of triggering additional damage. The skill level affects the skill damage.

source_zh:
降低对方防御力的技术，其减少量取决于敏捷和强壮,技术等级。持续时间取决于敏捷,智力和技术等级，延时取决于敏捷。

瀑布精灵卡斯凯德具有瀑布一般强大的力量，在没有水的地方可发挥凝聚力量的能力。将卡斯凯德召唤来，乔装打扮成任意模样给对方施加强大的重力作用。对方的移动将变得非常缓慢，躲闪能力有所下降。
translation: A technique that reduces the opponent's defense. The amount of reduction depends on agility, strength, and technical level. The duration depends on Dexterity, Intelligence and Skill levels, and the delay depends on Dexterity.Cascade, the waterfall elf, has the power of a waterfall and can exert its power in places where there is no water. Summon Cascade, disguise yourself in any appearance, and exert powerful gravity on the opponent. The opponent's movement will become very slow and his dodge ability will be reduced.

source_zh: 战斗系减益技能，降低目标回避率，力量、敏捷和技能等级影响减益效果。
translation: Combat-type debuff skills, reduce the target avoidance rate, strength, agility and skill level affect the debuff effect.

source_zh:
强烈的攻击技术，杀伤力随技术等级增加。

从破坏精灵鲁伊内尔那里传授到的技术，并不是直接召唤的技术。仅仅召唤他的力量，赋予打击程度的技术。可在敌人的颈部，腹部，膝盖等部位同时加以打击，在强壮的体魄条件下课发挥最高的能力。
translation: Strong attack technology, the lethality increases with the technology level.The technique taught from the destruction spirit Ruinel is not a direct summoning technique. A technique that simply summons his power and imparts a level of blow. It can hit the enemy's neck, abdomen, knees and other parts at the same time, and it can display its highest ability under strong physical conditions.

source_zh: 战斗系远程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat-type long-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh:
可以暂时提高自己抵抗力的技术，奖励值随着力量增加。持续时间取决于敏捷和技术等级。

受到空气精灵王米内尔瓦的保护的技术。穿着最好的米内里尔盔甲的它们平时连召唤者们也不让看到自己。但如果召唤自己的精灵师处于危险时就会露出一点自己用自己的盔甲保护精灵师的样子。
translation: A technique that can temporarily improve one's resistance. The reward value increases with strength. Duration depends on Dexterity and Skill level.A technology protected by the Air Elf King Minerva. Wearing the finest Mineril armor, they usually don't even let their summoners see themselves. But if the elf who summoned him is in danger, he will show a little bit of using his own armor to protect the elf.

source_zh: 战斗系增益技能，增加自身防御率，技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: Combat-type gain skills, increase one's own defense rate, skill level affects the gain effect.

source_zh:
增加火的杀伤力的技术，须在1，2，3号精灵石中具有火的属性。杀伤力奖励值取决于敏捷和力量,成功率取决于精灵等级。

用具有火的属性的精灵石赋予恰克拉姆火之精灵卡萨的力量的技术。
translation: The technology to increase the lethality of fire must have the attribute of fire in Elf Stone No. 1, 2, and 3. The lethality bonus depends on agility and strength, and the success rate depends on the elf level.A technique that uses the spirit stone with the attribute of fire to give Chaklam the power of the fire spirit kasa.

source_zh: 战斗系被动技能，有一定概率触发附加伤害，1、2、3号精灵石槽位必须佩戴火灵石，力量和敏捷影响伤害效果。
translation: Combat-type passive skills have a certain probability of triggering additional damage. Fire Spirit Stones must be worn in Elf Stone slots 1, 2, and 3. Strength and agility affect the damage effect.

source_zh:
将对方的攻击速度减半的技术，须在1，2，3号精灵石中具有水的属性。持续时间取决于敏捷，成功率取决于精灵等级。

用水属性的精灵石，将冰精灵格留佩因的力量赋予恰克拉姆。
translation: The technique of halving the opponent's attack speed must have the attribute of water in Elf Stone No. 1, 2, and 3. Duration depends on agility, success rate depends on elf level.A water-attributed elf stone that bestows the power of the ice elf Griupein on Chakram.

source_zh: 战斗系被动技能，有一定概率触发降低目标攻击速度，1、2、3号精灵石槽位必须佩戴水灵石。
translation: Combat-type passive skill, which has a certain probability of triggering to reduce the target's attack speed. Water Spirit Stones must be worn in Elf Stone slots 1, 2, and 3.

source_zh:
让很大范围内的敌人受到大地伤害的技术，须在1，2，3号精灵石中具有大地属性。杀伤力奖励值取决于敏捷和强壮，成功率取决于精灵等级。

让大地精灵诺姆的力量赋予恰克拉姆的技术。类似于CRITICAL但没有补充效果。
translation: The technique that causes enemies within a wide range to be harmed by the earth must have the earth attribute in Elf Stone No. 1, 2, and 3. The lethality bonus depends on agility and strength, and the success rate depends on the elf's level.Let the power of the earth elf Nomu be given to Chakram's technology. Similar to CRITICAL but without supplementary effects.

source_zh: 战斗系被动技能，有一定概率触发附加3×3范围伤害，1、2、3号精灵石槽位必须佩戴土灵石，力量和敏捷影响伤害效果。
translation: Combat-type passive skills have a certain probability of triggering additional 3×3 range damage. Earth Spirit Stones must be worn in Elf Stone slots 1, 2, and 3. Strength and agility affect the damage effect.

source_zh:
用特定准确率引起对方攻击障碍的消极技术，要按顺序依次在1，2，3号精灵石中拥有火，水，大地属性。持续时间取决于敏捷，成功率取决于精灵等级。

将混沌精灵雷普里肯的力量赋予恰克拉姆的技术。此技术在所有使用恰克拉姆的近战中，按一定比例引起对方的攻击障碍。中了这种技术的角色或者怪兽暂时无法施展魔法，也不能召唤摩托车。
translation: A passive technique that uses a specific accuracy to cause obstacles to the opponent's attack. The Elf Stones No. 1, 2, and 3 must have the attributes of fire, water, and earth in that order. Duration depends on agility, success rate depends on elf level.A technology that imbues Chakram with the power of the Chaos Elf Riprican. This technique causes the opponent's attack obstacles in a certain proportion in all melee battles using Chakram. Characters or monsters affected by this technique are temporarily unable to cast magic or summon motorcycles.

source_zh: 战斗系被动技能，有一定概率触发限制目标无法使用技能效果，1、2、3号精灵石槽位必须分别佩戴火、水、土灵石。
translation: Combat-type passive skills have a certain probability of triggering and restricting the target from using the skill effect. Fire, water, and earth spirit stones must be worn in slots 1, 2, and 3 respectively.

source_zh: 将精灵的力量附着在轮上，使轮的刃变的更锋利。
translation: attaches the power of the spirit to the wheel, making the wheel's edge sharper.

source_zh: 战斗系增益技能，百分比增加自身命中率，技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: Combat-type gain skills, which increase your own hit rate by a percentage, and the skill level affects the gain effect.

source_zh: 将轮抡开攻击自己周围的所有敌人。
translation: will swing its wheels to attack all enemies around itself.

source_zh: 战斗系近程群体2×3范围攻击技能，有一定几率破除黑暗之触效果，力量、敏捷和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat-type short-range group 2×3 range attack skill, has a certain chance to break the effect of the touch of darkness, strength, agility and skill level affect the skill damage.

source_zh: 给盔甲上赋予水之精灵，使得魔灵在遭受攻击的时候可以减少所受到的伤害
translation: Gives the water spirit to the armor, so that the monster can reduce the damage it takes when attacked.

source_zh: 战斗系被动技能，有一定概率100%抵消物理伤害，1、2、3号精灵石槽位必须分别佩戴水、水、土灵石。
translation: Combat-type passive skills have a certain probability of 100% negating physical damage. Water, water, and earth spirit stones must be worn in the 1, 2, and 3 spirit stone slots respectively.

source_zh: 将杀气集中在一点并释放出去的能力。
translation: The ability to focus murderous energy on one point and release it.

source_zh: 战斗系远程单体攻击技能，有一定几率使目标附带持续伤害效果，敏捷和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat-type long-range single-target attack skills have a certain probability of causing continuous damage to the target. Agility and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 给轮赋予火之精灵的力量，以增加轮的攻击力
translation: Give the wheel the power of the fire spirit to increase the wheel's attack power

source_zh: 战斗系被动技能，有一定概率触发附加伤害，1、2、3号精灵石槽位必须分别佩戴火、火、土灵石，力量和敏捷影响伤害效果。
translation: Combat-type passive skills have a certain probability of triggering additional damage. Fire, fire, and earth spirit stones must be worn in slots 1, 2, and 3 respectively. Strength and agility affect the damage effect.

source_zh: 将破坏精灵的强大力量赋予轮上，使用者可以连续使用此技能攻击敌人，不过只有最强大的魔灵可以使用。
translation: gives the powerful power of the destruction spirit to the wheel. The user can continuously use this skill to attack the enemy, but only the most powerful monsters can use it.

source_zh: 战斗系远程单体攻击技能，力量和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat-type long-range single-target attack skills, strength and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 给轮赋予大地之精灵的力量，从而大幅增加轮的攻击力
translation: gives the wheel the power of the earth spirit, thereby greatly increasing the wheel's attack power.

source_zh: 战斗系被动技能，有一定概率触发群体7×7十字形范围伤害，1、2、3号精灵石槽位必须分别佩戴土、土、火灵石，力量和敏捷影响伤害效果。
translation: Combat-type passive skills have a certain probability of triggering group 7×7 cross-shaped area damage. The 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Elf Stone slots must be equipped with earth, earth, and fire spirit stones respectively. Strength and agility affect the damage effect.

source_zh: 通过与光之精灵签定契约将自己的速度提升至光速，可以穿过敌人的身体并给其伤害，可以杀伤一条直线上的所有敌人
translation: By signing a contract with the light elf, he can increase his speed to the speed of light. He can pass through the enemy's body and inflict damage to him. He can kill all enemies in a straight line.

source_zh: 战斗系远程群体攻击技能，可快速移动到指定位置，敏捷和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat long-range group attack skills, which can quickly move to a designated location. Agility and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 直接变身为光之精灵攻击敌人。
translation: directly transforms into a light elf to attack the enemy.

source_zh: 战斗系远程单体攻击技能，可快速移动到目标身边，力量、敏捷和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat-type long-range single-target attack skill, which can quickly move to the target. Strength, agility and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 将雷之精灵的力量赋予轮上并挥出，由于雷的特性，所以可以攻击一定范围内的敌人。
translation: gives the power of the thunder spirit to the wheel and swings it out. Due to the characteristics of thunder, it can attack enemies within a certain range.

source_zh: 战斗系远程群体攻击技能，力量、敏捷和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat long-range group attack skills, strength, agility and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 强化毁灭之枪的精通技能，技能等级越高它的破坏性也会越强。这种技能可以攻击3*3的区域。除了中心部分，其他部分的被动技能攻击性被动是不适用的。
translation: strengthens the proficiency skill of the Destruction Spear. The higher the skill level, the more destructive it will be. This skill can attack a 3*3 area. Except for the central part, the passive skills and offensive passives in other parts are not applicable.

source_zh: 战斗系被动技能，增强致命爆发技能攻击范围和伤害，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat passive skill, enhances the attack range and damage of fatal burst skills, and skill level affects skill damage.

source_zh: 强化致命蚀刻的精通技能，技能等级越高它的毁坏性和准确率也会越高。
translation: Strengthens the mastery skill of Deadly Etching. The higher the skill level, the higher its destructiveness and accuracy will be.

source_zh: 战斗系被动技能，增加致残之蛇的技能伤害，技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat passive skill, increases the skill damage of the crippled snake, and the skill level affects the skill damage.

source_zh: 这是一个带有幻觉的攻击技能,是精神领域的灵魂力量。当技能使用后,敌人会看到Chakrams像雨水一样从天而降,受到物理伤害，力量和敏捷影响其威力。
translation: This is an attack skill with illusion, which is the soul power in the spiritual realm. When the skill is used, enemies will see Chakrams falling from the sky like rain, taking physical damage, with strength and agility affecting its power.

source_zh: 战斗系远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，力量、敏捷和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat long-range group 5×5 range attack skill, strength, agility and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 使用短暂契约召唤高级风之灵魂-斯理昂攻击敌人，作为高级风神的斯理昂,他可以追踪敌人并且给予攻击。记住在你和斯理昂之间保持一定距离以维持相互的效果。
translation: Use a short-term contract to summon the advanced wind soul-Siliang to attack the enemy. As the advanced wind god Siliang, he can track the enemy and attack. Remember to keep some distance between you and Slion to maintain mutual effects.

source_zh: 战斗系转职远程单体攻击技能，附带一定范围内持续伤害效果，力量、转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat-type long-range single-target attack skills for job transfers, with continuous damage effects within a certain range. Strength and job transfer level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 当你实用这个技能的时候,Chakram将会飞向空中,然后攻击几个敌人。
translation: When you use this skill, Chakram will fly into the air and attack several enemies.

source_zh: 战斗系转职远程群体5×5范围多段攻击技能，力量、敏捷和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat type long-distance group 5×5 range multi-stage attack skills, strength, agility and class transfer level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 巴瑞昂娜克象征着光辉之枪,魔灵战士默默学习这个技能,并且已经熟悉了。舞动武器产生迫力造成范围敌人伤害，敏捷越高的战士,光亮极其亮并且可使敌人感到恐怖。
translation: Barionak symbolizes the Spear of Glory. The Ousters Warrior silently learns this skill and is already familiar with it. Dancing the weapon generates force and causes damage to enemies within a range. The higher the agility of the warrior, the light is extremely bright and can frighten the enemy.

source_zh: 战斗系转职远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，有一定几率附带持续减少目标生命力效果，敏捷、转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Combat-type long-range group 3×3 range attack skill for changing jobs, there is a certain chance of continuously reducing the target’s vitality. Agility and job transfer level affect the skill damage.

source_zh:
火系列基本长距离攻击魔法，杀伤力随智力和技术的提高而增加。攻击距离取决于法术等级。 
  
借助小鹰形状的卡萨的力量的精灵魔法。当许多小鹰形状聚集时会形成巨大的不死鸟形状。由于卡萨的样子很像离弦之箭，随意得来此名，由火焰组成的卡萨时刻注视着对方的心脏部位。
translation:
Fire series basic long-distance attack magic, the lethality increases with the improvement of intelligence and technology. Attack range depends on spell level.
  
Elf magic using the power of Kasa in the shape of a small eagle. A giant phoenix shape is formed when many small eagle shapes come together. Kasa was named randomly because it looks like an arrow from a string. Kasa, which is composed of flames, always looks at the opponent's heart.

source_zh: 火系远程单体攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Fire-based long-range single-target attack skill, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 暂时提高自己的火属性攻击魔法杀伤力的魔法，取决于智力和技术等级。持续时间取决于技术等级和敏捷。要深入使用火精灵，须得到火精灵王伊夫里特的认可。他将自己的绝技烈火的攻击力赋予精灵师，并允许使用火的权限
translation: A magic that temporarily increases the lethality of one's fire attribute attack magic, depending on intelligence and skill level. Duration depends on skill level and agility. To use the fire elf in depth, you must obtain the approval of the fire elf king Ifrit. He gave the elf master the attack power of his special skill, Agni Fire, and allowed the permission to use fire.

source_zh: 火系增益技能，百分比增加自身火系魔法伤害，技能等级影响增益效果。精灵石数量不足增益效果会消失。
translation: Fire buff skill, which increases the own fire magic damage by a percentage, and the skill level affects the buff effect. If the number of Elf Stones is insufficient, the benefit will disappear.

source_zh: 将一定范围变成火海的广域攻击魔法，杀伤力，持续时间取决于智力和法术等级。延时随敏捷而减少，施展距离随法术等级而增加。用光精灵尼特拉斯的力量召唤太阳火焰的魔法。召唤此魔法，可将一个地方变成火海，使被困的人们将要体验到红焰的滚烫。在范围里的角色直到脱离该区域，一直会受到伤害。（同族不会受伤害。）
translation: A wide-area attack magic that turns a certain area into a sea of fire. Its lethality and duration depend on intelligence and spell level. The delay decreases with Dexterity and the casting distance increases with the spell level. Use the power of Nitras, the light elf, to summon the magic of the sun's flames. Summoning this magic can turn a place into a sea of ​​fire, so that the trapped people will experience the scalding red flames. Characters within the range will continue to take damage until they leave the area. (Members of the same species will not be harmed.)

source_zh: 火系远程群体3×3范围地板技能，在技能范围内造成持续伤害，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Fire remote group 3×3 range floor skill, causing continuous damage within the skill range, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 在一定时间内给接近自己的所有敌人给予打击的魔法，杀伤力取决于智力和技术等级。持续时间取决于智力和技术等级。召唤火的中级精灵沙勒曼德来攻击敌人的技术。施展者周围有火团保护，并给接近的敌人以火焰攻击。施展过程中也可以使用其他技术。
translation: A magic that strikes all enemies close to you within a certain period of time. The lethality depends on intelligence and technical level. Duration depends on intelligence and skill level. A technique that summons Salamander, a mid-level elf of fire, to attack the enemy. The caster is protected by a ball of fire and attacks approaching enemies with fire. Other techniques may also be used during the casting process.

source_zh: 火系增益技能，召唤火精灵，对靠近自身的目标造成伤害，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。佩戴武器不是护腕增益技能会消失。
translation: Fire buff skill, summons fire elves, causing damage to targets close to itself. Intelligence and skill level affect skill damage. The buff skills will disappear if you wear a weapon other than the bracer.

source_zh:
发射火团的远距离攻击魔法，杀伤力随着智力和技能等级而决定。延时和攻击距离隶属于技能等级。

受助于火的上级精灵伊格尼斯帮助的魔法，是卡萨之箭升级版本，此魔法可以进行远距离攻击。
translation: A long-distance attack magic that launches fireballs. The lethality is determined by intelligence and skill level. Delay and attack distance are subject to skill level.The magic helped by Ignis, the superior elf of fire, is an upgraded version of Casa's Arrow. This magic can carry out long-distance attacks.

source_zh: 火系远程单体攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Fire-based long-range single-target attack skill, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 由三根手指放出的火焰之息，向外扩张攻击敌人。
translation: The breath of fire released by three fingers expands outward to attack the enemy.

source_zh: 火系远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Fire remote group 3×3 range attack skill, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 放出一个火精灵跟随自己并攻击敌人。
translation: releases a fire spirit to follow you and attack the enemy.

source_zh: 火系召唤技能，召唤火元素单体攻击目标，智力和技能等级影响元素伤害。佩戴武器不是护腕火元素会消失。
translation: Fire summoning skill, summons a single fire element to attack the target, intelligence and skill level affect elemental damage. If you wear a weapon other than a bracer, the fire element will disappear.

source_zh: 召唤从天而降源源不断的火焰攻击敌人，随着法术的等级提升数量和威力也提升。
translation: Summons a steady stream of flames falling from the sky to attack the enemy. As the level of the spell increases, the quantity and power also increase.

source_zh: 火系远程单体多段攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Fire-type long-range single-target multi-stage attack skill, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 召唤地下的岩浆造成火山喷发给予站在上面的敌人以致命伤害。
translation: Summons underground magma to cause a volcanic eruption, inflicting fatal damage to enemies standing above.

source_zh: 火系远程群体3×3范围地板技能，在技能范围内的敌人附加一个持续伤害的效果，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Fire-type remote group 3×3 range floor skill. Enemies within the skill range are given a continuous damage effect. Intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 强化玛格南长矛的精通技能。练成这中技能，就可以把火球掷在地上以增强毁坏力。随着技能等级的提高，毁坏力也会增加。
translation: Strengthens the mastery skill of Magnum Spear. After mastering this skill, you can throw fireballs on the ground to increase the destructive power. As the skill level increases, the destructive power increases.

source_zh: 火系被动技能，将赤雨流焰多段伤害转变为单次伤害，并附加伤害加成效果，技能等级影响伤害效果。
translation: Fire passive skill, converts the multi-stage damage of Red Rain Flowing Flame into single damage, and adds a damage bonus effect. The skill level affects the damage effect.

source_zh: Miga愤怒的火焰,根据它自己的意志攻击敌人。
translation: Miga's angry flames attack enemies according to its own will.

source_zh: 火系召唤技能，召唤火精灵通过自爆方式群体5×5范围攻击目标，智力和敏捷影响火精灵伤害。
translation: Fire summoning skill, summons fire elves to attack the target in a 5×5 range through self-destruction. Intelligence and agility affect the damage of the fire elves.

source_zh: 火之灵魂有着精力旺盛的精灵，它不太满意只能烧灼一个物体。当一个物体触到火,它会立刻延烧到周围。假如你在一群敌人中使用它,可造成一片火海。
translation: The Fire Soul has an energetic spirit that is not content with being able to burn only one object. When an object touches fire, it immediately spreads to the surrounding area. If you use it in a group of enemies, it can cause a sea of ​​​​fire.

source_zh: 火系转职远程群体攻击技能，附带持续伤害传染效果，智力和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Fire-type long-range group attack skills for class transfer, with continuous damage contagion effect, intelligence and class transfer level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 召唤火鸭附予敌人身上,可使敌人在痛苦中死亡，它的威力根据你的能力。
translation: Summon the fire duck and attach it to the enemy, which can cause the enemy to die in pain. Its power depends on your ability.

source_zh: 火系转职远程群体多段攻击技能，第一段为攻击单体目标，第二段以目标为中心5×5范围攻击，智力和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Fire type long-range group multi-stage attack skill. The first stage is to attack a single target, and the second stage is a 5×5 range attack centered on the target. Intelligence and class transfer level affect the skill damage.

source_zh: 借用火精灵的无限力量，只有少数高级魔灵可使用它,转换热火为球,丢向周围的敌人,造成范围燃烧.智力影响杀伤。
translation: Borrows the infinite power of fire elves. Only a few high-level Ousters can use it to convert heat into balls and throw them at surrounding enemies, causing burning in a wide range. Intelligence affects the damage.

source_zh: 火系远程群体5×5范围攻击技能，智力和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Fire remote group 5×5 range attack skill, intelligence and job transfer level affect skill damage.

source_zh:
水系列的基本攻击魔法，杀伤力随着智力和技能等级而增加。
~
召唤制造彩虹的水精灵克里蒂的魔法。
translation: The basic attack magic of the water series, the lethality increases with intelligence and skill level.~The magic that summons Criti, the water spirit that creates rainbows.

source_zh: 水系远程单体攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Water type long-range single target attack skill, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 在地面上铺上一层冰使得对方的移动速度减半的魔法，法术范围，持续时间和延时取决于技术等级。召唤冰精灵格留佩因的魔法，魔法力的大小仅受精灵师的能力限制，因此对于初学精灵术的人很有帮助。格留佩因被召唤的地方会立即被冰冻，束缚进入该区域的人们。
translation: A magic that lays a layer of ice on the ground to halve the opponent's movement speed. The spell range, duration and delay depend on the skill level. The magic power of summoning the ice elf Gliupein is only limited by the ability of the elf master, so it is very helpful for those who are new to elf magic. The place where Gryupein is summoned will be immediately frozen, binding those who enter the area.

source_zh: 水系远程群体3×3范围地板技能，在技能范围内的敌人附加一个降低移动速度的效果。
translation: Water-based remote group 3×3 area floor skill. Enemies within the skill range will have an effect that reduces their movement speed.

source_zh:
利用水墙低档一部分远距离物理攻击和广域攻击，魔法攻击的破坏力。杀伤力减少量和持续时间取决于智力和技术等级。

召唤精灵翁蒂内的气息，形成无形的水墙，加以防范的魔法。
translation: utilizes the destructive power of water wall's low-end long-range physical attacks, wide-area attacks, and magic attacks. The amount and duration of the damage reduction depends on intelligence and skill level.A magic that summons the breath of the spirit Ondy to form an invisible water wall for protection.

source_zh: 水系增益技能，可以减少部分魔法技能伤害，智力和技能等级影响增益效果。佩戴武器不是护腕、精灵石数量不足增益技能会消失。
translation: Water-based gain skills can reduce the damage of some magic skills, and intelligence and skill levels affect the gain effect. If you wear a weapon other than a bracer and the number of elf stones is insufficient, the buff skills will disappear.

source_zh:
将对方用水柱缠绕的近距离魔法，杀伤力取决于智力和技术等级。攻击距离隶属于技术等级。

召唤水精灵希奎尔的魔法。他是个好战的精灵，决不允许擅自闯入自己领地的人们。
translation: A close-range magic that surrounds the opponent with water jets. Its lethality depends on intelligence and skill level. Attack distance is subject to technical level.The magic that summons the water spirit Siquil. He is a warlike elf who will never allow people to trespass into his territory.

source_zh: 水系远程单体攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Water type long-range single target attack skill, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh:
恢复自己或同伙的HP或EP的魔法，恢复量取决于智力和技术等级。延时和施展距离隶属于技术等级。

水精灵尼木夫会给予需要帮助的他们援助之手
translation: A magic that restores one's own or an accomplice's HP or EP. The amount of recovery depends on intelligence and skill level. Delay and cast distance belong to technical level.The water elf Nimuf will give a helping hand to those in need.

source_zh: 水系增益技能，给自身或同族角色恢复生命力，附带解除荧绿之毒、艳黄之毒、毒雾、幽暗之毒负面状态，智力和技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: Water-based buffing skills can restore vitality to yourself or characters of the same race, and also remove the negative status of green poison, bright yellow poison, poisonous mist, and dark poison. Intelligence and skill level affect the buffing effect.

source_zh: 召唤生命精灵来复活同伴的魔法。
translation: A magic that summons the spirit of life to resurrect companions.

source_zh: 水系复活技能，可以复活处于濒临死亡状态的同族角色。
translation: Water resurrection skill, which can revive characters of the same race who are on the verge of death.

source_zh:
解除吸血鬼的麻痹状态的魔法，成功率，延时，有效距离隶属于技术等级。

用水精灵王艾尔奎内斯的恢复能力，使受到诅咒的恶灵返回黑暗。
translation: The magic to relieve the paralysis of vampires, the success rate, delay, and effective distance are subject to the technical level.The restorative power of the Water Elf King Elquines causes the cursed evil spirits to return to darkness.

source_zh: 水系远程单体解除负面状态技能，可以解除同族角色麻痹负面状态，技能和角色等级影响解除成功率。
translation: Water-type remote single-target negative status removal skill can remove the paralysis negative status of characters of the same race. Skills and character levels affect the success rate of removal.

source_zh: 将空气中的水分凝结成冰并给予敌人打击。
translation: Condenses moisture in the air into ice and strikes the enemy.

source_zh: 水系远程单体攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Water type long-range single target attack skill, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 用最坚韧的冰制造一个铠甲，可以防御任何方位来的攻击。
translation: Use the toughest ice to create an armor that can defend against attacks from any direction.

source_zh: 水系增益技能，可以减少部分物理技能伤害，并给攻击者附带一个降低移动速度的负面状态，智力和技能等级影响增益效果。精灵石数量不足增益技能会消失。
translation: Water-based buff skills can reduce some physical skill damage and give the attacker a negative state that reduces movement speed. Intelligence and skill level affect the buff effect. If the number of Elf Stones is insufficient, the buff skills will disappear.

source_zh: 召唤一个水精灵跟随自己并不断的治愈自己受到的伤害。
translation: Summons a water elf to follow you and constantly heal yourself from damage.

source_zh: 水系召唤技能，召唤水元素给自身或队友恢复生命力，智力和技能等级影响恢复效果。佩戴武器不是护腕水元素会消失。
translation: Water summoning skill, summons water elements to restore vitality to yourself or teammates. Intelligence and skill level affect the recovery effect. If you wear a weapon other than a bracer, the water element will disappear.

source_zh: 放出一个喷泉限制敌人的移动。
translation: Releases a fountain to restrict the enemy's movement.

source_zh: 水系远程单体攻击技能，附带使目标无法移动、无法使用技能和伤害减免效果，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Water-type long-range single-target attack skill, with the effect of making the target unable to move, unable to use skills and damage reduction. Intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 再次跟生命精灵签约来增强复活魔法的效果
translation: Contracted with Life Elf again to enhance the effect of resurrection magic

source_zh: 水系被动技能，增加复活技能的施放距离、成功率、生命力恢复比例，技能等级影响被动效果。
translation: Water passive skill, increases the casting distance, success rate, and vitality recovery ratio of resurrection skills. The skill level affects the passive effect.

source_zh: 强化冰冻长枪的精通技能。熟练这种技能的人可以把普通的冰冻长枪升级为3*3大小的区域攻击。技能等级越高毁坏性也越强。
translation: Strengthens the mastery skill of the frozen spear. People who are skilled in this skill can upgrade the ordinary freezing spear to a 3*3 area attack. The higher the skill level, the more destructive it is.

source_zh: 水系被动技能，增加疾风冰矛技能伤害和攻击范围（3×3），同时攻击目标变化为无固定目标，技能等级影响被动效果。
translation: Water passive skill, increases the damage and attack range of the blast ice spear skill (3×3). At the same time, the attack target changes to no fixed target, and the skill level affects the passive effect.

source_zh: 召唤水精灵之泪,借用她的治疗能力。水神之泪滴含有强大的治疗能力,可恢复一定距离内的队友的生命力，智力影响治疗能力。
translation: Summons the Tears of the Water Elf and borrows her healing power. Teardrops of the Water God contain powerful healing abilities that can restore the vitality of teammates within a certain distance, and intelligence affects healing abilities.

source_zh: 水系召唤技能，召唤水精灵并在5×5范围内给自身或同族角色恢复生命力，智力和技能等级影响恢复效果。
translation: Water summoning skill, summons water elves and restores vitality to itself or characters of the same family within a 5×5 range. Intelligence and skill level affect the recovery effect.

source_zh: 当使用这个技能的时候,一个影子覆盖5x5范围。影子闪过,冰雹从天而降,给予敌人固定伤害。
translation: When using this skill, a shadow covers a 5x5 area. Shadows flashed and hail fell from the sky, inflicting fixed damage to the enemy.

source_zh: 水系转职远程群体5×5范围地板技能，在技能范围内的敌人造成持续伤害，智力和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Water type long-distance group 5×5 area floor skill for job transfer. Enemies within the skill range will cause continuous damage. Intelligence and job transfer level affect the skill damage.

source_zh: 水精灵一般情况下温顺,但主人被攻击之时,它会攻击敌人。这个技能魔灵专有,它可以使敌人盲目并且爆炸。
translation: The water elf is generally docile, but when its owner is attacked, it will attack the enemy. This skill is exclusive to monsters, and it can blind enemies and cause them to explode.

source_zh: 水系转职远程群体多段攻击技能，第一段为攻击单体目标，最后一段以目标为中心5×5范围攻击，智力和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Water-type long-range group multi-stage attack skill for class transfer. The first stage is to attack a single target, and the last stage is a 5×5 range attack centered on the target. Intelligence and class transfer level affect the skill damage.

source_zh: 冰冻之川借用冰之灵魂的能量，它可以使敌人周围的空气迅速冰冻,并且从敌人体内开始伤害，伤害取决于智力。
translation: Frozen River borrows the energy of the ice soul. It can quickly freeze the air around the enemy and cause damage from within the enemy's body. The damage depends on intelligence.

source_zh: 水系转职远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，附带一定技能触发降低目标移动速度效果，智力和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Water-type long-range group 3×3 range attack skill for job transfer, with certain skill triggers that reduce the target’s movement speed. Intelligence and job transfer level affect skill damage.

source_zh:
大地系列中基本的中距离攻击魔法，根据智力和技能等级，杀伤力会增加。攻击距离隶属于技能等级。

借助大地妖精德沃夫的力量，丢落岩石的魔法。
translation: The basic mid-range attack magic in the Earth series, the lethality will increase according to the intelligence and skill level. Attack distance is dependent on skill level.The magic of throwing rocks with the help of the power of the earth elf Dwulf.

source_zh: 土系远程单体攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Earth type long-range single target attack skill, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh:
一种阻止对方移动的魔法，遭到此魔法后，角色既不受攻击也不能攻击。魔法持续时间取决于智力和法术等级，成功率和延时，施展距离等则单取决于法术等级！
~
将丛林精灵内奈频的气息赋予大地的魔法。魔法成功时，会由许多树藤缠绕在对方的身上。
translation: A kind of magic that prevents the opponent from moving. After being hit by this magic, the character can neither be attacked nor attacked. The duration of magic depends on intelligence and spell level, the success rate and delay, the casting distance, etc. depend solely on the spell level!~The magic of the earth is given by the breath of Nepin, the jungle spirit. When the magic is successful, many vines will wrap around the opponent's body.

source_zh: 土系召唤技能，召唤藤曼困住目标，使目标无法移动、无法使用技能，同时也使目标处于无敌状态。
translation: Earth summoning skill, summons vines to trap the target, making the target unable to move or use skills, and also makes the target invincible.

source_zh: 可以感知隐蔽的敌人的魔法。最初有效程度是隐藏，但当技术等级达到15后，可以看到隐身，到了25狙击手也能看得出来。持续时间随着智力和技术等级而不同。
translation: Can sense the magic of hidden enemies. The initial effectiveness is hiding, but when the skill level reaches 15, the invisibility can be seen, and at 25, the sniper can also see it. Duration varies with intelligence and skill level.

source_zh: 土系增益技能，使自身或队友拥有识别隐蔽、隐身、狙击状态的能力，技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: Earth-based buffing skills allow oneself or teammates to have the ability to identify concealment, invisibility, and sniper status. The skill level affects the buffing effect.

source_zh:
让石头从地面钻出的远距离攻击魔法，杀伤力取决于智力和技术等级。延时和攻击距离隶属于技术等级。

召唤地的下级精灵诺姆的魔法。召唤时会用地上的尖尖的石块攻击敌人。
translation: A long-range attack magic that makes rocks emerge from the ground. Its lethality depends on intelligence and technical level. Delay and attack distance are subject to technical level.Summons the magic of Nomu, the lower level elf in the land. When summoned, it will attack the enemy with sharp rocks on the ground.

source_zh: 土系远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Earth type remote group 3×3 range attack skill, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh:
解除吸血鬼的黑暗的魔法，范围，成功率，延时，施展距离隶属于技术等级。

借助地的中级精灵莫尔顿的力量，在地下沼泽制作的天然气，具有净化大地的能力。
translation: The magic that removes the darkness of vampires, range, success rate, delay, and casting distance are subject to technical level.With the help of the power of Morton, the intermediate elf of the earth, the natural gas produced in the underground swamp has the ability to purify the earth.

source_zh: 土系远程群体3×3范围破除黑暗之触效果，智力和技能等级影响技能施放成功率。
translation: The 3×3 range of the earth remote group can break the effect of the touch of darkness. Intelligence and skill level affect the success rate of skill casting.

source_zh:
掷出风力锯齿的中距离攻击魔法，杀伤力取决于智力和技能等级。延时和攻击距离隶属于技术等级。

召唤地之精灵克劳威尔需要另外的媒介。因此，要借助它的力量，须使用召唤地下深处锋利矿物的双重魔法。
translation:
A mid-range attack magic that throws wind sawtooths. Its lethality depends on intelligence and skill level. Delay and attack distance are subject to technical level.

Summoning the earth elf Crowell requires another medium. Therefore, to harness its power, one must use dual magic that summons sharp minerals deep underground.

source_zh: 土系远程单体攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Earth type long-range single target attack skill, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 召唤大地精灵给自己的铠甲增加防护效果，可以减少物理攻击对自己的伤害。
translation: Summons the earth elves to add protective effects to your armor, which can reduce the damage caused by physical attacks to you.

source_zh: 土系增益技能，增加自身或同族角色回避率、防御率，智力和技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: Earth-based buffing skills increase the evasion rate and defense rate of oneself or characters of the same race, and intelligence and skill levels affect the buffing effect.

source_zh: 通过召唤大地精灵并得到大地精灵的祝福来增强自己的能力。
translation: Enhance your abilities by summoning earth spirits and receiving their blessings.

source_zh: 土系增益技能，增加自身或同族角色能力值总和，力量、敏捷、智力和技能等级影响增益效果。
translation: Earth-type gain skills, which increase the total ability value of oneself or characters of the same race. Strength, agility, intelligence and skill level affect the gain effect.

source_zh: 通过与大地精灵签约放出一个5X5范围的保护区，在这个区域内的所有魔灵的能力都会提升，但是如果释放者死亡的话，这个区域就会消失。
translation: releases a 5X5 protected area by signing a contract with the earth elves. The abilities of all monsters in this area will be improved, but if the releaser dies, this area will disappear.

source_zh: 土系召唤技能，召唤土精灵在5×5范围内隐藏自身或同族角色行踪，技能等级影响土精灵生命力。
translation: Earth summoning skill, summons earth elves to hide themselves or characters of the same race within a 5×5 range. The skill level affects the vitality of earth elves.

source_zh: 召唤大量的石头从天而降，给予一定范围内的敌人以伤害。
translation: Summons a large number of stones to fall from the sky, causing damage to enemies within a certain range.

source_zh: 土系远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Earth type remote group 3×3 range attack skill, intelligence and skill level affect skill damage.

source_zh: 强化反应装甲的精通技能。练成这个技能后使用在自己身上，可以起到削弱破坏力的防护作用。破坏力的减少以及被动技能和普通技能的等级都有影响，并且随着技能等级的提高，普通技能的防御力和回避率的增加量也会提高。
translation: Strengthens the mastery skills of reactive armor. After mastering this skill and using it on yourself, it can play a protective role in weakening the destructive power. The reduction of destructive power and the levels of passive skills and normal skills have an impact, and as the skill level increases, the increase in defense power and evasion rate of normal skills will also increase.

source_zh: 土系被动技能，增加大地护甲技能回避率、防御率的增益效果，并附带减免物理伤害效果，技能等级和是否学习土系命运转职技能影响被动效果。
translation: Earth passive skill, which increases the evasion rate and defense rate of earth armor skills, and also has the effect of reducing physical damage. The passive effect is affected by skill level and whether to learn earth destiny transfer skills.

source_zh: 这个技能可借用大地之力,即大地灵魂。它可召唤一个巨大的岩石从天而降，它是一个范围性难以抵挡的能量，但岩石柱稳定住在地上,它在附近的敌人的攻击速度将减半,这就是它实际有用之处。
translation: This skill can borrow the power of the earth, that is, the soul of the earth. It summons a giant rock to fall from the sky. It's a range of energy that's hard to withstand, but the rock pillar stays stable on the ground. Enemies nearby will have their attack speed halved, which is where it's actually useful.

source_zh: 土系远程群体5×5范围地板技能，降低技能范围内的敌人技能施放速度，智力和技能等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Earth-type remote group 5×5 area floor skill, which reduces the skill casting speed of enemies within the skill range, and intelligence and skill levels affect skill damage.

source_zh: 那些灵魂不只是攻击那些招惹它们或者他们的立契约者,甚至是视所有物体为之敌人。
translation: Those souls not only attack those who provoke them or their contract makers, but even regard all objects as their enemies.

source_zh: 土系转职远程群体多段攻击技能，第一段为单体攻击，第二段以目标为中心7×7范围最多10个同类目标群体攻击，智力和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Earth type long-range group multi-stage attack skill. The first stage is a single attack, and the second stage is a group attack with up to 10 similar targets in a 7×7 range centered on the target. Intelligence and class transfer level affect the skill damage.

source_zh: 召唤魔法圈保护魔灵受到敌人攻击，魔灵在这个魔法范围内可治愈，智力影响能力。
translation: Summons a magic circle to protect Ousters from enemy attacks. Ousters can be healed within this magic range, and their intelligence affects their abilities.

source_zh: 土系转职远程群体5×5范围地板技能，在技能范围内有伤害减免效果，并附带清除雷神之剑、安装炮塔、光辉领域、仁慈大地、避难所、黑暗之触、黑暗神力、血墙、酸性沼泽、艳黄之毒、萤绿之毒、冰之领域技能的能力。
translation: Earth type long-range group 5×5 area floor skill, which has a damage reduction effect within the skill range, and comes with the ability to clear Thor's Sword, Installation Turret, Radiant Field, Mercy Earth, Refuge, Dark Touch, Dark Power, Blood Wall, Acidic Swamp, Brilliant Yellow Poison, Fluorescent Poison, and Ice Domain skills.

source_zh: 卫星轰炸是一种非常强大的魔法,它凝聚大地精灵的能量,召唤卫星范围攻击.智力越高威力越大。
translation: Satellite bombing is a very powerful magic. It condenses the energy of the earth elves and summons satellites to attack within a range. The higher the intelligence, the greater the power.

source_zh: 土系转职远程群体3×3范围攻击技能，智力和转职等级影响技能伤害。
translation: Earth type long-range group 3×3 range attack skill for job transfer, intelligence and job transfer level affect skill damage.

source_zh:
在无数战场上纵横无尽的传说中那些顶级的达人们拥有一种超强能力，可以通过强烈的灵魂锁链，瞬间把握特定人物的具体位置并追击。
所以顶极的长老们能够向同族的人类或吸血鬼所在地移动。
translation: Those top experts who have traveled endlessly on countless battlefields have a super ability. They can instantly grasp the specific location of specific people and pursue them through strong soul chains.Therefore, the top elders can move to the location of humans or vampires of the same race.

source_zh: 三族通用传送技能，在追踪栏中输入同族角色名称，可以传送到对方身边。
translation: is a universal teleportation skill for all three races. Enter the name of a character of the same race in the tracking column to teleport to the other party.

source_zh: 不只是人类还有狼和蝙蝠等夜晚的动物也会被吸血鬼眩惑住。用此魔法可以召唤助战的一只强力的狼。操纵一只狼是很费劲的事情故两只以上的狼是几乎不可能操纵的。级别高的吸血鬼可根据自己的意愿自如地控制招徕的狼。
translation: Not only humans but also night animals such as wolves and bats are also dazzled by vampires. Use this magic to summon a powerful wolf to help you fight. It is very difficult to control a wolf, but it is almost impossible to control two or more wolves. High-level vampires can freely control the wolves they attract according to their own wishes.

source_zh: 能力突出熟练的吸血鬼们可使未完全死亡的怪物们暂时复活。没有灵魂的这些怪物们将跟随使自己复活的吸血鬼随从。
translation: Vampires with outstanding abilities and proficiency can temporarily resurrect monsters that are not completely dead. The soulless monsters will follow the reanimated vampire minions.

source_zh: 召唤可以自己制作的吸血鬼一只的魔法。当然如果召唤更强的吸血鬼须消耗更多的血。而且不能召唤比自己级别高的吸血鬼.召唤而来的吸血鬼只能在被召唤的地区内移动，超过范围马上会死亡。
translation: A magic that summons a vampire that you can make yourself. Of course, if you summon a stronger vampire, more blood will be consumed. And you cannot summon vampires with a higher level than yourself. The summoned vampire can only move within the summoned area, and will die immediately if it exceeds the range.

source_zh: 境界比较高的剑士可以运用自身所有的技术来创造新动作。多种技术没有延时地连续攻击可使敌人受到致命伤。
translation: A swordsman with a relatively high level can use all his skills to create new moves. A variety of techniques can cause fatal damage to the enemy by continuously attacking without delay.

source_zh: 吸血鬼长老们能召唤具有不可抗拒的强大力量的血水晶来封闭人类。在被关期间人类将忍受极大的痛苦。
translation: Vampire elders can summon blood crystals with irresistible power to seal away humans. Human beings will endure great suffering while in captivity.

source_zh: 经长时间修炼的吸血鬼所施的魔法攻击力更强且攻击范围更广。做出血球一次性攻击很大的范围使很多生灵受到致命打击。
translation: The magic attacks cast by vampires who have practiced for a long time are stronger and have a wider attack range. The blood ball attacks a large area in one go, causing fatal blows to many creatures.
